stem: 34．Some very rare drawings have been recovered for this exhibition through ______ research work in museums and libraries.

stem: 36．Employer-sponsored programs are unlikely to be paid entirely or even partly by employers. ______, employee-pay-all plans are the most likely scenario, ______ the rising employer costs for the employer-paid benefit plans already in effect.

stem: 39．Dave: It s important to understand that it s not too late. ______ and think that you have no chance of success. Paul: It s still not too late? All my hopes were dashed by the announcement. Dave: You need to remain alert, especially in a crisis.

stem: 39． Look, what a mess your room is! Don t mock my disorder next time! ______.

stem: Section B Cultures （5 marks） 41．______ refers to some contrast or discrepancy between appearance and reality.

stem: 42．The main theme of Emily Dickinson is the following except ______.

stem: 43．In Britain, children from the age of 5 to 16 ______.

stem: 44．The first steam engine was devised by Thomas Newcomer at the end of the 17th century, and the Scottish inventor ______ modified and improved the design in 1765.

stem: 45． Beauty is truth, truth beauty is an epigrammatic line by ______.

stem: Section A Vocabulary and Grammar (10 marks) 31.I know you re ______ to your neck in work at the moment and probably don t want to take ______ any more, but could you have a look at this new project?

stem: 36.______ thinks that Judith should be given the job, but she encouraged ______ it.

stem: 37.A lot of those interviewed said the men talk about their problems more than in the past. ______ that, they felt that the situation had not changed much.

stem: 38.Beyond the orbit of our planet ______ the red world of Mars. If you look at it through a telescope, the planet appears to have patches of a blue-green colour, ______ scientists think may be some kind of plant life.

stem: 39. I suppose we could walk or cycle to the pool-it s not that far. Yes, but it s so hot we ll be exhausted by the time we get there. ______ It stops right outside. That s a good idea. And we could use our card.

analysis: 【解析】对话中第一个说话者提议步行或骑自行车去游泳池，根据第二个说话者提到的“但是天太热了，我们到地方时也已经累得不行了…它就停在外面”，可知B项“坐38路公交车怎么样”符合语境。

stem: 40 I m thinking of going into healthcare. A lot of reports say it s a growing field. Is it? ______ Not at all. The population is growing older, so there s a need for every kind of healthcare. Actually my mother was a nurse for thirty years. And I think it might suit me too.

analysis: 【解析】第一个说话者表示想向医疗方面发展，提到很多报告指出该领域正在不断发展，第二个说话者进行了反问，接着第一个说话者解释说“一点儿也不。随着老龄化的发展，人们对医疗领域的方方面面都有需求…”。由此可见D项“我之前还以为医生太多了呢”符合语境。

stem: Section B cultures (5 marks) 41.Generally accounted, with The Times and The Daily Telegraph, ______ is an influential daily newspaper published in London and Manchester, as one of the United Kingdom s big three quality newspaper.

stem: 42.The Australian flag uses three prominent symbols: the Union Flag, the Commonwealth Star and the Southern Cross. The Union Flag is thought locally to symbolise Australia s history as six ______ colonies and the principles upon which the Australian Federation is based.
choices: British<sep>American<sep>Spanish<sep>Portuguese
analysis: 【解析】澳大利亚国旗上有三个突出的图案：英国国旗(表示其为英联邦一份子)、英联邦星和南十字星。米字旗被认为是象征澳大利亚作为的英国殖民地的历史。联邦之星象征着组成澳联邦的六个洲和联邦区。其余部分有四颗较大的白色七角星与一颗较小的白色五角星，代表的是太平洋上空的南十字星座。

stem: 43.The Wars of the ______ were a series of dynastic wars between 1455 and 1485 fought between supporters of two rival branches of the royal House of Plantagenet: the Houses of Lancaster and York for the throne of England.
choices: Lilies<sep>Roses<sep>Tulips<sep>Mayflowers
analysis: 【解析】Wars of the Roses(玫瑰战争)，主要发生在1455年和1485年之间。玫瑰战争是英王爱德华三世的两支后裔：兰开斯特家族和约克家族的支持者为争夺英格兰王位而发生的断续内战。玫瑰战争的。战争最终以兰开斯特家族的亨利七世与约克的伊丽莎白联姻而结束。

stem: 44.Ernest Hemingway is one of the most famous American writers of the 20th century. He wrote novels and short stories about outdoorsmen, expatriates, soldiers and other men of action. In ______, he told the story of a young American during the Spanish Civil War.
choices: The Old Man and the Sea<sep>A Farewell to Arms<sep>For Whom the Bell Tolls<sep>The Sun Also Rises
analysis: 【解析】Ernest Miller Hemingway(欧内斯特·米勒尔·海明威)，为美国作家和记者，被认为是20世纪最著名的小说家之一。他是美国“迷惘的一代”(Lost Generation)作家中的代表人物。其中《丧钟为谁而鸣》是以美国人参加西班牙人民反法西斯战争为题材的海明威的代表作之一。

stem: 45.The MBA or M.B.A is ______, which attracts people from a wide range of academic disciplines. The MBA designation originated in the United States, emerging from the late 19th century as the country industrialised and companies sought out scientific approaches to management.

stem: Part II Vocabulary, Grammar and Culture （15 marks） There are 15 incomplete sentences in this section. For each blank there are four choices marked A, B, C and D. Section A Vocabulary and Grammar （10 marks） 31．I feel it is your husband who______for the spoiled child.
choices: is to blame<sep>is blamed<sep>is to be blamed<sep>should blame
analysis: 【解析】句意：我感觉孩子被惯坏是你丈夫的责任。be to blame为固定用法，意为“对某事应负责任的，应受责备的”。

stem: 32．When we returned from the ball, we found that our house ______ and many things ______.
choices: has broken into; has been stolen<sep>has broken; had been stolen<sep>had been broken into; stolen<sep>had been broken; stolen
analysis: 【解析】句意：从舞会回来后，我们发现房子被撬了，许多东西都丢了。break into为固定搭配，意为“闯入；打断；把…分成”，排除B项和D项。house与break into之间为被动关系，因此答案选C。第二个空为避免重复而省略了have been。

stem: 33．______ my finishing reading the novel, you can have it immediately.
choices: On<sep>At<sep>For<sep>With
analysis: 【解析】句意：我一看完这本小说，就会立刻给你。on/upon doing为惯用搭配，指“一…就…”，相当于as soon as。

stem: 34．It wasn t long before they found that there was much trouble ______the plan.
choices: to carry out<sep>carrying out<sep>with carrying out<sep>to have carried out
analysis: 【解析】句意：不久，他们就发现实行该计划非常困难。there is no difficulty/trouble （in） doing sth.为固定用法，意为“做某事不困难”，题干中为该搭配的肯定形式，即there is much trouble （in） doing。

stem: 35．The meeting ______over, I found her ______at the desk and ______to the music.
choices: to be; sitting; listened<sep>is; sitting; listened<sep>was; seating; listening<sep>being; seated; listening
analysis: 【解析】句意：会议结束了，我看见她坐在桌子旁，听着音乐。题干逗号前后两个分句都有各自的主语，并且两句并非并列关系，因此第一空应用独立主格结构，即使用非谓语动词，排除B项和C项。表示“坐在桌子旁”可用sit at the desk或be seated at the desk，但第二个分句宾语her与listen之间为主动关系，因此答案选D。

stem: 36．______, I have never seen anyone who s as capable as John.
choices: As much as I have traveled<sep>Now that I have traveled so much<sep>Much as I have traveled<sep>As I have traveled so much
analysis: 【解析】句意：虽然我经常出行，但从没见过像约翰那样能干的人。as和though引导让步状语从句时，必须将表语、状语或动词原形提前，即“名词/代词/形容词/副词/动词＋as/though＋主＋谓”。因此答案选C。

stem: 37．The other day, my friend John drove his car down the street at ______I thought was a dangerous speed, and ______surprised everyone in the car.

stem: 38．______and I ll get the work finished.
choices: Have one more hour<sep>One more hour<sep>Given one more hour<sep>If I have one more hour
analysis: 【解析】句意：再有一个小时，我就把工作做完了。题干中and连接两个并列的句子，因此状语成分的C项和D项均可排除；A项为省略了主语you的祈使句，前后意思不符。此处one more hour相当于give me one more hour。因此B项正确。

stem: 39． Bobby is overweight, but he is too young to be on a low-fat diet. He needs to exercise. What about keeping him from playing computer games or watching TV? stem: 40． Have you heard about the cafeteria s plan to have genetically modified food on the menu? Really? They say genetically modified food isn t safe. ______ We d better not. stem: 42．______ has been regarded by some as the Father of the English Poetry .
choices: Jonathan Swift<sep>John Bunyan<sep>Geoffrey Chaucer<sep>John Milton
analysis: 【解析】杰弗雷•乔叟，公认中世纪最伟大的英国诗人，也是首位葬在Poet of Westminster Abbey（维斯特敏斯特教堂诗人之角）的诗人，其被尊为“英国诗歌之父”。其代表作品为The Canterbury Tales《坎特伯雷故事集》，他在促进和中世纪英语白话的正统方面起着举足轻重的作用。

stem: 43．The book from which all modern American literature comes refers to ______.
choices: The Adventure of Huckleberry Finn<sep>The Great Gatsby<sep>An American Tragedy<sep>Sister Carrie
analysis: 【解析】The Adventure of Huckleberry Finn《哈克贝利•费恩历险记》是马克吐温是一部重要的作品，主要讲述了聪明、善良、勇敢的白人少年哈克贝利为追求自由生活逃亡到密西西比河上，并在逃亡途中遇到黑奴吉姆，两个人历经了种种奇遇的故事。海明威曾评价这本书“All modern American literature comes one book by Mark Twain called Huckleberry Finn...it’s the best book we’ve had...There was nothing before. There has been nothing so good since”。

stem: 44．The traditional dividing line in America between east and west is ______.

analysis: 【解析】密西西比河是世界第四长河，也是北美洲流程最长、流域面积最广、水量最大的河流，位于北美洲中南部。这条滔滔不绝的大河被美国人民长期以来称为“众河之父”。一般密西西比河被作为美国东西两部分的分界线。

stem: 45．In 1066, ______ led the Norman army in invading and defeating England.
choices: Alfred the Great<sep>Julius Caesar<sep>William the Conqueror<sep>Claudius
analysis: 【解析】威廉一世（William I）为英格兰诺曼王朝第一任国王，绰号为“征服者威廉”（William the Conqueror）。英格兰国王忏悔者爱德华是威廉的表兄弟，没有子嗣，据说威廉访英时曾答应让威廉继承他的王位。但当1066年，忏悔者爱德华去世时，在爱德华举荐下，英格兰贤人会议却选举了哈罗德为国王。威廉闻讯怒不可竭，于是发动了此次征服战。

stem: Part Ⅱ Vocabulary, Grammar Cultures (15 marks) There are 15 incomplete sentences in this section. For each blank there are four choices marked A, B, C and D. stem: 34．Though much has been said about teacher appraisal, it s odd that children, who see more of teachers than anyone else, are not routinely ______ for their views.

stem: 35．The recent identification of strains of plague resistant to drugs, and the possibility of using the microbe yersinia pestis as a chemical weapon in a war, mean that plague still ______ humans.

stem: 36．Doctors are becoming ______ about the health of children spending hour after hour ______ computer games who are exposing themselves to a range of potential hazards, from mouse elbow to joystick digit .

analysis: 【解析】Alice Munro(爱丽丝·门罗)为加拿大女作家，被誉为“加拿大的契诃夫”。2009年5月，爱丽丝·门罗以其作品一贯的极高水准和在全球的巨大影响，荣获第3届布克国际文学奖。2013年她获得了诺贝尔文学奖，瑞典学院给出的颁奖词是：“当代短篇文学小说大师”。其代表作品为Dance of the happy shades(《快乐影子之舞》)、Runaway(《逃离》)、The view from Castle Rock(《石城远望》)。

stem: 45._____is a collegiate research university located in England, United Kingdom. Although its exact date of foundation is unclear, there is evidence of teaching as far back as 1096，making it the oldest university in the English-speaking world, and the second-oldest surviving university in the world, after the university of Bologna.
choices: The University of Cambridge<sep>The University of Oxford<sep>The University of Wales<sep>The University of Edinburgh
analysis: 【解析】牛津大学是一所位于英国牛津市的公立大学，为英语世界中最古老的大学，也是世界上现存第二古老的高等教育机构。它在英国社会和高等教育系统中具有极其重要的地位，是一所在世界上享有顶尖大学声誉、巨大影响力的知名学府。

stem: Part II Vocabulary, Grammar and Culture （15 marks） There are l5 incomplete sentences in this section. For each blank there are four choices marked A, B, C and D. Choose the one that best completes the sentence. Then mark the corresponding letter on the answer sheet with a single line through the centre. Section A Vocabulary and Grammar （10 marks） 31．It was not until she got home ______ Jennifer realized she had lost her keys.
choices: when<sep>that<sep>where<sep>before
analysis: 【解析】句意：詹尼弗到家后才意识到自己把钥匙弄丢了。该句为强调句型，即It is/was...that/who..结构，因此答案选B。

stem: 32．He was not brave. He ______ jump down from the roof.
choices: dare not<sep>dared not<sep>dares not<sep>dare not to
analysis: 【解析】句意：他不勇敢，不敢从屋顶跳下去。根据第一句的was可知该空所在句也应用过去时，因此答案选B。

stem: 33．It was a wonder that ______ little food saved ______ many lives during the war.
choices: so；such<sep>such；so<sep>so；so<sep>such；such
analysis: 【解析】句意：真不敢相信，战争期间，这么一点食物就能拯救如此多条生命。such和so虽都有“如此，这样”之意，但such为形容词，修饰名词，而so为副词，修饰形容词或副词。第一个空之后的little为限定词，相当于形容词的作用，第二空之后的many为形容词，因此均应用so来修饰，故答案选C。

stem: 34．I have already divided all my possession amongst my family, so please give whatever ______to Robert.
choices: is leaving<sep>leaves<sep>has left<sep>is left
analysis: 【解析】句意：我已经把所有的财产都分给家人了，所有不管剩下什么请都给罗伯特吧。该句中whatever引导宾语从句，而give的直接宾语为whatever所引导的从句，间接宾语为Robert。whatever与leave （剩下）之间为被动关系，因此答案选D。

stem: 35．Every man in this country has the right to live where he wants to ______ the color of his skin.
choices: regardless of<sep>in view of<sep>in spite of<sep>in case of
analysis: 【解析】句意：不管是什么肤色，这个国家的每一个人都有权住在任何他想住的地方。regardless of不管，不顾。in view of由于，鉴于。in spite of虽然，尽管…。in case of万一，如果。

stem: 36．I can t thank you ______ much for your kindness because without your help I ______have won the first prize in the speech contest.
choices: too；wouldn t<sep>very；shouldn t<sep>that；might not<sep>so；couldn t
analysis: 【解析】句意：我真是太感谢你了，要是没有你的帮助，我也不会在这次演讲比赛中获第一名。对于第一个空，can never/can’t与too/too much/enough搭配表示“无论怎样…都不过分”；对于第二个空，without表示对非真实情况的假设，因此用虚拟语气，根据语境可知是对过去的假设，因此第二空用would/could/might （not） have done sth.结构。因此本题答案选A。

stem: 37．It is necessary for us to learn ______ second language ______ our mother tongue.
choices: the；besides<sep>a；except<sep>the；except<sep>a；besides
analysis: 【解析】句意：除了母语之外，有必要学习第二语言。对于第一空，题中并未给出明确语言范围，表示泛指，因此用不定冠词a；对于第二空，besides指“除…之外 （还有）”，而except指“除去 （不包括在内）”，因此该空应填besides。故答案选D。

stem: 38．When ______ different cultures, we often pay attention only to the differences without noticing the many similarities.
choices: compared<sep>being compared<sep>comparing<sep>having compared
analysis: 【解析】句意：比较不同文化时，我们经常只注意到不同之处而忽略文化间的众多相同点。当状语从句主语与主句主语相同，且从句中包含be动词的某种形式时，从句主语和be动词可省。本题前半句为由when引导的状语从句，其完整表达为when we are comparing different cultures，符合上述条件，因此答案选C。

stem: 39． I feel as if my head s going to explode! ______ After I d been playing computer games for about seven hours. Oh well, you ve only got yourself to blame, haven t you? I know, I know. But I ve taken aspirin, and it hasn t worked.
choices: Why are you walking like that?<sep>Well, when did it start?<sep>So, what did you do?<sep>Have you got any plans?
analysis: 【解析】根据第一个说话者的回答“我连续玩了几个小时的电脑游戏之后”，可知第二个说话者询问的是对方从什么时候开始感觉到头痛欲裂的，因此B项符合语境。

stem: 40． I m thinking of asking her to marry me. But you only met her last night! ______ Yeah, right!
choices: It seems like I ve known her all my life.<sep>I used to have piano lessons, but I got bored.<sep>How do you know her?<sep>When was the last time you saw her?
analysis: 【解析】题目中第一个说话者说自己想让某个女孩嫁给他，对于此第二个说话者指出“但是你们昨晚才是第一次见面啊”。Yeah, right!在英语中是带有嘲讽口气的反话，表示不相信对方，因此A项“感觉我似乎认识她一辈子了”符合语境。

stem: Section B Culture （5 marks） 41．The trouble is you re too good-natured and people take advantage of it. ______ You will have to learn to refuse people who ask too much.
choices: Walls have ears.<sep>Add fuel to the fire.<sep>All lay load on the willing horse.<sep>Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
analysis: 【解析】题干中指出“问题是你脾气太好了，别人就会利用你这一点…你应该学会拒绝那些向你提出太多要求的人”，因此C项“人善被人欺，马善被人骑”符合语境。Walls have ears隔墙有耳。Add fuel to the fire火上加油。Beauty is in the eye of the beholder情人眼中出西施。

stem: 42．The capital of Scotland is ______.
choices: Edinburgh<sep>Birmingham<sep>Glasgow<sep>Manchester
analysis: 【解析】苏格兰的首都是爱丁堡。Birmingham （伯明翰）是英国的第三大城市，位于英格兰中部、伦敦至利物浦的铁路干线上。Glasgow （格拉斯哥）是苏格兰第一大城市。Manchester （Manchester）是英格兰西北区域大曼彻斯特郡的都市自治市、城市、实行单一管理。

stem: 43． The Father of American Literature is ______.
choices: Benjamin Franklin<sep>Mark Twain<sep>Washington Irving<sep>Earnest Hemingway
analysis: 【解析】Washington Irving （华盛顿•欧文）是19世纪美国最著名的作家，号称美国文学之父。其代表作为《纽约外史》、《见闻札记》。Benjamin Franklin是一位优秀的科学家和杰出的社会活动家，参加了第二届大陆会议和《独立宣言》的起草工作。Mark Twain为美国著名作家和演说家，代表作品有《百万英镑》、《哈克贝利•费恩历险记》、《汤姆•索亚历险记》。Earnest Hemingway美国作家和记者，被认为是20世纪最著名的小说家之一，代表作《老人与海》、《乞力马扎罗的雪》、《永别了，武器》。

stem: 44．Uncle Tom s Cabin is written by a woman writer whose name is ______.
choices: Kate Chopin<sep>Emily Dickson<sep>Alice Brown<sep>Harriet Beecher Stowe
analysis: 【解析】Uncle Tom’s Cabin《汤姆叔叔的小屋》，是美国作家Harriet Beecher Stowe“哈里特•比彻•斯托”于1852年发表的一部反奴隶制小说。该部小说中非裔美国人与美国奴隶制度的观点曾产生深远影响，在某种程度上激化了美国内战的地区局部冲突。

stem: 45．The city of ______ is nicknamed Space City of USA .
choices: Los Angeles<sep>Houston<sep>Boston<sep>Honolulu
analysis: 【解析】Houston （休斯顿）是美国得克萨斯州的第一大城，全美国第四大城。休斯顿官方绰号为Space City“太空城”，因为它是约翰逊航空中心的所在地，任务监控中心也设在该地。

stem: Part Ⅱ Vocabulary, Grammar Culture (15 marks) There are 15 incomplete sentences in this part. For each blank there are four choices marked A, B, C and D. Choose the one that best completes the sentence. Then mark the corresponding letter on the answer sheet with a single line through the centre Section A Vocabulary Grammar (10 marks) 31. The story of their exploration is inextricably ______ the character of the caves themselves.
choices: bound to<sep>bound by<sep>bound up for<sep>bound up with
analysis: 【解析】句意：他们的探险故事都不可避免地与洞穴的特征相关。A项的bound to与B项的bound by都表示“束缚于…”，C项的bound up for表示“绑好用于”，D项的bound up with表示“与…密切相关”。探险故事应该是与洞穴特征相关，D项符合句意。

stem: 32. Senior students should be capable of acquiring and applying knowledge at varying levels of abstraction simultaneously as well as creating new concepts through ______ and invention.
choices: mixture<sep>connection<sep>synthesis<sep>merge
analysis: 【解析】句意：高年级学生应该能够同时在多层次的抽象概念上获取和应用知识，而且要通过综合和创新来创造新概念。mixture表示“混合；混合物”。connection表示“连接；联系”。synthesis表示“综合；合成”。merge表示“合并；使合并”，用作动词。空格处填入的词应该与invention并列，invention表示“发明；创造”，用作名词。根据句意可推断，此处表示“词语的合成和发明”，应用synthesis来表示。

stem: 33. Mr. Suthep launched his crusade three months ago, at the time of the government s cack-handed attempt to force through a bill ______ Mr. Thaksin amnesty for convictions for corruption and abuse of power.
choices: protecting<sep>granting<sep>devoting<sep>abandoning
analysis: 【解析】句意：Suthep先生三个月前发起了改革。当时，愚蠢的政府正试图强行通过一项法案，准许Thaksin特赦因贪污和滥用权力而定罪的人。grant同意，准予。protect保护。devote致力于。abandon放弃；屈服。

stem: 34. Conrad himself says ______ he is unexceptional mentally, but he has compared his earliest memories with others and has found ______ he can recall things ______ many people can t.
choices: . /; that; what<sep>that; what; what<sep>what; that; /<sep>that; that; that
analysis: 【解析】句意：Conard说他心智上跟普通人一样，但是把他的早期记忆与他人相比，他发现他能够回忆出很多其他人不记得的事情。第一个空和第二空后是由that引导的宾语从句，其中that通常可以省略。第三空后是定语从句，先行词为things，关系代词可用that或which，其中，关系代词作宾语，可省略。需要注意，句末can’t后其实省略了recall。

stem: 35. China boasts thousands of charming little communities rich in heritage but none ______ as many museums as Anren, ______has a small population with many museums being planned.
choices: has; which<sep>has; where<sep>has had; which<sep>have; where
analysis: 【解析】句意：中国自夸有很多有着丰富遗产的迷人小型社区，但是没有一个像安仁县一样，人口很少，却计划筹建很多博物馆。but none意为“没有任何一个”，该处应为单数，结合题干现在时，排除选项C、D。第二空后是定语从句，通过分析句子结构可知这里应用关系代词that或which作主语，故选A。

stem: 36. No sooner ______ his term, this month, ______ found himself accused of corruption by Mr. Obama s Justice Department.
choices: had he ended; than he<sep>he ended; he than<sep>had he ended; he than<sep>he ended; than he
analysis: 【解析】句意：这个月他的任期一结束，奥巴马的司法部就起诉他犯了贪污罪。句型no sonner+倒装+than+句子，意思为“一……就”，且主句应用完成时态，因此A项正确。

stem: 37. From this detachment arises also his sense of freedom, his love of ______ and his pride and nonchalance.
choices: betrayal<sep>vagabondage<sep>mutiny<sep>arrogance
analysis: 【解析】句意：这份超然同时唤起了他的自由感，他对流浪的热爱，以及他的自豪和淡然。vagabondage流浪；流浪者；流浪生活。betrayal背叛；辜负。mutiny兵变；暴动。arrogance自大；傲慢。B项符合句意。

stem: 38. In many civil-forfeiture cases the agencies that seize the assets ______, and can use them to pay their budgets or buy faster patrol cars.
choices: hold the greatest power<sep>check their takings<sep>keep most of the proceeds<sep>make investment proposals
analysis: 【解析】句意：在很多民事财产没收的案件里，管理该财产的代理方保留了大部分收益并可以使用这些收益支付他们的预算以及购置速度更快的巡逻车。keep most of the proceeds 保留大部分收益。hold the greatest power拥有最大的权力。check their takings检查他们的收入。make investment proposals做出投资建议。C项符合句意。

I ll bring it tomorrow.
choices: Thank you for your care<sep>That s good<sep>It makes me disgusting<sep>It sounds quite frightening
analysis: 【解析】对话发生在医生和受检查者之间。由题干内容得知，该空上文医生要检查血压，并告知检查者血压很正常。该空后，医生继续检查。A项为对医生服务表示感谢，应发生在全部检查结束后。C项，意为“它让我恶心”。D项，意为“听起来很可怕”。A、C、D均不符合题意，B项符合。

Fire Service: Is he in the house? What s your address? Mary: The Schoolhouse, Millbrook. Fire Service: OK. Where are you calling from? Mary: My neighbor s. The number is 90890009. Fire Service: Get it. Now stay away from the house and we ll be there soon.
choices: I m sorry to hear that<sep>I ll put you through<sep>I m glad you called<sep>I ll take a message
analysis: 【解析】对话发生在火宅报警者、接线员及消防署之间。该空之前的内容为接线员询问报警者需要哪种紧急情况的服务。该空之后，对话转向了消防署。可得知，该空是接线员转接了电话。put through接通；完成；把……接通。B项符合情境。

stem: Section B Culture (5 marks) 41. The Hemingway Code heroes are best remembered for their ______ .
choices: indestructible spirit<sep>optimistic view of life<sep>war experiences<sep>masculinity
analysis: 【解析】海明威作品中的硬汉形象最突出的特点是其不可被磨灭的强大精神力量。海明威定义其为“a man who lives correctly, following the ideals of honor, courage and endurance in a world that is sometimes chaotic, often stressful, and always painful.”。故A项最为贴切。

stem: 42. Which of the following books is written by Mark Twain?
choices: The House of the Seven Gables<sep>Oliver Twist<sep>Pride and Prejudice<sep>The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
analysis: 【解析】The Adventures of Tom Sawyer《汤姆·索亚历险记》是马克·吐温1876年的作品。The House of the Seven Gables《七个尖角阁的房子》是纳撒尼尔·霍桑（Nathaniel Hawthorne）的作品。Oliver Twist《雾都孤儿》是查尔斯·狄更斯（Charles Dickens）的作品。Pride and Prejudice《傲慢与偏见》是简·奥斯汀（Jane Austen）的作品。

stem: 43. The Victorian Age was largely an age of ______, eminently represented by Dickens and Thackeray.

analysis: 【解析】The Victorian Age维多利亚时代（1832～1901）是英国发展史上迅猛上升的时期。该时期小说迅猛发展。题干中的狄更斯和萨克雷皆为该时期著名小说家，其代表作分别为《雾都孤儿》和《名利场》。

stem: 44. In 1794, the US government and the ______ government signed Jay Treaty.
choices: British<sep>French<sep>Spanish<sep>Russian
analysis: 【解析】Jay Treaty杰伊条约，是1794年美英签署的友好、通商与航海条约，因美方代表，美国首席大法官约翰·杰伊得名。

stem: 45. India used to be a colony of ______.
choices: Canada<sep>the US<sep>England<sep>Japan
analysis: 【解析】印度于1757年沦为英国殖民地。1947年印巴分治，印度独立。

stem: Part Ⅱ Vocabulary, Grammar Culture (15 marks) There are 15 incomplete sentences in this section. For each blank there are four choices marked A, B, C and D. analysis: 【解析】句意：“永结同心”是英语中的一个习语，意为：结婚。解析：idiom习语。dialect方言。proverb谚语；格言。epigram警句。tie the knot原意“打结”，引申为“永结同心，结婚”，是常用习语。故选B。

stem: 32. We have to acknowledge that, for some people, religious identity is such an important part of their lives that it may ______ everything else.
choices: outdo<sep>exceed<sep>excel<sep>transcend

stem: 33. More and more people are signing up for yoga classes nowadays, ______advantage of the health and relaxation benefits.

stem: 34. It seems that most of us want more holidays than we actually get, ______ a small number of workaholics who do not take all the days off they are ______ to.

stem: 35. Michael wrote numbers of wonderful tales that ______ a bit like folktales, but they are self-assured, vital, and unforgettable.
choices: appeal<sep>visualize<sep>read<sep>listen

stem: 36. The novel Pride and Prejudice is now ______ in a shorter form, with the language ______ to a vocabulary limit of 2,500 words.

stem: 33. Do you suppose we should accept the businessman s help? Yes, we should, for we______ such bad luck up till now, and time______ out.

Buildings are left to decay ______ vandals and the weather.

analysis: 【解析】句意：这些建筑任由破坏者损坏、任由天气侵蚀。at the mercy of任…摆布，在…前毫无办法。for the purpose of为了；因…起见；借以。in regard to关于。in proportion to相对于某事物来说；与某事物成比例。

stem: 32. Well done, Cassandra. Crook said. She blushed, but accepted the ______ with good grace.
choices: compartment<sep>compliment<sep>competence<sep>complacence
analysis: 【解析】句意：她脸红了，但还是优雅地接受了赞美。compliment恭维；敬意。compartment隔间（尤指火车车厢中的）；区划。competence能力；技能。complacence自满，沾沾自喜。

stem: 33. A referendum in Egypt on a new constitution was ______ by 98% of those who voted in a turnout of 38% of those eligible.
choices: endorsed<sep>ensured<sep>allowed<sep>alleged
analysis: 【解析】句意：埃及有关新宪法的公投获得了98%的投票支持，本次符合投票资格的民众投票率达到38%。 endorse开证明文件；支持。ensure确保；担保获得。allow允许；承认。allege断言，宣称。

stem: 34. In a television interview with a local station ______ Sunday, the government official said the protests, which ______ more than three weeks, have gone out of control even for the people who started it, for people who planned it, for people who scripted it .
choices: that aired; have been lasted<sep>which airing; have been lasted<sep>that aired; have lasted<sep>which airing; have lasted
analysis: 【解析】句意：地方电视台周日播出的电视访谈中，政府官员提到，此次抗议已经持续了三个星期,第一个空在定语从句中作“电视访谈”的谓语，根据下句政府官员谈话的动词时态(said)可知，此处应用一般过去时。第二个空定语从句谓语last作“持续”讲时为不及物动词，因此此处不用被动语态。

stem: 35. He is only one of the students in our class who ______ the first prize of the National English Competition for College Students.
choices: has won<sep>have won<sep>has combated<sep>have combated
analysis: 【解析】句意：他只是我们班上曾经获得全国大学生英语竞赛一等奖的学生之一。此句only前没有the，那么定语从句的先行词为students，所以谓语动词用复数。“获得一等奖”用的动词搭配是win the first prize。combat与…战斗；与…斗争。

stem: 36. ______ in his office afterwards, Mr. Brown allowed himself to veer further off base, ______ Wittgenstein, Matthew Arnold and Buddhism as he ______ his government philosophy.
choices: Interviewing; citing; explained<sep>Interviewed; cited; explaining<sep>Interviewed; cited; explaining<sep>Interviewed; citing; explained
analysis: 【解析】句意：之后在他的办公室接受的采访，布朗先生自己却突然不走常规，引用维特根斯坦、马修·阿诺德和佛教的理念来解释他的政治哲学。第一个空应用过去分词形式，表示被动。第二个空应用现在分词形式，表示伴随。第三个空前面的as作连词，表示“当……时”，后面加完整句子，所以该处填一般过去时，作he的谓语。

stem: 37. In contrast to the muted colors of Elizabeth s wardrobe, Andrew preferred clothes that were ______.
choices: elegant<sep>outlandish<sep>extravagant<sep>flamboyant
analysis: 【解析】句意：与伊利莎白颜色暗淡的衣服相反，安德鲁更喜欢艳丽的服装。flamboyant艳丽的；火焰似的。elegant（人或其举止）优美的；漂亮的。outlandish古怪的；奇异的。extravagant过度的，过分的。

stem: 38. The official kiln in ancient China gathered the most skilled ______ and used a strict manufacturing process, ______ represented the highest level of porcelain making at that time.
choices: craftsmen; which<sep>bricklayers; who<sep>craftsmen; who<sep>bricklayers; which
analysis: 【解析】句意：中国古代官窑聚集了最有技术的工匠，其严格的制造工艺，代表了当时制瓷的最高水平。craftsman工匠；手艺人。bricklayer砖匠。第二个空定语从句的先行词为“制造工艺”，所以关系代词应用which。

stem: 39. Monica: Morning. Mark: Not a very nice one, is it? Monica: ______ Mark: Rain again. Monica: The forecast s good though. Mark: Is it? Monica: Yes. It s supposed to be sunny for the rest of the week. Mark: That s good. I m sick of rain. Monica: So am I.
choices: No, how can we handle this?<sep>Yes, it is not so bad.<sep>No, what miserable weather!<sep>Yes, it makes me annoyed.
analysis: 【解析】横线下一句回答“又下雨了”(Rain again)，对话最后两人表示都不喜欢雨(—I’m sick of rain. —So am I.)，证明该空应该填对天气的抱怨，因此选择C项“是啊，天气真糟糕！”。

stem: 40. Assistant: Hello. Can I help you? Lucy: Yes, I hope so. I want to return this dress. Assistant: Oh. Is there something wrong with it? Lucy: The first time I washed it, the color ran and it shrank. Assistant: Did you follow the washing instructions? Lucy: Yes, of course I did. Assistant: Do you have your receipt? Lucy: Yes. Here it is. ______ Assistant: That s OK. Do you want to exchange it or...
choices: I ll call the service desk.<sep>I bought it in your Oxford branch last week.<sep>I want to exchange this for a new one.<sep>I need you to give me a refund.
analysis: 【解析】销售员向Lucy索要收据，她提供收据并告知她的具体购物地点“我上周在你家牛津分店买的”，因此选择B项。下句销售员回答说“好的”，所以没必要给服务台打电话，所以不选A项。因为下句销售员才问她处理方法“是想更换还是……”，所以不选C、D。

stem: Section B Culture (5 marks) 41. It is Christopher Marlowe who brought vitality and grandeur into the ______ with his mighty lines , which carry strong emotions.
choices: blank verse<sep>free verse<sep>ragged verse<sep>calming verse
analysis: 【解析】克里斯托弗·马洛(Christopher Marlowe)，英国诗人，剧作家。马洛革新了中世纪的戏剧，在舞台上创造了反映时代精神的巨人性格和“雄伟的诗行”(mighty lines )，他也是首位英国作家充分发挥了无韵诗(blank verse)的潜能。

stem: 42. The First Continental Congress was held in ______ in September 1774.
choices: Chicago<sep>Boston<sep>New York<sep>Philadelphia
analysis: 【解析】1774年9月5日，北美殖民地在费城 (Philadelphia)召开了殖民地联合会议，史称“第一届大陆会议”（The First Continental Congress）。

stem: 43. The first thirteen states of the US are mainly located on the ______ seaboard.
choices: eastern<sep>western<sep>northeastern<sep>southeastern
analysis: 【解析】从1607年到1733年，英国殖民者先后在北美洲东岸（大西洋沿岸）建立了十三个殖民地。后来，这些殖民地便成为美国独立最初的十三个州。

stem: 44. Which is the oldest bridge in the world?
choices: The London Bridge.<sep>The Lu Ding Bridge.<sep>The Zhao Zhou Bridge.<sep>The Story Bridge.
analysis: 【解析】赵州桥又称安济桥，建于隋朝年间公元595年~605年，由著名匠师李春设计建造，距今已有约1500年的历史，是当今世界上现存最早、保存最完整的古代敞肩石拱桥。

stem: 45. Gulliver s Travels written by ______ is one of the most effective and devastating criticisms and satires of all aspects of the English and European life of the time.
choices: Daniel Defoe<sep>Jonathan Swift<sep>Alexander Pope<sep>John Bunyan
analysis: 【解析】《格列佛游记》(Gulliver’s Travels)是乔纳森·斯威夫特（Jonathan Swift）的一部杰出的游记体讽刺小说，以格列佛船长的口气叙述周游四国的经历。

stem: Part Ⅱ Vocabulary, Grammar Culture ( 15 marks) There are 15 incomplete sentences in this section. For each blank there are four choices marked A, B, C and D. Choose the one that best completes the sentence. Then mark the corresponding letter on the answer sheet with a single line through the centre. Section A Vocabulary Grammar ( 10 marks) 31. In my free time I wear ______ clothes jeans and a shirt, things like that.
choices: random<sep>casual<sep>convenient<sep>unprofessional
analysis: 【解析】句意：业余时间，我都穿休闲服装……casual非正式的；偶然的。random任意的；随机的。convenient方便的；适当的。unprofessional非专业化的，外行的。

stem: 32. Six out of ten women admit they regularly give ______ to temptation as the main reason for shopping on ______.
choices: up; instinct<sep>up; consciousness<sep>in; impulse<sep>in; response
analysis: 【解析】句意：十个女人中有六个都承认她们通常冲动购物的主要原因就是经不住诱惑。give in屈服；投降。give up放弃；把…让给。impulse凭冲动行事；突如其来的念头。instinct本能，天性。consciousness意识；观念。response反应；回答。

stem: 33. Individuals can and should make their own legal decisions ______ who their employer is.
choices: except for<sep>by virtue of<sep>in the light of<sep>regardless of
analysis: 【解析】句意：每个人，无论他的老板是谁，都可以也应该拥有其自己的合法意愿。regardless of不管，不顾。except for除…之外；若不是。by virtue of凭借…的力量；由于。in the light of鉴于；按照。

stem: 34. We go to Mt. Qomolangma not only with the personal goal of ______ the summit, but we also ______ a purpose higher than to simply stand on top of the world.
choices: conquering; strive for<sep>ascending; hope for<sep>overwhelming; carry out<sep>climbing; work out
analysis: 【解析】句意：我们攀登珠穆朗玛峰不仅要实现征服高山的个人目标，而且我们还要实现一个比仅仅站在世界之巅更伟大的计划。conquer征服；攻克。ascend继承；占领。overwhelm淹没；压倒。climb攀登，爬。strive for奋斗，争取。hope for希望，希望得到。carry out执行；进行。work out解决；作出。

stem: 35. When travelling, you are advised to take your credit card, which provides a secure ______ to carrying your money in cash.
choices: selection<sep>preference<sep>alternative<sep>replacement
analysis: 【解析】句意：旅游的时候，大家都会建议你带上信用卡，这也是随身携带现金的另一个安全的选择。alternative可供选择的事。selection选择；被选中者。preference偏爱；优先权。replacement代替；归还。A is an alternative to B表示“A是B的另一种选择”，其要与介词to搭配使用。

stem: 36. A minority language is often put ______, for it lives in the shadow of a culturally dominant language, for example, Irish in ______ of English.
choices: at risk; that<sep>at will; case<sep>at last; favor<sep>at ease; spite
analysis: 【解析】句意：少数民族的语言往往是处于危险之中，因为其活在文化主导语言的阴影下，比如说，爱尔兰语对于英语即是如此。at risk有危险。at will任意，随意。at last终于，最终。at ease安逸，自由自在。第二个空为that作代词，代替前面提到的名词，以避免重复。此句代替的是上句的shadow。

stem: 37. ______ the geography class, Mandy went to the teacher and asked for the assignment.
choices: Having been missed<sep>Being missed<sep>Having missed<sep>Missing
analysis: 【解析】句意：错过了地理课，Mandy去找老师要作业。根据主句谓语动词的时态，前面非谓语应用表示过去含义的形式，并且Mandy错过地理课是主动发出的动作，综上所述，应选择C项。

stem: 38. If you want a shop to keep something for you until later, you may have to ______.
choices: request a discount<sep>give a refund<sep>open an account<sep>pay a deposit
analysis: 【解析】句意：如果你想要一个店为你保留一会儿某件商品，你可能需要支付押金。pay a deposit支付押金。request a discount要求打折。give a refund退款。open an account开户。

stem: 39. They are building a new entertainment complex at the end of the road. Have you only just heard of it? I ve known it for ages. In fact, I m sure I told you about it last week. ______ But I ve been forgetting things lately. My memory is failing.
choices: It s only your imagination.<sep>You probably did.<sep>You can say that again.<sep>How annoying!
analysis: 【解析】横线后面用转折的证据说自己最近记忆力较差，证明很有可能对方曾经说过这个消息，因此选择B项。

stem: 40. Could you please write down the prescription for me? ______
choices: No. You need to see a doctor first.<sep>Yes. You can buy the medicine from any drugstore.<sep>Certainly. I ll do it for you right away.<sep>Well. Prevention is better than cure.
analysis: 【解析】句意：—你能给我开张处方吗？—当然。我马上给你开。只凭选项含义比较，A项似乎也合理。但该回答方式不礼貌，即使是拒绝也应该回答I’m sorry。

stem: Section B Culture (5 marks) 41. Chinese poetry and philosophy have exerted great influence on ______.
choices: Ezra Pound<sep>Ralph Waldo Emerson<sep>Robert Frost<sep>Emily Dickinson
analysis: 【解析】埃兹拉•庞德（Ezra Pound），美国著名诗人，意象派的代表人物。他和艾略特同为后期象征主义诗歌的领军人物。他从中国古典诗歌、日本俳句中生发出“诗歌意象”的理论，为东西方诗歌的互相借鉴做出了卓越贡献。

stem: 42. Which degree is offered in community colleges in the United States?
choices: Master s degree.<sep>Doctor s degree.<sep>Bachelor s degree.<sep>Associate s degree.
analysis: 【解析】associate’s degree副学士，副学士学位。通常是社区学院(community colleges)或两年制专科学校颁发给毕业生的文凭。

stem: 43. Which of the following is James Joyce s work?
choices: A Tale of Two Cities.<sep>Vanity Fair.<sep>Ulysses.<sep>Jude the Obscure.
analysis: 【解析】詹姆斯•乔伊斯(James Joyce, 1882-1941)，爱尔兰作家、诗人，二十世纪最伟大的作家之一，后现代文学的奠基者之一，其作品及“意识流”思想对世界文坛影响巨大。其代表作长篇小说《尤利西斯》(Ulysses)(1922)表现现代社会中人的孤独与悲观。

stem: 44. The most famous Arts Festival is the ______ International Festival of Music and Drama. It takes place for a period of 3 to 4 weeks between August and September.
choices: Belfast<sep>Edinburgh<sep>Liverpool<sep>Cardiff
analysis: 【解析】爱丁堡国际音乐戏剧节 (Edinburgh International Festival of Music and Drama)，每年8月最后两周和9月第一周举行。

stem: 45. The word holiday originally meant holy day , but now it signifies any day on which we don t have to work. This is an example of ______.
choices: meaning shift<sep>widening of meaning<sep>narrowing of meaning<sep>loss of meaning
analysis: 【解析】该词的含义原指特别的宗教日子，例如主日(星期日，也叫礼拜日)、复活节及圣诞节等，现可以指各种无需工作的日子，所以词意范围扩大，因此选择B项。

stem: Part II Vocabulary, Grammar Culture (15 marks) There are 15 incomplete sentences in this section. For each blank there are four choices marked A, B, C and D. Choose the one that best completes the sentence. Then mark the corresponding letter on the answer sheet with a single line through the centre. Section A Vocabulary and Grammar (10 marks) 31. Animals are one of the most important resources for human beings, however, by 2030, many species will have ______ according to recent research.
choices: used up<sep>died out<sep>gone up<sep>got rid of
analysis: 【解析】句意：动物是人类最重要的资源之一，然而，最近的研究显示，到2030年许多物种都会灭绝。use up用尽，耗尽。die out（物种、家族、观念等）绝迹，绝种。go up上涨；晋级。get rid of 除去；去掉。B项die out符合题意。

stem: 32.If the government refused to appropriate funds, the slum-clearance programme might be ______.
choices: rejected<sep>contended<sep>abused<sep>terminated
analysis: 【解析】句意：如果政府拒绝拨款，贫民窟清扫计划将会终结。reject拒绝；否决。contend争夺；斗争。abuse滥用；虐待。terminate结束；使终结。本题应选D项。

stem: 33.We are in the full ______ that the current situation will improve sooner or later.
choices: understanding<sep>appreciation<sep>consciousness<sep>conviction
analysis: 【解析】句意：我们确信目前的状况迟早会得到改善。understanding理解；谅解。appreciation欣赏；鉴赏。consciousness意识；观念。conviction 确信；信念；定罪。四个选项中D项最符合语境。

stem: 34.The reporters exposed the corruption of several high officials in the government; ______, they were asked to resign from office.
choices: constantly<sep>consistently<sep>consequently<sep>consecutively
analysis: 【解析】句意：记者们揭露了几个政府高官的腐败情况，结果，他们都被辞退了。constantly不断地；时常地。consistently一贯地；坚持地。consequently所以；结果。consecutively连续地。句中“被辞退”是由于“揭露腐败”而引起的，因此，本题应选C项。

stem: 35. Helping his little daughter with her physics homework reminded him of things he had long ______.
choices: cared about<sep>forgotten about<sep>dreamed about<sep>complained about
analysis: 【解析】句意：帮他的小女儿讲解物理家庭作业让他想起了忘记很久的东西。care about关心；在乎。forget about忘记。dream about梦见；梦到。complain about抱怨；投诉。由“帮他的小女儿讲解物理家庭作业”可知，B项符合本题的逻辑。

stem: 36. You should never provide your personal information ______ a request you did not ask for over the Internet.
choices: in response to<sep>according to<sep>prior to<sep>thanks to
analysis: 【解析】句意：在网上，你永远不能在回应你没有提起的请求时提供个人信息。in response to对……做出反应。according to 根据……。prior to在……之前。thanks to 幸亏……。由空格后面的“request（请求）”可知本题应选A项。

stem: 37. The new chairman urged the members of the committee to ______ their differences and settle down to work.
choices: wear out<sep>break up<sep>calm down<sep>set aside
analysis: 【解析】句意：新任主席敦促委员会的成员们搁置分歧，开始工作。wear out用坏；穿破。break up结束；（使）破碎。calm down（使）平静；镇静。set aside置……于不顾；把……放置一旁。四个选项中。D项“set aside”最符合语境。

stem: 38. Why so many students graduate from high school with inadequate skills in reading and mathematics is a question that continues to ______ American educators.
choices: harass<sep>intimidate<sep>trouble<sep>oppress
analysis: 【解析】句意：为什么如此多的高中毕业生不具备足够的阅读和数学技能这一问题继续困扰着美国教育者。harass骚扰；烦扰。intimidate恐吓威胁。trouble麻烦；使烦恼。oppress使意气消沉，使气馁。B项“intimidate”和D项“oppress”明显不符合语境。A项“harass”语意侧重在“骚扰”。故本题应选C项。

stem: 39. I need some help with my homework! ______ I ve got lots of work to do myself, and besides, it s your problem, not mine!
choices: No problem, just a moment!<sep>Sorry, I can t help you right now.<sep>Yes, I need your help as well.<sep>Wait, it s a piece of cake for me.
analysis: 【解析】句意：—我需要人帮我指导家庭作业。—对不起，我现在帮不了你。我自己也有很多作业，而且那是你的问题，不是我的。根据空格后面的内容可知空格处应填入否定式回答。故只有B项符合题意。

stem: 40. I spilled some coffee on my jacket! ______ You ll see a place on Madison Avenue between the First Street and the Second Street. It s beside the bank.
choices: How can you get it ironed?<sep>Do you know the way to the factory?<sep>Who is to blame for the accident?<sep>Where can I get it cleaned?
analysis: 【解析】句意：—我把咖啡洒在外套上了，该去哪里清洗呢？—去一街和二街之间的麦迪逊大道，银行旁边的一个地方。由回答可知，回话人主要告知了问话人地点信息，因此空格处应填入询问地点的问题。本题应选D项。

stem: Section B Culture (5 marks) 41. ______ felt that society forced too many rules on people and kept them from living a full, natural life. His forceful writing on daring themes shocked many. Sons and Lovers, based partly on his own life, is one of his finest novels.
choices: James Joyce<sep>D.H.Lawrence<sep>George Bernard Shaw<sep>Thomas Hardy
analysis: 【解析】D.H.劳伦斯是20世纪英语文学中最重要的人物之一，也是最具争议性的作家之一。他在作品中力求探索人的灵魂深处，对情感和性爱的描绘显得非常直白，毫不隐讳，这震惊了他生活的社会。劳伦斯的主要代表作包括《虹》（The Rainbow）、《儿子与情人》（Sons and Lovers）、《恋爱中的女人》（Women in Love）、《查特莱夫人的情人》（Lady Chatterley's Lover）等。

stem: 42. Which of the following is the national flag of the United States of America?
choices: <sep><sep><sep>

stem: 32. Generally, British independent schools provide a broader curriculum than _____ required by law.

stem: 33. They felt such heat in the jungle _____ they had never felt before in other places in their life.

stem: 34. The US government has the right to regulate _____ to animals cock fighting, bear and bull baiting, and dog fighting were all outlawed in the 19th century.

stem: 35. South Korea s largest mobile phone operator is to offer users a new service that it says will repel mosquitoes and subscribers can download a sound wave that is _____ to human ears but annoys mosquitoes within a range of about a metre.

stem: 36. President Xi Jinping will today become the first Chinese leader to _____ the annual World Economic Forum in the Swiss resort of Davos.

stem: 37. DINK is an _____ for couples with dual income and no children and thus DINKs always have more disposable income than the average family.

stem: 38. A three-year search for the missing Malaysia Airline s flight MH370 has been called off, _____ one of the great aviation _____ mysteries.

stem: 39. The objectives of the Pearl Harbor Incident were the total destruction of the Axis powers and the establishment of a world order after unconditional victory _____ American ideals and interest.

stem: 40. Researchers say pizza-eaters are less _____ certain cancers according to a study showing that those who ate at least one pizza a week were 59% less likely to contract cancer of the oesophagus, and they _____ tomato sauce.

stem: 41. In the late 15th century, Christopher Columbus, an Italian navigator, sailed across the vast ocean and reached some small islands in the West Indies, but he thought he _____ Asia and didn t know he _____ a new continent.

analysis: 【解析】句意：十五世纪末，意大利航海家克里斯托弗·哥伦布（Christopher Columbus）横渡辽阔的海洋，到达了西印度群岛。但他认为自己到了亚洲而不知道他已经发现了一个新的大陆。过去完成时表示在过去某一时间或动作之前已经发生或完成的动作。哥伦布到达西印度群岛和认为自己发现了新大陆均在谓语动作之前，因此用过去完成时。D项正确。

stem: 42. I m sorry but you need find another parking space, because if any vehicle _____ on these premises, it shall be towed away.

analysis: 【解析】句意：很抱歉你必须另找一个地方停车，因为如果发现任何车辆停在这里，车辆将会被拖走。本题考查的是if虚拟语气的用法。本题中的虚拟部分与将来事实相反，主句谓语动词应该是“＋动词原形”的形式，而车又是被发现停在那里，因此应该用被动形式，省略了“should/ would/ could/ might”。因此B选项正确。

stem: 43. I can t open this email attachment our Paris office has sent me. Are you sure you re using the right program? Well, yes, it s definitely the same program but I might have the wrong version. Their system is newer than ours. That s why you can t open it. _____

stem: 44. We ve managed to reduce the energy consumption in our factory by about 15 percent in the last two years. That s excellent. How have you managed that? stem: 45. Good evening, Mrs. Adams. I m sorry to barge in on you like this but I d like a word with you about your son, Brian. _____ We ve only just sat down to dinner. I can t help that. stem: 33. _____ that India s annual harvest takes 13.5 million tons of nutrients from the soil.

stem: 34. The workers protested when the board of directors announced that above two-fifths of the employees would be _____.

stem: 36. The vocabulary of any technical discussion may include words which are never used outside-the-subject or field _____.

stem: 39. Ms. Merkel listened carefully _____ she might discover exactly what the little boy wanted.

stem: 31. The expedition has left for the Andes and there is no _____ when it will return.

analysis: 句意：探险队已经出发前往安第斯山脉，不知道什么时候会回来。knowing 认知；知道。reflecting 反思。timing 时间安排。 accounting会计，会计学；账单。advising 建议；劝告。There is + no + doing something是英语中的固定搭配，表示“说不上，很难说”。其中的 动词（do）多为“转述”或“认知”等意义的动词，如tell、say、know等，其后 一般跟疑问副词引导的从句，如when, what等。正确答案为C。

stem: 32. Will you _____ my article to find out whether I ve made any mistakes?
choices: look after<sep>look through<sep>look up<sep>look at<sep>look on
analysis: 句意：能请你通读一下我的文章，看看我有没有犯错吗？look through 逐一查看；阅读。look after照顾；照管。look up查阅；（久别后）拜访。look at看；考虑；着眼于。look on观看，旁观；看待。根据句意可知，正确答案为B。

stem: 33. Once a picture is proved to be a forgery, it becomes quite _____.
choices: inexpensive<sep>invaluable<sep>priceless<sep>unworthy<sep>worthless
analysis: 句意：一旦某张画被证明是赝品，它就一文不值了。worthless无价值的；一无是处的。 inexpensive便宜的。 invaluable 非常宝贵的。priceless 无价的；宝贵的。unworthy不值得的；配不上的。结合句意，正确答案为E。

stem: 34. _____ the potential of new technology and the accompanying advances in science, it is possible to foresee a world in which a relatively stable human population can live at a high level of material affluence.
choices: In accordance with<sep>With regard to<sep>In case of<sep>As a result of<sep>For the sake of
analysis: 句意：鉴于新技术的潜力和随之而来的科学进步，我们有可能预见 到一个世界，在那里人口相对稳定，人们拥有高度的物质财富。with regard to考虑到；就……而言。 as a result of 因此，由于；作为……的结果。in accordance with 依照；与……一致。in case of万一；如果发生；假设。for the sake of为了；为了……的利益。故正确答案为B。

stem: 35. I don t think it s sensible of you to _____ your knowledge in front of the chairwoman, for it may well offend her.
choices: show around<sep>show up<sep>show off<sep>show out<sep>show away

stem: 36. _____ you promise you will work hard, _____ support you to study abroad.
choices: If; will I<sep>Only; I will<sep>If only; will I<sep>Only if; will I<sep>Only if; I will
analysis: 句意：只有你保证你会努力学习，我才会支持你出国留学。if only 但愿，希望。only if只要……就；只有。only if条件句位于句首，主句谓语用部分倒装，if引导的从句的谓语无需倒装，故排除A。正确答案为D。

stem: 37. _____ is often the case with a new idea, much preliminary activity and optimistic discussion produced no concrete proposals.
choices: Which<sep>So<sep>It<sep>This<sep>As
analysis: 句意：一个新想法诞生之初往往是这样，许多初步活动及乐观讨论不会产生什么具体的建议。as is often the case固定搭配，意为“这是常有的事”。故选E。

stem: 38. All of the international delegates attending the conference _____ to bring a souvenir from their own countries.
choices: are asking<sep>were asking<sep>were asked<sep>have asked<sep>has been asked
analysis: 句意：（会议）要求所有参会的国际代表都要带来本国的纪念品。这 里的delegates和ask是被动关系，应该用被动语态，又因为delegates是复数形式，所以C选项正确。

stem: 39. People in business _____ hire artists for that kind of work say that simple artistic ability is not enough.
choices: which<sep>whom<sep>who<sep>whose<sep>why
analysis: 句意：商业界雇用艺术家从事这类工作的人说，单纯的艺术能力是不够的。此处先行词指代的是前文的“people in business”，是指人，并且在定语从句中做主语。故正确答案为C。

stem: 40. So involved with their cell phones _____ that leaders at summer camps often have to force them to break for sports and games.
choices: became the children<sep>become the children<sep>had the children become<sep>do the children become<sep>children became
analysis: 句意：孩子们如此热衷于玩手机，以至于夏令营的领导们经常不得不强迫他们停下来，参加一些体育运动和游戏。本题着重考查倒装句的用法。由于so involved放在了句首，句子用倒装形式。因为句子的时态是一般现在时，所以要借助于助动词do 来构成倒装。把这句话变成正常语序是：The children become so involved with their cell phones that leaders at summer camps often have to force them to break for sports and games。故正确答案为D。

stem: 41. My son has an advantage over his mother _____ he can speak English.
choices: since that<sep>in that<sep>at that<sep>so that<sep>with that
analysis: 句意：我儿子比他母亲有一个优势，因为他会说英语。in that为固定搭配，意为“既然；因为”。与句意相符。since也有“既然，由于”的意思，但一般放于句首，而且也不与that连用。没有at that和with that的搭配。so that表示“以便于，因此”。结合句意，故正确答案为B。

stem: 42. _____ with the size of the whole earth, the highest mountain does not seem high at all.
choices: When compared<sep>While comparing<sep>To compare<sep>Being compared<sep>Comparing
analysis: 句意：若是与整个地球相比，最高的山也不算高了。考查状语从句的省略式，英语中如果主从句的主语一致，可以省略从句的主语和be动词。完整的句子应是When it is compared with the size of…，故A选项符合句意。

stem: 43. I heard you took a trip to Mexico. Yes, I did. How did you like it? Oh, I got sick and tired of hotels and hotel food. I can imagine. _____.
choices: I d like to go with you.<sep>You d better go to a beach.<sep>East or west, home is the best.<sep>Go to other parts of the country.<sep>They ll be better next time.
analysis: 句意：——我听说你去墨西哥旅行了。——是的，我去了。——你的旅行怎么样？——我身体有些不舒服，也厌倦了酒店和酒店的食物。——我明白的。不管东奔西跑，还是家最好。“East or west, home is the best.”是一句英语俗语，可以理解为中国的“金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝”或“在家千日好，出门一日难。”故正确答案为C。

stem: 44. Hi, Danny. _____ I wish I could, but I really have to stay in and finish my paper tonight. Oh, maybe some other time, then.?

stem: 45. 一Do you think I could borrow your car to go grocery shopping? The supermarkets outside the city are so much cheaper. I d also be happy to pick up anything you need. Well, I don t like to let anyone else drive my car. Tell you what, _____.

stem: 31. Mr. Taylor felt very _____ at the suggestion that he had stolen the car.

stem: 32. Business and government managers often promote clean desk policies to avoid disorganized offices and messy desks, _____ boosting work efficiency and productivity.

stem: 33. The tenant must be prepared to decorate the house _____ the terms of the contract.
choices: in accordance with<sep>in the vicinity of<sep>in quest of<sep>in collaboration with<sep>in command of

stem: 34. Students should know better not _____ pets like dogs, cats and mice at dormitory.

stem: 35. The investigation into the food safety incident over dairy products tainted with melamine is _____.

stem: 37. The number of stay-at-home fathers reached a record high last year, new figures show, as families saw an _____ in female breadwinners.

stem: 41. Mississippi also upholds the South s well-deserved reputation for warm, hospitable people, balmy year-round weather, and truly _____ cuisine.

stem: 40. Having never been to the United Kingdom before, Catherine was initially confused _____ the value of each coin.

stem: 41. Before I agree your suggestion, I d like to know what I m _____ myself in for.

stem: 42. Since they had stopped serving meals, we had to _____ ourselves with sandwiches and coffee.
choices: content<sep>appeal<sep>appreciate<sep>settle<sep>withdraw
analysis: 【解析】句意：因为他们不再供应食物，我们只好吃三明治和咖啡填饱肚子。content sth. with sth.是固定搭配，意为“满足；满意；知足”。appeal呼吁；申诉。appreciate欣赏；理解。settle解决（纠纷、问题等）。withdraw移开；拿走；撤退。结合句意，A选项符合句意。

stem: 43. _____ ended traffic on the Mississippi River, Mark Twain left his job as a river pilot and moved west to Carson City.
choices: As the Civil War was<sep>Because the Civil War was<sep>During the Civil War<sep>Now that the Civil War was<sep>When the Civil War

stem: 44. I d better go on a diet. What makes you think so? I think _____.
choices: you look pale<sep>you need to take a rest<sep>you should lose weight<sep>you re in good shape<sep>you must go to see a doctor
analysis: 【解析】句意：——我最好节食。——你为什么这么想？我觉得你身材很好。根据回答者第一句“what makes you think so”可推测，讲话人并不觉得对方需要节食，故正确答案为D。

stem: 45. I hear many people like French food. How about you? Not me. _____.
choices: As far as I m concerned, I don t eat much.<sep>As for me, I don t eat out at all.<sep>Considering my age, I shouldn t eat a lot.<sep>No matter what they say, I ll have soft drinks only.<sep>Speaking of food, I like Italian cuisine.
analysis: 【解析】句意：——我听说很多人喜欢法国菜。你呢？——不是我。说到食物，我喜欢意大利菜。根据对话可知，“speaking of food, I like Italian cuisine”选项最符合逻辑。故E为正确答案。

stem: 31. Don t put the _____ on me! I m not responsible _____ your financial problems.
choices: guilt; about<sep>blame; for<sep>excuse; into<sep>cause; of<sep>burden; to
analysis: 【解析】句意：别怪我!我不对你的财务问题负责。“put the blame on sb.”为固定搭配，意为“归咎于……”，“be responsible for sth.”表示“对……负责”。因此选择B选项。

stem: 32. He was supposed to meet me at ten o clock at the railway station, but he _____.
choices: wasn t<sep>doesn t<sep>wouldn t<sep>didn t<sep>supposed not
analysis: 【解析】句意：他本该十点钟到火车站来见我，但他没有来。“be supposed to do”表示“应该做某事”，事情发生在过去，后半句陈述事实，用一般过去时。“but he didn't meet me at ten o' clock at the railway station”，省略重复的部分后为“but he didn't”，因此选择D选项。

stem: 33. Did you like the new film? No, it didn t _____ my expectations.
choices: make up for<sep>fall short of<sep>live up to<sep>come up with<sep>go down with
analysis: 【解析】句意：——你喜欢这部新电影吗？——不喜欢，它没有达到我的期望。live up to expectation达到期望。make up for弥补，补偿（损失、不足等）。fall short of陷入短缺；未达到（目标）。come up with想出，提出（计划、想法等）。go down with染上（疾病）；被接受，被赞同。

stem: 34. Mr. Peters had been with us for ten years and _____ the firm made us all very sad.
choices: quitting<sep>his quitting<sep>being quit<sep>by quitting<sep>having quit
analysis: 【解析】句意：彼得斯先生在我们公司干了十年，他的离职使我们大家都很难过。and前后为两个完整的句子，横线处为后面句子的主语，指彼得先生的离职。因此选择B选项。

stem: 35. Do you know anything about paper-cut? Well, I ve seen it _____.
choices: being done<sep>to be done<sep>having done<sep>to have done<sep>doing
analysis: 【解析】句意：—你懂剪纸吗？—我曾经看到过（别人剪纸）。剪纸动作的主语是人，所以此处应该为被动语态，E选项错误。看到时剪纸动作正在进行，因此选择A选项。

stem: 36. You look different, Maria. Have you done something different to your hair? Oh yes. I _____ red.
choices: got it dyed<sep>got it to dye<sep>got it dye<sep>got dyed it<sep>got dyed
analysis: 【解析】句意：—玛利亚，你看起来不一样了。你做了头发了？—噢，是的。我把它染红了。“get sth. done”表示“完成某事”。

stem: 37. Has the weather cleared up in New York? No, it s _____ cold.
choices: so far<sep>hardly ever<sep>ever so<sep>too much<sep>too rather
analysis: 【解析】句意：—纽约的天气转晴了吗？—没有，天气（还是）非常冷。ever so极其，非常。so far到目前为止，迄今为止。hardly ever几乎不；几乎从来不。too much太多。too rather搭配错误。

stem: 38. Did Jane get angry at the remark on the Internet? _____ it. She was quite pleased.
choices: Longer for<sep>Far from<sep>Sooner than<sep>Rather than<sep>Instead of
analysis: 【解析】句意：—简对网上的那句话生气了吗？—并没有。她非常高兴。根据横线前后内容可知，横线处是对上一句的否定，A和C选项不符合句意。D和E选项都表示“不是……而是……”，填入横线中句子不完整。“far from it”表示“远非如此；并不是”。因此选择B选项。

stem: 39. Will Michael eventually be put on trial? Not _____ his old age and poor health.
choices: with respect to<sep>as for<sep>in view of<sep>apart for<sep>in spite of
analysis: 【解析】句意：—迈克最终会受审吗？—如果不考虑他年纪大了、身体不好（他会受审）。in view of鉴于；考虑到。“with respect to”和“as for”都表示“关于，至于”，与句意不符。“apart for”表示“除了”，“in spite of”表示“不管，不顾”，两者本身就含有否定含义，句中已有“not”，双重否定为肯定，不符合句意。因此选择C选项。

stem: 40. They don t have to have any riding experience _____, and we ll teach them how to ride.
choices: whatsoever<sep>wherever<sep>however<sep>whatever<sep>nonetheless
analysis: 【解析】句意：他们不需要任何骑行经验，我们会教他们怎么做。“whatsoever”和“whatever”都表示“无论什么”，但是whatever用于肯定句中作定语，且位于修饰的名词之前。whatsoever是whatever的强调形式，用来加强否定句的语气。B，C，E选项不符合句意。因此选择A选项。

stem: 41. We invited two hundred people to the reception. Had we known that only fifty would turn up, we _____ so much food.
choices: should not prepare<sep>would not prepare<sep>did not prepare<sep>would not have prepared<sep>had not prepared
analysis: 【解析】句意：我们邀请了两百人参加招待会。如果我们知道只有五十人会来，我们就不会准备这么多食物了。本句为虚拟语气，与过去事实相反，从句为“if＋主语＋had＋动词过去分词”，主句为“主语＋would＋have＋动词过去分词”，此句省略if，因此从句将助动词had提到句首，但是主句语序不变。因此选择D选项。

stem: 42. Suppose we _____ so hard. Do you think we would have passed the examination?
choices: don t study<sep>are studying<sep>will study<sep>haven t studied<sep>hadn t studied
analysis: 【解析】句意：如果我们没有这么努力地学习，你觉得我们会通过考试吗？本句为虚拟语气，suppose相当于if，对过去发生事情的虚拟，应该用过去完成时。因此E选项正确。

stem: 43. I had to stay up late to work last night. _____
choices: So I had.<sep>So had I.<sep>So I did.<sep>So did I.<sep>So you had.
analysis: 【解析】句意：—我昨晚必须熬夜工作。—我也是。在简短回答中表示“我也是；另外一个人也如此”时，用“so＋do＋主语”结构。上一句中时态为一般过去式，时态应该保持一致。因此选择D选项。

stem: 44. Concert Choice, thank you for waiting. May I Help you? Yes, I d like two tickets for the New York Philharmonic on May 18th. _____ The orchestra section? Just a minute. There re only a few seats left. They re on the side. Would those be OK?

stem: 35. If anybody here does not agree with me, they should _____ their own plans for improving the living conditions of these people.

stem: 36. Francis, _____ born in Kentucky, lived and practiced law in Missouri.

stem: 37. All the mountains are stunningly beautiful, and there are _____ valleys and the smell of peat from every cottage.

stem: 38. It is not so much the language _____ the cultural background that makes the article difficult to understand.

stem: 39. _____ for your help, we d never have been able to finish the project on time.

stem: 42. Language belongs to _____, to the flower-seller as much as to the professor.

stem: 43. Did you watch the 6 o clock programme on Channel 9 yesterday evening? I was about to watch it when someone came to see me. Yeah! It reported some major breakthrough in cancer research. _____

stem: 40. It is well known that knowledge is the ____ condition for expansion of mind.

stem: 41. If businessmen are taxed too much, they will no longer be motivated to work hard, with the result that incomes from taxation might actually ____.

stem: 42. As a way of ____ the mails while they were away, the Johnsons asked the cleaning lady to send little printed slips asking the senders to write again later.

stem: 43. Next we ll interview Miss Smith, I think. Smith? Did she fill in the form? She did fill in the form. Mm, well it seems ____, then.

stem: 44. Would you pass me the milk, please? Certainly, sir. ____. What about chocolate? Sorry, I m on a diet.

stem: 31. The police accused him _____ setting fire to the building but he firmly denied _____ in the area on the night of the fire.

analysis: 【解析】句意：警察指控他对建筑物纵火，但他坚决否认在当天出现在事发现场。accuse sb与of搭配，意为“控告，指控”。deny doing为固定搭配，意为“否定做过”，而由于纵火事件已发生，故使用完成时。故选C。

stem: 32. You should try to make some _____ of your differences so that you can work together without quarrels.

analysis: 【解析】句意：你应尝试调整你们的分歧，这样大家才能合作而不争吵。adjustment调整，调节。arrangement布置；整理。development发展；开发；发育。improvement改善；提高。movement运动；活动；运转。故选A。

stem: 33. The United Nations is trying to _____ the serious problems created by the energy crisis.

analysis: 【解析】句意：联合国正竭力处理由于能源危机所带来的问题。cope with对付，处理，应付。comply with遵守。come up with提出；想出。put up with忍受。submit to提交；服从。故选B。

stem: 34. The company s profits last year were worse than expected so they are certainly going to _____ some workers.

analysis: 【解析】句意：这家公司去年的利润低于预期，所以他们即将进行裁员。layoff解雇；休息；停止工作。care for照顾；喜欢。help out帮助……摆脱困难。put down镇压；记下；贬低。strike on突然袭击；突然想起。故选C。

stem: 35. When Catherine told me that she was going to ride the horse herself in the race I was _____ and for a while couldn t think of anything to say.

stem: 36. I can t give you an answer yet. I need _____ more time to consider my decision.

stem: 37. Simon still hasn t returned from the meeting. Really? I m sure he expected to be back _____.

stem: 38. To our surprise, _____ lessons were not so difficult as we thought.

stem: 39. Every citizen in this country has the right and freedom to live where they want to _____ the colour of their skin.

stem: 40. _____ as much as one-fourth of all timber harvested is not used.

stem: 41. Have you heard an English expression about dogs and tricks? Yeah, it is You can t teach an _____ dog _____ tricks.

stem: 42. The painter Jacob Lawrence frequently incorporated patterns into his compositions, making them more striking than they would _____ have been.

stem: 43. In 1908, the first international rugby match was _____ in Paris between France and England. Henri Rousseau painted the happy scene and The Football Players _____ a landscape with rich colours in the trees and background.
choices: held; arouses<sep>made; flows<sep>operated; owns<sep>played; features<sep>designed; aims
analysis: 【解析】句意：1908年，法国和英国在巴黎举行了第一场国际橄榄球比赛。Henri Rousseau描绘了这幅欢乐的画面，The Football Players（踢足球的人）这幅画专门描绘了这一场景，在树木和背景上运用了丰富的色彩。play a match比赛，竞技。hold a match也有举行比赛之意，但通常使用主动形式，不使用被动形式。make，operate，design均不与match搭配。feature特写；以...为特色。arouse引起；唤醒。flow淹没，溢过。own拥有；承认。aim目的在于；引导。故选D。

stem: 44. Come on! I forgot how to play this computer game. It s easy. Just follow the instructions. _____

stem: 45. You look so happy. What happened? I became a member of the drama club. _____

stem: 31. The pass _____ for the university entrance examination has risen significantly during the last few years.

stem: 32. My father tried to _____ his voice but my mother realized who it was at once.

stem: 33. Would you like to come to the ballet with me tonight? Oh yes, thank you. I would be _____ to go with you.

stem: 34. Linda s mum urges her to pack lots of warm clothes _____ it gets cold at night.

stem: 35. Cindy was reading funny stories that she had found in a book but it was Tim _____ was making everyone laugh.

stem: 37. What s wrong, Jimmy, why do you have _____ look on your face? Oh, nothing serious. It is just that I wish Paul _____ here.

stem: 42. Did you go to Andy s party last night? ____ hard all day, I was exhausted so I stayed at home.

stem: 37. When dealing with awkward people it is advisable to keep your temper well _____ hand.
choices: off<sep>in<sep>on<sep>by
analysis: 【解析】keep…in hand 掌握；支配；管理句意：与难相处的人打交道时，最好控制住自己的脾气。

stem: 38. Our professor should have attended the evening party last night; he _____ too much work to do.
choices: must have had<sep>had to have<sep>must have<sep>had had
analysis: 【解析】本题考察情态动词对过去发生过的事情的有把握地猜测。使用的结构为：must have done. 句意：我们的教授昨晚本应该参加晚会的;他要做的工作一定是太多了。

stem: 39. What do you think of his proposal that improvements _____ in the old type of vacuum cleaner?
choices: be made<sep>will be made<sep>would be made<sep>have made
analysis: 【解析】本题考察虚拟语气。proposal后的同位语从句应用虚拟语气：should+do的形式。被动语态中should be done将should省略后，选择A。句意：你对他关于改进老式吸尘器的建议有什么看法?

stem: 40. We didn t find the Thompsons _____ the lecture. No one had told them about _____ a lecture the following day.
choices: to attend; there to be<sep>attending; there being<sep>attended; there be<sep>to attend; there was
analysis: 【解析】find sb. doing意为发现某人正在做某事； about作为介词后面加名词性结构。将there be中的be变为非谓语being, 以名词性结构充当介词about的宾语。句意为：-我们没发现汤普森一家参加讲座。-没有人告诉他们第二天将有一个讲座。

stem: 41. A large fish was slowly swimming through the water, its tail _____ back and forth like the pendulum of a clock.
choices: swung<sep>swinging<sep>was swung<sep>would swing
analysis: 【解析】本题考察独立主格结构，逗号后没有任何连词，因此用独立主格结构。尾巴和摇晃是主动关系，因此用doing. 句意：一条大鱼在水里慢慢地游着，它的尾巴像钟摆一样前后摆动着。

stem: 42. It was the belief _____ Clive Haley could find his roots in Africa _____ made him decide to go to Gambia.
choices: which; that<sep>where; that<sep>how; which<sep>that; that
analysis: 【解析】第一个空是同位语从句的连接词that. 第二个空是强调句式的连词that。句意：恰恰是克莱夫哈雷可以在非洲找到他的“根”这一信念使他决定去冈比亚。

stem: 43. So that s the offer, Heather. The work is well within our range and abilities. There s a profit of a million pounds in it for us. It looks too good to miss. What do you think? I m not sure. It just doesn t feel right. What exactly doesn t feel right? A million pounds feels all right to me. I know the profit margin is high, but we re the best in the business. It s not the money. Call it gut feeling, whatever._____
choices: The money we can earn is quite limited.<sep>I think the market is gloomy.<sep>I m worried about the huge investment.<sep>I can t put my finger on it.
analysis: 【解析】根据对话中Call it gut feeling, whatever. 即：就叫它直觉吧。可以断定说话人自己也说不清为什么。故选D。I can’t put my finger on it. 我说不清楚。

stem: 44. How do you feel about the future of the Jaragua lizard, the world s smallest lizard? I feel optimistic because local people have formed conservation organisations in the Caribbean. And we find it in the park Isla Beata which has its remoteness and ruggedness. _____ Well, good luck in the future with your environmental campaigns.
choices: There are different species of lizards.<sep>Many people like to keep lizards as pets.<sep>The park provides natural protection for the lizard.<sep>The park is famous for the world s smallest lizard.
analysis: 【解析】根据对话中: I feel optimistic because local people have formed conservation organisations in the Caribbean. And we find it in the park Isla Beata which has its remoteness and ruggedness. 即：我感到乐观，因为当地人已经在加勒比海成立了保护组织。在贝阿塔岛公园找到了这种蜥蜴，这个公园既偏远又崎岖。可知这个公园为蜥蜴提供了自然保护。故选C。

stem: 45. George, I m sorry to be late. That s OK. We haven t ordered yet. So, what s new？ Nothing much. _____ That s why I had to rush to get here. How are things with you? Same as usual. Overworked, underpaid.
choices: The new job suits me well.<sep>I ve been promoted to sales manager.<sep>I ve been really busy this week.<sep>You re my guest today.
analysis: 【解析】根据对话中That’s why I had to rush to get here. 所以我才急着赶过来。选择C。I’ve been really busy this week. 我这周真的很忙。

stem: 31. A survey has found that three quarters of men quite enjoy their food shopping experience and are happy to _____ their way around the aisles searching out products.
choices: tour<sep>journey<sep>navigate<sep>voyage
analysis: 【解析】“navigate one's way”有“导航，指路，寻找”的意思。句子大意是“一项调查发现，四分之三的男性非常享受他们的美食购物体验，并乐于在过道里四处寻找产品。”

stem: 32. Business and government managers often promote clean desk policies to avoid disorganized offices and messy desks, _____ boosting work efficiency and productivity.
choices: for the purpose of<sep>by means of<sep>in view of<sep>on account of
analysis: 【解析】“for the purpose of” 意为“为了……目的”。“by means of ”意为“用，依靠”。“in view of”意为“鉴于；考虑到”。“on account of”意为“因为，由于”。根据句子大意，“为了提高工作效率和生产力，企业和政府管理人员经常推行“清洁办公桌”政策，以避免杂乱无章的办公室和凌乱的办公桌。”后半句表示实施政策的目的。选择“for the purpose of”最合适。

stem: 33. New research suggests gossip could actually lower _____ and help people overcome the frustration of seeing someone doing something wrong and getting away with it.
choices: mentality<sep>sentiment<sep>mood<sep>stress
analysis: 【解析】mentality n. 心态，想法；sentiment n. 态度，意见；mood n. 心境，情绪；stress n. 压力，紧张。根据空格前的“lower”在句子中做动词，意为“降低”，和“压力”搭配最合理。

stem: 34. _____ 2.6 million people starting diets on New Year s Day, the report says that by the end of the week 92 percent of dieters gave up, shunning exercise and gorging on comfort food.
choices: Instead<sep>Despite<sep>Although<sep>While
analysis: 【解析】根据大意，前半部分为让步状语，排除选项A。despite 后接短语或名词结构，不接句子。Although和while只可接句子，根据语法判断前半部分不构成一个完整句子，选B。

stem: 35. Experiments show that season of birth dramatically affects the speed _____ which the body clock ticks.
choices: at<sep>for<sep>on<sep>in
analysis: 【解析】“at”与“speed”搭配表示“速度”，句子大意为“实验表明，出生季节会显著影响生物钟活动的速度。”

stem: 36. Today scientists have a greater understanding of genetics and its rule in _____ organisms.
choices: live<sep>life<sep>living<sep>alive
analysis: 【解析】空格处需填一个形容词修饰“organism”，表示“活着的有机体”，其中只有“living”和“alive”有“活着的”的意思。但是“alive”只能置于名词后，“living”一般置于名词前，也可置于名词后。

stem: 37. The news commentator says that the argument the speaker has presented does not _____ water.
choices: have<sep>contain<sep>include<sep>hold
analysis: 【解析】“hold water” 意为 “合情合理，站得住脚，说得通”。句子大意为“新闻评论员说演讲者提出的论点站不住脚。“

stem: 38. A financial statement is a report or record _____ usually on a quarterly and annual basis which provides an individual s, an organization s, or a business s financial situation.
choices: composed<sep>compiled<sep>collected<sep>collocated
analysis: 【解析】compose vt. 组成，构成。compile vt. 收集；编辑，编制。常指根据搜集、整理的资料编辑成册。collect v. 收集，采集。collocate vi. 并置排列，配置。句子大意“财务报表通常是按季度和年度编制的报告或记录，提供个人、组织或企业的财务状况。

stem: 39. The Internet has been around for an almost equal amount of time as most forms of media, but only recently _____ a popular way of retrieving information.
choices: has it become<sep>it has become<sep>it becomes<sep>does it become
analysis: 【解析】only和副词在句首，应该用部分倒装。recently出现表示句子用现在完成时，其中“have、has”为助动词，放在主语前，构成部分倒装。

stem: 40. Children are often _____ sports at an early age. As they get older and start school they participate in sports as a way to make friends and be active.
choices: involved in<sep>exposed to<sep>indulged in<sep>related to
analysis: 【解析】involved in 涉及；包含；牵涉进…exposed to 接触；暴露于；indulge in 沉湎于，沉溺于；related to 与…有关。句子大意为“孩子们在很小的时候经常参加体育活动。随着年龄的增长，不步入学堂，参加体育运动可以是一种交友和保持积极生活的方式。

stem: 41. To have a knowledge-based economy and a scientifically _____ population, developing countries must invest in fundamental science and blue skies research.
choices: moderate<sep>obsolete<sep>literate<sep>desperate
analysis: 【解析】moderate adj.中等的, 适度的, 不很大的；obsolete adj. 老式的；废弃的；literate adj. 受过教育的；精通文学的；desperate adj.不顾一切的, 拼命的。句子大意为“为了有一个知识经济时代和科学素养的人口，发展中国家必须投资于基础科学和理论研究。”

stem: 42. New Zealanders colloquially refer to themselves as Kiwis , _____ the country s native bird.
choices: for<sep>by<sep>with<sep>after
analysis: 【解析】after表“以……命名”，句子大意为“新西兰人通常把自己称为“几维”，以该国本土的鸟命名。

stem: 43. Good leadership requires you to surround yourself with people of _____ perspectives who can disagree with you without fear of revenge.
choices: cynical<sep>diverse<sep>separate<sep>relevant
analysis: 【解析】cynical adj.愤世嫉俗的，冷嘲的；diverse adj.不同的，多种多样的；separate adj. 分开的，单独的； relevant adj. 相关的。句子大意为“好的领导能力应该表现在你周围的人都能有不同的观点，他们可以不赞同你，也无需担心被报复。

stem: 44. Hello, Doctor Green! We have two kids and really hope to _____ them to grow up as honest adults. Could you give us some advice? Certainly. It s always nice to know some parents value honesty a lot and hope to pass it on to their kids. My first tip is parents should set a good model.
choices: bring<sep>lift<sep>raise<sep>rise
analysis: 【解析】raise 提起; 举起; 竖起；增加; 提升；抚养; 饲养。抚育孩子成长，用“raise”。句子大意为：——你好，格林医生！我们有两个孩子，真的希望把他们培养成诚实的大人。你能给我们一些建议吗？——当然。知道一些父母非常重视诚实，并希望把诚实传给他们的孩子，这总是件好事。我的第一个建议是父母应该树立一个好榜样

stem: 45. Excuse me. Have you been waiting long? About ten minutes. Did you notice whether the No. 7 bus has gone by? _____. I m waiting for the No. 7 myself.
choices: Not while I ve been standing here<sep>The changes were not at all surprising<sep>Not many people have read the report<sep>Not that I care
analysis: 【解析】根据情境，上下文连接，A选项大意“我在这儿的时候，没有看到。”能承接上文意思。句子大意为：——打扰一下，你等了很久了吗？——我等了大约十分钟。——你有注意到7路公共汽车是否经过了吗？ ——________. 我自己也在等7号公交车。

stem: 31. The speaker said that he was not concerned _____ people s morals but _____ their education and health.
choices: about; to<sep>on; with<sep>for; for<sep>with; with
analysis: 【解析】句意：演讲者说他关心的不是人们的道德，而是他们的教育和健康。be concerned with 为固定搭配, 意为：关心。故选D。

stem: 32. He will make little progress in his studies _____ he has little knowledge of the language.
choices: even if<sep>in case<sep>since<sep>unless
analysis: 【解析】句意：他在学习上进步不大，因为他对这门语言知之甚少。since意为“因为”，引导原因状语从句。故选C。

stem: 33. I cannot understand how you _____ these depressing surroundings and the poor quality of the building.
choices: carry on with<sep>go on with<sep>come up with<sep>put up with
analysis: 【解析】句意为：我不明白你怎么能忍受这些令人沮丧的环境和劣质的建筑。put up with意为“忍受；容忍”。carry on with与go on with同义，意为 “继续”；come up with意为“提出；想出；赶上”。故选D。

stem: 34. It is one of the paradoxes of social intercourse that a _____ is much harder to respond to than an insult.
choices: consideration<sep>compliment<sep>complement<sep>condemnation
analysis: 【解析】句意：恭维比侮辱更难回应，这是社会交往的矛盾之一。 compliment意为“恭维；称赞”。consideration意为“考虑”；complement意为“补语”；condemnation意为“谴责，定罪”。deny否认。claim宣称，声称。refuse拒绝；state声明，陈述。故选B。

stem: 35. Supposing that international agreement could be obtained to mitigate these difficulties, what is the proper policy to _____?
choices: pursue<sep>gain<sep>reach<sep>indicate
analysis: 【解析】句意：假设能够达成国际协议来减轻这些困难，应该采取什么政策呢? pursue意为“执行；贯彻”。gain意为“获得；增加”；reach “达到；影响”；indicate“表明；指出”。故选A。

stem: 36. This new company may succeed _____ what it wants to do, but what it wants to do may not be _____ important.
choices: /; all this<sep>at; all that<sep>in; this all<sep>to; that all
analysis: 【解析】句意：这家新公司可能会在它想做的事情上取得成功，但它想做的事情可能并不那么重要。succeed at意为“在某方面成功”。all that意为“那么；到那种程度”。故选B。

stem: 37. The program may seem quite expensive now, but it will actually save much money _____.
choices: above all<sep>best of all<sep>in the long run<sep>to the top
analysis: 【解析】句意：这个项目现在看来可能相当昂贵，但从长远来看，它实际上会节省很多钱。above all与best of all同义，意为“首先”；to the top意为“直到最顶端”故选C。

stem: 38. When taking a test, we need to _____ our semantic memories, the sum of our acquired knowledge.
choices: draw on<sep>fold up<sep>jump at<sep>run down
analysis: 【解析】句意：在进行测试时，我们需要利用我们的语义记忆，也就是我们已经获得的知识的总和。draw on意为“利用”。fold up意为“折叠”；jump at意为“欣然接受”；run down 意为“撞倒”。故选A。

stem: 39. _____, don t ask the maths teacher about the homework. I think she s definitely forgotten.
choices: At all costs<sep>By and by<sep>In consequence<sep>Well and truly
analysis: 【解析】句意：无论如何，不要去问数学老师作业的事情。我觉得她肯定已经忘了。At all costs意为”无论如何、不惜一切代价”，用于强调避免某件事情发生。By and by意为“迟早、最终”；In consequence意为“因此、结果”；Well and truly意为“确实、完全”。故选A。

stem: 40. Research shows that if we don t _____ enough vitamin D, we will develop health problems.
choices: add to<sep>put on<sep>sum up<sep>take in
analysis: 【解析】句意：研究表明，如果我们不摄入足够的维生素D，我们就会出现健康问题。take in意为“吸收；摄入”。add to意为“加入，加到”；put on意为“穿上；上演”；sum up 意为“总结；概述”。故选D。

stem: 41. I really can t _____ of the operation manual of the new mobile phone. Could you please explain it to me?
choices: break the ice<sep>make head or tail<sep>take good care<sep>have a try
analysis: 【解析】句意：我对这种新手机的操作手册一点也看不懂。你能给我解释一下吗？make head or tail意为“弄清楚”；break the ice意为“打破沉默，打破僵局；破冰”；take good care意为“好好照顾；珍重”；have a try意为“尝试；努力”。故选B。

stem: 42. Most researchers believe this new medicine could _____ the virus and _____ save millions of lives.
choices: wipe out; potentially<sep>turn up; particularly<sep>put up with; possibly<sep>come down with; intentionally
analysis: 【解析】句意：大多数研究人员相信这种新药可以消灭病毒，并可能拯救数百万人的生命。wipe out意为“消灭，彻底摧毁”; potentially意为“可能地，潜在地”。故选A。

stem: 43. Thankfully, my dry-clean-only shirt looked _____ for having gone through the washing machine.
choices: at least<sep>in good time<sep>none the worse<sep>all the more
analysis: 【解析】句意：值得庆幸的是，我那件只能干洗的衬衫在洗过之后并没有变得更糟。none the worse意为“一点也不差；还是；仍然”。at least意为“至少”；in good time意为“及时地；迅速地”；all the more意为“更加”。故选C。

stem: 44. Are you excited about graduation and going into the world? Not really. I haven t been able to find a job. _____
choices: Not too bad.<sep>I am sorry to hear that.<sep>It doesn t matter.<sep>See you later.
analysis: 【解析】句意：“听到这件事我很遗憾。”上文对方表示毕业后没有找到工作，因此应表示遗憾。故选B。

stem: 45. Do you find country life satisfying? I m afraid not. It s too inconvenient, is it? _____
choices: That makes sense.<sep>Please try again.<sep>Take it easy.<sep>Sorry, I can t agree with you.
analysis: 【解析】句意：对不起，我不能同意你的看法。通过上下文可知，两人意见不同，前者认为乡村生活令人惬意，后者认为其不方便。故选D。

stem: 31. President Xi Jinping was given a very warm _____ by the people who were waiting for him to arrive at the airport.
choices: invitation<sep>reception<sep>recognition<sep>collection
analysis: 【解析】reception:接待；接收。invitation 邀请；recognition 识别；承认；collection 采集，聚集。句意为：习近平主席在机场受到候机人员的热烈接待。

stem: 32. You should know that you are not _____. If you are not good at your job, the company will fire you.
choices: indifferent<sep>unnecessary<sep>unpredictable<sep>indispensable
analysis: 【解析】indispensable：不可缺少的；绝对必要的；indifferent：冷淡的；不关心的；unnecessary： 不必要的；多余的；unpredictable：不可预知的；不定的。句意为：你应该知道你不是不可缺少的。如果你不擅长你的工作，公司就会解雇你。

stem: 33. Yale university s distinguished faculty includes many _____ have been trained or educated abroad and many _____ fields of research have a global emphasis.
choices: that; which<sep>who; those<sep>which; whose<sep>who; whose
analysis: 【解析】第一个空为who引导的定语从句修饰先行词many。 第二个空为whose引导的定语从句修饰先行词many。句意为：耶鲁大学的杰出教员包括许多在国外受训或接受教育的人，以及许多研究领域具有全球重点的人。

stem: 34._____have I seen such a talent in math. His abilities are amazing.
choices: Rare<sep>Seldom<sep>Scarce<sep>Little
analysis: 【解析】Seldom很少，不常. 否定词never,seldom,rarely,hardly,barely,scarcely,little,few等位于句首时所引起的倒装句通常为部分倒装形式。rare adj. 稀有的; scarce adj. 缺乏的，不足的; little n. 少许。

stem: 35. What s happened to Jane? Coming back from work, _____ down by a car.
choices: she been knocked<sep>she knocked<sep>she was knocked<sep>she was being knocked
analysis: 【解析】本题考查一般过去时被动语态。主语+was/were+过去分词。

stem: 36. Now that you have found a new job you cannot possibly come to the beach tomorrow, _____?
choices: have you<sep>can t you<sep>haven t you<sep>can you
analysis: 【解析】本题考查反义疑问句。本题为：陈述部分否定式+疑问部分肯定式 。意为：既然你找到了一份新工作，你明天就不可能来海滩了，是吗?

stem: 37. Ellen, I know it wasn t your fault, so stop apologizing _____ to my poetry reading.
choices: you don t come<sep>don t come<sep>for not coming<sep>not coming
analysis: 【解析】本题考查固定搭配：apologize for (not) doing sth.为(未)做某事而道歉。句意为：艾伦，我知道那不是你的错，所以别再为没来参加我的诗朗诵而道歉了。

stem: 38. As the exam date_____, more and more students began attending weekly review sessions.
choices: drew near<sep>filled in<sep>went over<sep>came down
analysis: 【解析】draw near:靠近；接近。fill in：填满；go over 越过；检查; come down下来。句意：随着考试日期的到来，越来越多的学生开始参加周复习。

stem: 39. When you sign up for a conversation partner, the teacher will_____ with a native English speaking student.
choices: come up<sep>hook you up<sep>put up<sep>wrap you up
analysis: 【解析】hook you up with… 帮你联络上……。句意：当你报名找一个对话伙伴时，老师会为你介绍一个以英语为母语的学生。
