stem: 40. The headmaster told us that if it _____ rain tomorrow, the sports meet would be _____ till next Monday.
choices: was to; laid off<sep>were to; put off<sep>wouldn t; put off<sep>would; laid off
analysis: 【解析】句意：校长告诉我们，如果明天下雨，运动会将会推迟到下周一。此句为虚拟语气，句中“told”为过去式，而运动会还未举办，因此校长的话是对将来情况的推测，从句应该用“if+主语+were to do”。put off推迟。lay off解雇；休息。故选B。

stem: 41. I don t think I can afford to buy the latest Playstation. It _____.
choices: costs an arm and a leg<sep>gets the wrong end of the stick<sep>puts my foot in it<sep>shows my true colours
analysis: 【解析】句意：我想我买不起最新的PS游戏机，它太贵了。cost an arm and a leg价格昂贵；付出过高的代价。get the wrong end of the stick完全搞错了；完全误解。put one's foot in it失言；犯错误；因处理不当而招惹麻烦。show one's true colours原形毕露。故选A。

stem: 42. _____ we might go and _____ we might do, we should bear in mind the people s interests.
choices: Whether; however<sep>Wherever; whatever<sep>Whenever; whether<sep>However; whichever
analysis: 【解析】句意：无论去哪里，做什么事，都要以人民的利益为重。第一个空格后的动词为“go”，因此横线处为“无论什么地方”。第二个空格后的动词为“do”，因此横线处为“无论什么（事情）”。故选B。

stem: 43. You can t study the foreign language well _____ you have improved your method of study.
choices: as long as<sep>in case<sep>unless<sep>whereas
analysis: 【解析】句意：除非你改进学习方法，否则你是学不好外语的。unless除非；as long as只要；in ease安逸的，清闲的；whereas然而，鉴于。故选C。

stem: 44. I hope you don t mind my smoking here. I really can t help it. _____
choices: Oh, of course.<sep>Not at all.<sep>Well, I can help you.<sep>You are welcome.
analysis: 【解析】句意：—希望你不会介意我在这儿抽烟。我实在没办法。—我一点也不介意。根据对话情境可知，横线处应该用“not at all”表示“不介意”。故选B。

stem: 45. I m going to London by plane the day after tomorrow. _______
choices: Did you have a good time?<sep>Are you enjoying it?<sep>It s my pleasure to meet you.<sep>I wish I were going with you.
analysis: 【解析】句意：—我后天要坐飞机去伦敦。—我真希望我们和你一起去。从对话中“the day after tomorrow”可以对方还没有去伦敦，因此A、B选项不符合情境。C选项与对方所说的事情无关。故选D。

stem: 31. All teachers can have a free_____of these books to see if they are good enough to be used in class.
choices: issue<sep>gift<sep>sample<sep>benefit
analysis: 【答案】C 【解析】句意：所有老师都可以享有这些书的免费样本，用来确定它们是否适用于课堂教学。issue问题；gift礼物；benefit益处。sample样本，符合题意。

stem: Jane Austen was an English novelist _____work focused on the questions of courtship, marriage, morals and inheritance. Sense and Sensibility tells the story of two sisters are_____different in personality.
choices: who; that<sep>whose; which<sep>who; which<sep>whose; who
analysis: 【答案】D 【解析】句意：简·奥斯汀是英国小说家，她的作品聚焦于恋爱、婚姻和遗产继承等主题。《理智与情感》讲述了不同性格的两姐妹的故事。考察定语从句引导词。第一空填入的词在从句中表示所属关系，即奥斯汀的作品，故填whose，因而排除A、C两项，第二空的先行词是两姐妹，应用代指人的who。故选D。

stem: I think I have_____your abilities. You are much better than I thought.
choices: mistrusted<sep>reduced<sep>lowered<sep>underestimated
analysis: 【答案】D 【解析】句意：我觉得我低估你的能力了，你比我想的要好得多。mistrust猜疑；reduce减少；lower降低。underestimate低估，符合题意。

stem: When Mike s school called home to inform his parents of his misbehaviour, they were very disappointed_____him.
choices: at<sep>in<sep>on<sep>to
analysis: 【答案】B 【解析】句意：学校打电话告知迈克的父母他的不良行为，他们听后对他感到非常失望。be disappointed at sth意为“对某事感到失望”，be disappointed in sb意为“对某人感到失望”，故选B。

stem: Although he is warm-hearted enough, he keeps people_____ .
choices: in his way<sep>beyond his reach<sep>at arm s length<sep>ahead of him
analysis: 【答案】C 【解析】句意：他虽然很热心，但总与人保持一定的距离。in one's way妨碍；挡着…的路；beyond one's reach够不着；ahead of sb领先某人。keep sb at arm's length意为“与某人保持距离；不亲近某人”，符合题意。

stem: Steve is a dependable man. He never_____his promises.
choices: goes back to<sep>goes in for<sep>goes back on<sep>goes down with
analysis: 【答案】C 【解析】句意：斯蒂芬是一个可靠的人，他从来不打破他的承诺。go back to sth回忆起；追溯到；go in for sth对某事物有兴趣；爱好；go down with患……病；感染上……病。go back on sth违约；食言，符合题意。

stem: Why don t you give Jack some advice about learning English？ Oh no, that s a situation I definitely want to _____.
choices: stay out of<sep>come up with<sep>look for<sep>break down
analysis: 【解析】句意：——你怎么不给杰克提一些学英语的建议？——那可别，这种情况我正想 。come up with 想出；look for 寻找；break down 倒塌，分解。stay out of 置身事外，符合题意。

stem: Are you coming out with us this weekend? I will if I _____all my homework for next week.
choices: finish<sep>will finish<sep>will be finishing<sep>finished
analysis: 【答案】A 【解析】句意：——你这周和我们一起出去吗？——如果我能完成下周的作业就去。考察if引导的条件状语从句的时态。本句中主句的时态为一般将来时，可以判断从句应用一般现在时，故选A。

stem: What are you thinking of doing for the Spring Festival? We aren t sure but_____to go to London.
choices: have been hoped<sep>will hope<sep>are hoping<sep>will be hoping
analysis: 【答案】C 【解析】句意：——你们在春节想做什么？——我们还不确定，但是想去伦敦。想去伦敦是答话人在说话时的想法，所以应该用现在进行时。

stem: When do you think the workers will finish building the garage？ They here been here all day. It_____much longer.
choices: mustn t take<sep>is taking<sep>has taken<sep>won t take
analysis: 【答案】D 【解析】句意：——你认为工人们什么时候能建成车库？——他们一整天都在这儿，应该不会太久了。本句是对工人们完工时间的预测，是未来发生的事情，故用一般将来时。A项意为“禁止花费更长时间”，不符合题意，B、C两项时态不正确，故选D。

stem: Black Friday is an informal name for the day_____Thanksgiving Day in the United States, which_____as the beginning of the country s Christmas shopping season since 1952.
choices: following; was regarded<sep>following; has been regarded<sep>followed; has been regarded<sep>followed; was regarded
analysis: 【答案】B 【解析】句意：在美国，黑色星期五是感恩节后一天的非正式名称，从1952年起，这一天被认为是美国圣诞购物季的开端。第一空应填动词分词形式做the day的后置定语，the day是follow的逻辑主语，故用following。从since 1952可以判断，第二空填入的时态应为现在完成时，故填has been regarded。故选B。

stem: Have you been to the new night club in town? Rarely_____the chance to go out, let alone to a night club.
choices: I do have<sep>have do I<sep>do have I<sep>do I have
analysis: 【答案】D 【解析】句意：——你去过镇里的新夜店了吗？——我几乎没机会出去，更别提去夜店了。Rarely是表示否定的副词，放句首时句子要用倒装，正确的语序是D。

stem: Hello, Mr. Green. It s Sarah Kennedy here. I was wondering if you would be interested in meeting with me and our design manager. We have some ideas to discuss with you. Thank you, Sarah. I d be very interested in arranging a meeting. When would be convenient for you? Well, I was thinking of perhaps next Tuesday, if you can make it then. Yes, _____.
choices: that s fine with us<sep>let me think about it<sep>the time is so limited<sep>I have a case to deal with
analysis: 【答案】A 【解析】句意：——您好，格林先生。我是萨拉·肯尼迪。我想询问，您是否有兴趣与我和我们的设计总监会面呢？——谢谢你，萨拉。我非常感兴趣。你们什么时候方便呢？——真好，如果你方便的话，我想可能安排在下周六。——嗯，好，那个时间合适。格林先生回答“yes”，说明他那个时间方便，故选A。B项意为“让我想想”；C项意为“时间太紧张了”；D项意为“我有一个案子要处理”。

stem: Hi, Steve. I haven t seen you for ages. You know, I ve got a new job. Oh, that s nice. How are you getting on, then? _____I feel like a fish out of water doing this job.
choices: Don t worry.<sep>It s all my fault.<sep>Not so well.<sep>It s great.
analysis: 【答案】C 【解析】句意：——史蒂夫先生，您好。好多年不见啦。——我找了份新工作。——那太好了，那你的新工作怎么样？——不太好，我做这份工作感觉像是鱼儿离开了水。从空后的比喻可以看出史蒂夫先生的工作不顺心，故选C。A项意为“不要担心”；B项意为“都是我的错”；D项意为“太棒了”。

stem: Excuse me, but I ve lost my wallet. It contains my ID card, driving license and some family pictures. It s pretty important to me. Don t worry, sir, let me check._____ Oh, it s a brown leather wallet, quite new.
choices: What s your name?<sep>What s the wallet like?<sep>Where have you been?<sep>Where did you lose it?
analysis: 【答案】B 【解析】句意：——打扰一下，我丢了钱包，里面有身份证、驾驶证和家庭照。——它对我很重要。——不要担心，先生，我登记一下。钱包是什么样子？——是灰色的皮革钱包，非常新。从答语看，询问的应该是钱包的样子，故选B。A项意为“你的名字是？”；C项意为“你去过哪里？”；D项意为“你在哪里丢了它？”。

stem: 31. Samantha worked very hard and put in a lot of overtime hours because she wanted a salary_____.
choices: improvement<sep>expansion<sep>raise<sep>growth
analysis: 【C】本题考查词汇辨析。improvement改进，改善；提高；expansion膨胀；阐述；扩张物；raise提高；筹集；养育；growth增长；发展；生长。题干意思是“萨曼莎工作非常努力，经常加班，因为她想要一份薪水________”，“salary raise加薪”因此填raise。所以这题选C。 【句意】萨曼莎工作非常努力，经常加班，因为她想要加薪。

stem: 32. The government will_____new price controls on the industry next year.
choices: impose<sep>compose<sep>repose<sep>dispose
analysis: 【A】本题考查固定搭配。impose利用；欺骗；强加；征税；compose构成；写作；使平静; repose休息；睡眠；静止；dispose安置，安排。根据句意，政府将于明年对该行业实施新的价格管制，因此答案选A。【句意】政府明年将对该行业实施新的价格管制。

stem: 33. One difficulty in translation lies in obtaining a concept match, _____this it is meant that a concept in one language is lost or changed in meaning in translation.
choices: in<sep>for<sep>with<sep>by
analysis: 【D】本题考查介词用法。名词difficulty常与介词in搭配，表示“……方面的困难”。句型by...is meant that...可以看成是what is meant by...的变形，用于解释说明前文的内容，因此答案选C。 【句意】翻译的难点之一是概念匹配，即一种语言中的概念在翻译过程中失去或改变了意思。

stem: 34. _____person with_____good education usually gets_____good job.
choices: A; a; a<sep>The; a; /<sep>The; /; the<sep>A; /; /
analysis: 【A】本题考查冠词用法。不定冠词a用来表示这个冠词后面的名词是指某一类特定事物中的一个,但具体是哪一个并不重要；而定冠词the用来限定这个冠词后面的名词是某个特定的事物，联系句意，并未特指某个人，收到的某种教育，以及某份具体的工作，因此答案选A。 【句意】受过良好教育的人通常能找到一份好工作。

stem: 35. _____we were careful with expenses, we still went over our budget this year.
choices: If<sep>Since<sep>Because<sep>Even though
analysis: 【D】本题考查连词。If如果；Since既然；Because因为；Even though虽然。根据句意，虽然我们对开支很小心，我们今年还是超出了预算，因此答案选D。 【句意】虽然我们对开支很小心，我们今年还是超出了预算。

stem: 36. _____in today s business world is difficult, and many new businesses fail.
choices: Compete<sep>Competing<sep>To compete<sep>Having competed
analysis: 【B】本题考查非谓语动词。分析主句成分，除了主语部分不完整，句子不缺少成分，可知挖空处应使用非谓语，可排除选项A，联系句意“在当今的商业世界”，可知用“compete”的ing形式，因此答案选C。 【句意】在当今的商业世界，竞争是困难的，许多新企业失败了。

stem: 37. In computer programming, this model is obviously_____any of the others we have in the institute.
choices: superior to<sep>familiar to<sep>essential to<sep>relevant to
analysis: 【A】本题考查固定搭配。superior to比…优越 ；familiar to熟悉的；亲近的；essential to对……必不可少；relevant to相应的；与……有关的。根据句意，本模型应暗含与其他模型的比较，结合选项“superior to比……优越”，答案选A。 【句意】在计算机编程方面，这个模型明显优于我们研究所的任何其他模型。

stem: 38. Because of_____weather conditions, more than a dozen towns in this region were declared disaster areas last year.
choices: exotic<sep>harsh<sep>moist<sep>fancy
analysis: 【B】本题考查词汇辨析。exotic异国的；外来的；异国情调的；harsh严厉的；严酷的；刺耳的；moist潮湿的；湿润的；多雨的; fancy想做；喜爱；自负。根据句意，后文谈到城镇面临被划为灾区，因此天气应该是极为严酷、恶劣的，答案选B。 【句意】由于恶劣的天气条件，去年该地区有十几个城镇被宣布为灾区。

stem: 39. The girl from_____I received the card was someone_____I met on holiday.
choices: which; who<sep>her; whom<sep>who; that<sep>whom; /
analysis: 【D】语法题。第一个挖空处缺少宾语，正确语序应该是“I received the card from the girl”，所以应填“whom”，第二个挖空处缺少关系代词，someone作 I met的并语，应该填“that”或省略，因此答案选D。 【句意】寄给我这张卡片的女孩是我在假日遇到的人。

stem: 40. Helen_____the purse from the office. She didn t come into the office on the day it was stolen.
choices: might have taken<sep>must have taken<sep>can t have stolen<sep>needn t have stolen
analysis: 【C】语法题，考察情态动词的用法。A. might have taken当时可能偷了 B. must have taken当时一定偷了 C. can’t have stolen当时一定没有偷 D. needn’t have stolen本来不必偷，但事实上偷了，根据时态和句意。根据句意，这里应该是“不可能偷了钱包”的意思，因此答案选C。

stem: 41. Animals do not talk with words. They use smells, sounds and movements to communicate with_____animal.
choices: any<sep>another<sep>each<sep>the other
analysis: 【B】本题考查词汇辨析。A. any用作形容词的基本意思是“任何一个（一些）”，指在三个或三个以上的事物中，强调“无论哪一个”。B. another用作形容词的基本意思是“(又)另一个的”，主要指同类中又多一(个)的或与前述不同的另一个的。C. each指两者或两者以上的“每个”。D. the other既能作形容词，又能作代词，但它一般用来表示总数为二时的“另外一个”，经常与one搭配，根据句意，这里指的其他动物是有别于前边提到的，因此答案选择B。 【句意】动物不会说话。它们用气味、声音和动作与其他动物交流。

stem: 42. She always put her medication on the top of the shelf lest the children_____it by mistake.
choices: took<sep>had taken<sep>would take<sep>should take
analysis: 【D】语法题。本题考查“lest唯恐”的用法，“lest”后应该用虚拟语气，即用“should+动词原形”，should可以省略，因此答案选D。 【句意】她总是把药放在架子的最上面，以免孩子们误吃。

stem: 43. I m calling an emergency meeting tomorrow morning at 10:00. Do you think you can be there? _____I ll probably be about 15 minutes late. Why are you calling the meeting, anyhow? The accounting department has been having some difficulties, and paychecks will be delayed until next week.

stem: 44. Do you think you could help me move this desk to the other side of the room? I want to put it near the window so I can work in the daylight. I m sorry. I hurt my back._____Why don t you get Emma to help you? She s not here. She ll be at a meeting downtown all afternoon.

stem: 45. I m looking for some warm winter gloves. My wife said you had them on sale. Yes, these gloves are on sale._____We also have these scarves that would look just right with them. Yes, that s all very nice, but I really just want the gloves.
choices: That s what I came down here for.<sep>That comes to $15.50 with tax.<sep>They come with matching hats.<sep>I ll take this black pair.
analysis: 【C】情景交际题。A.这就是我来这里的原因。B.算上税一共是15.50美元。C.它们都配有配套的帽子。D.我要这双黑色的。根据挖空处上文，店主说手套在打折，而下文顾客委婉拒绝后，表明只想要手套，可知店主应该是推荐了别的商品，根据句意，本题选C。 【句意】—我想买一些温暖的冬季手套。我妻子说你在打折。 —是的，这些手套正在打折。它们都配有配套的帽子。我们也有这种围巾，看 起来和它们很搭。 —是的，这些都很好，但我真的只想要手套。

stem: 31. Nobody has ever seen a dinosaur _____ on a visit to a zoo.
choices: in case<sep>in spite of<sep>even though<sep>apart from
analysis: 考察连词。选项的意思依次是“以免”、“尽管（介词短语后面加名词）”、“即使”、“除了，远离”。题目句子的意思是“即使去动物园参观，也没有人见过恐龙”，所以C选项为正确答案。

stem: 32. In the absence of gravity, there _____ be no air around the Earth.
choices: should<sep>would<sep>can<sep>must

stem: 33. Interpreting the feelings of other people is not always easy, as we all know, and we _____ as much on what they seem to be telling us, as on the _____words they say.
choices: estimate; real<sep>rely; actual<sep>evaluate; real<sep>assess; actual

stem: 34. Young adults _____ older people are more likely to prefer online shopping.
choices: rather than<sep>other than<sep>more than<sep>less than
analysis: 考察介词短语。选项的意思依次是“而不是”、“除了”、“多于”、“少于”。根据young adults…older people，所以选项A为正确答案。题目句子的意思是“青壮年而不是老年人，更喜欢网上购物”。

stem: 35. Grey hair should be respected is an example of _____.
choices: personification<sep>irony<sep>pun<sep>metonymy
analysis: 考察修辞方法。选项的意思依次是“拟人”、“反语”、“双关”、“转喻”。本句中用白发表示老人，即用事物典型特征来理解被替代的事物，所以是“转喻”的修辞方法，答案为D选项。题目句子的意思是“‘老年人应该受到尊重’这句话是转喻的一个例子”。

stem: 36. _____ for our tickets, we were annoyed when the flight was canceled.
choices: By paying<sep>Having paid<sep>Had it paid<sep>Having been paid
analysis: 考察非谓语动词。本题后半句是主句，前半句应为非谓语动词作状语，主语是人，与谓语动词之间是主动关系，强调动作已经发生，所以用非谓语动词的完成形式，B选项为正确答案。题目句子的意思是“已经付了飞机票，当航班取消时我们很心烦”。

stem: 37. A word which has two or more different meanings is called a _____word.
choices: multiple<sep>polysemous<sep>multilingual<sep>synonymous
analysis: 考察形容词辨析。选项的意思依次是“多个的”、“一词多义的”、“多语种的”、“同义的”。题目句子的意思是“一个词有两个或多个含义被称为‘多义词’”， 所以B选项为正确答案。

stem: 38. We can _____ the sea from our hotel room but _____ we stand on a chair and lean out of the window.
choices: glimpse; if only<sep>stare at; except<sep>gaze at; only if<sep>glance; unless
analysis: 考察动词短语、连词。选项的意思依次是“瞥见，要是……就好了”、“凝视，除了”、“注视，只有在……的时候”、“浏览，除非”。题目句子的意思是“我们可以从宾馆房间看到大海，但是仅限于我们站在椅子上，斜靠着窗户”，所以C选项为正确答案。

stem: 39. With two houses and an income of over ￡100,000 a year, he has a very _____ lifestyle.
choices: affluent<sep>expensive<sep>splendid<sep>modest
analysis: 考察形容词辨析。选项的意思依次是“富裕的”、“昂贵的”、“辉煌的”、“谦逊的”。题目句子的意思是“他有两套房子，年收人10万英镑，过着富足的生活”，所以A选项为正确答案。

stem: 40. Tom had always loved singing and dancing, so when he got a part in a musical he was _____.
choices: on a different wavelength<sep>the black sheep of the family<sep>in his element<sep>under the weather
analysis: 考察习语。选项的意思依次是“不是同一路人”、“家里的害群之马”、“得心应手”、“身体不适”。题目句子的意思是“汤姆一直喜欢唱歌跳舞，所以他在音乐剧里得到角色后，很得心应手”，所以C选项为正确答案。

stem: 41. If the doctor had come earlier, the little baby would not _____for two hours.
choices: have laid there<sep>have been lied there<sep>have lied there<sep>have lain there
analysis: 考察虚拟语气。本题考查与过去事实相反的虚拟语气，前半句是与过去事实相反的假设，后半句用would have done，所以D选项正确。题目句子的意思是“如果医生再早一点来，那个小男孩就不用在那躺两个小时了”。

stem: 42. Women are particularly _____ to developing depression and anxiety disorders in response to stress compared to men.
choices: susceptible<sep>sustainable<sep>possible<sep>suitable
analysis: 考察形容词辨析。选项的意思依次是“易受影响的”、“持续的”、“可能的”、“适当的”。题目句子的意思是“在面对压力时，女性比男性更易患抑郁症和焦虑症”， 所以A选项为正确答案。

stem: 43. What is great English poet Geoffrey Chaucer s main work?
choices: Vanity Fair.<sep>Beowulf.<sep>Canterbury Tales.<sep>The Divine Comedy.
analysis: 考察文学常识。选项分别是书名《名利场》、《贝奥武夫》、《坎特伯雷故事集》、《神曲》。题干的意思是“英国诗人杰弗雷·乔叟的代表作是什么？”《坎特伯雷故事集》是乔叟的代表作，所以选择C。

stem: 44. Excuse me, I was sitting there. Oh were you? Sorry. I didn t realize. _____ Let me move my things.
choices: Don t be sorry.<sep>That s OK.<sep>I didn t mean to be rude.<sep>What do you mean?
analysis: 考察句意分析。本题主要根据语境选择合适的句意，回答抱歉的是“没关系”，所以选择B选项。题干意思为“——打扰一下，刚才我一直坐在这里。——是吗？对不起，我没注意。——没关系。——我把我的东西挪走吧”。

stem: 45. As far as photography is concerned, Cindy Sherman is currently the most famous artist. Really? To be honest, _____ .
choices: I m going to attend a lecture now<sep>I ve always admired her work<sep>she has taken a lot of photos<sep>her work is not really to my taste
analysis: 考察句意分析。根据上文“真的吗？”可以推测下文要表达相反的观点，所以选择D。题干意思为“——如果论摄影技术，辛迪·谢尔曼应该是当今最著名的艺术家。——真的吗？老实说，我不太喜欢他的作品”。

stem: 31.In most developed countries, small corporations pay about 32.5 percent of their net income in taxes _____ large ones pay _____ 46 percent.
choices: and; only<sep>but; near<sep>however; quite<sep>while; some
analysis: 译文： 在大部分发达国家，小企业缴纳净收益32.5％左右占比的税，然而大企业就得花费46％之多。 解析 分析句意，空格处需要表达的是转折关系。表达转折可以有几种表达方式，一是while，表示“然而”，二是“however”。空格之后为some，以表示份额。故选D。

stem: 32.We would like to express our _____ a large number of businesses and business publications, _____ have given us permission to use various kinds of their materials.
choices: thanks at; which<sep>gratitude in; they<sep>gratefulness on; that<sep>appreciation to; who
analysis: 译文： 我们想向那些为我们提供不同原材料的大多数企业法人及发行人表达感激。 解析 express one's appreciation to意为“对...表示感激”；分析句意，得知第二空格处应填who表示主语从句的关系词。故选D。

stem: 33.Patriotism teaches people to believe that their country, and by _____ their government, is always right.
choices: specification<sep>definition<sep>illusion<sep>assertion
analysis: 译文： 爱国主义告诫人们要始终相信他们自己的国家，相信人民的政府永远都是对的。 解析 分析句意：爱国主义教导人们要相信国家，要把政府定义为是永远是对的。definition意为定义，把...当作。故选B。

stem: 34.Nicolaus Copernicus s ideas were far _____ the age in which he lived. That made him a tragedy _____ .
choices: in advance of; at last<sep>at advantage of; over time<sep>in adventure of; by chance<sep>in front of; for ever
analysis: 译文: Nicolaus Copernicus的思想是远远超过他所处的那个年代，这也就导致了其最终的悲剧。 解析 选项 be in advance of是固定搭配选项，表示“超过，领先”；分析句意，这最终致使他成了悲剧，故填at last，其他选项代入句中意思均不符，故选A。

stem: 35.In order to utilize female talents effectively, it may _____ be necessary, as many have already argued, to provide some support in the form of flexible work schedules, childcare facilities and _____.
choices: best; something<sep>ever; so on<sep>right; etc<sep>well; the like
analysis: 译文 正如之前争论的那样，为了有效发挥女性的聪明才智，为弹性化的工作机制提供大量支持是极其重要的；儿童抚养机制也是如此。 解析 选项A为“最好的”和“有些事”；选项B为“曾经”和“诸如此类”；选项C为“正确的”和“等等”；选项D为“好的”和“如此”。分析句意，第一空格处应填副词well，意为非常有必要；第二空格处，the like表示...也是一样，相当于the same as。其他选项代入句中意思均不符。故选D。

stem: 36.The establishment of the European market has _____fewer barriers to regional trade.
choices: contributed to<sep>risen to<sep>led to<sep>resorted to
analysis: 译文 统一的欧洲市场的形成和建立，减少了区域贸易的阻碍。 解析 本题考查的是结果状语。选项A为“为...做贡献”；选项B 为“上升为”;选项C为“导致”选项D为“归类为”。分析句意，led to表示导致，引发什么样的结果。其他选项代入句中均不符。故选C。

stem: 37.If you want to set _____a company, you must _____ the regulations laid down by the authorities.
choices: down; adhere to<sep>in; accord with<sep>up; comply with<sep>with; conform to
analysis: 译文 如果你想成立一家公司，你就必须遵从官方制定的法律法规。 解析 分析句意，空格处需要介词，表示“成立”。选项C 为“set up”，意为“成立公司企业”代入句中意思相符。with作为介词，自身含义为“同...一起，遵从...”。故选C。

stem: 38.The company s goods are competitive _____ product quality, reliability and above all variety.
choices: by means of<sep>in terms of<sep>in relation to<sep>in response to
analysis: 译文 在产品品质，可信赖度以及综上所有方面，这家公司的产品相当有竞争力。 解析 选项A为“通过...方式”，而选项B为“在...方面”，因此选项C为“与...相关”，选项D为“回应...”。分析句意，在...方面，这家公司的产品非常出色，因此空格应填in terms of，其他选项代入句中意思均不符。故选B。

stem: 39.For years before Thomas Jefferson became President in 1801, he had dreamed of sending an expedition _____ North America to _____ the unknown parts of the continent.
choices: across; explore<sep>in; seek<sep>through; find<sep>to; search
analysis: 在汤姆斯杰斐逊于1801 年成为美国总统数年前，他就梦想着穿越北美大陆去寻找大洲的未知部分。 解析 选项A是固定搭配；选项B为“在里面，寻找”；选项C为“穿过，找到”；选项D为“去.....搜查”。分析句意，第一个空格是表示穿过，故用across而不用through，第二空格处表示探寻…故用explore，其他选项代入句中意思均不符。故选A。

stem: 40.― Can we finish painting the garage tonight? ― I don t know, but we _____ .
choices: might try to<sep>should like to<sep>had to try<sep>had better try
analysis: 译文 ——我们今晚可以刷完车库的墙吗？ ——我不知道，但我们最好尝试弄完。 解析 分析句意：前后两句有关联性，表明今晚不能刷完墙。因此，第二句空格处应表达“最好”。D选项“had better”为固定搭配，表示“最好…”，其他选项代入句中均不符。故选D。

stem: 41.I think it would be _____ to hear the other side of the argument before you make your decision.
choices: encouraged<sep>flexible<sep>prudent<sep>reserved
analysis: 我认为在做自己的决定之前，倾听有异议得那一方才会是明智的。 解析 四个选项均为形容词，但语义不同。A为“备受鼓舞的”；选项B为“灵活的”；选项C 为“明智的，显而易见的”；选项D为“保守的，有质疑的”。 分析句意 空格处意为明智之举，应使用prudent。其他选项代入句中意思均不符。故选C。

stem: 42.Travel between time zones may _____ evident disturbances in normal sleep patterns and body rhythms.
choices: come up with<sep>go in for<sep>build up<sep>result in
analysis: 译文 时空传送会致使睡眠方式以及身体机制紊乱。 解析 选项A为“提出”；选项B为“追求”；选项C 为“建造”；选项 D为“导致”。分析句意，空格处需要表达的前后的因果联系，空格处应为 results in，表示“导致”，因此，需要填入和其含义近似的词语。其他选项代入句中意思均不符合，故选D。

stem: 43.― Whenever I have to write a paper, I don t know where to begin. ― I have the same problem, but _____ , the paper seems to write itself.
choices: after starting it<sep>once I start<sep>on starting it<sep>started once
analysis: ——每当我要写论文的时候，我都不知道从哪里开始。 ——我也是有相同的问题，但只要一开始，这文章就不由自主的完成了。 解析 每当我需要写论文时，我不知道从哪里开始。但一旦开始写，论文似乎就自己写出来了。 在选项中，“once I start”表示“只要一开始”就可以顺利进行。这里的“once”是表示时间的连词，意思是“一旦”或“开始之后”，故选B。

stem: 44.― Can you tell me what his interests are? That way we can make sure he has a good time. ― _____We shall just have to fine-tune everything when he gets here.
choices: I m not really sure.<sep>I totally agree.<sep>Thank you for inviting me!<sep>You re missing the point!
analysis: ——你能告诉我他的兴趣是什么吗？那样一来，我们就能确保他会很开心。 ——我真的不知道，当他到这来的时候，我们也是投其所好。 解析 选项A为"我真不知道”；选项B为“我完全同意。”选项C为“谢谢邀请我。”选项D为“你跑题了”。分析句意，空格处需要表达的是对于求助的回答，而不是提出新的问题，更不可能以感谢的语气，其他选项代入句中意思均不符，故选A。

stem: 45.― You may think I m mad, but after a great deal of thought, I ve now finally come to a decision: I want to study in England. ― _____ I can now help you with all the necessary applications.
choices: Are you sure?<sep>Sorry about that.<sep>That s fine.<sep>What a lovely day.
analysis: ——你可能认为我疯了，但经过一番深思熟虑后，我目前最终还是做了个决定：我想去英国留学。 ——那好的，我可以帮你完成一些必要的申请材料。 解析 选项A为“你确定吗?”；选项B为“很抱歉”；选项C为“好的”；选项D为“多么美好的一天”。分析句意，对方下定了决心要去英国留学，向对方表达想法。因此，空格处需要表达的要么是祝福，或者请求回复，因此故选C。

stem: 31. The officer asked for a detailed _____ of what happened at the time of the accident.
choices: explanation<sep>declaration<sep>expression<sep>impression
analysis: 本题考查名词的辨析。A 项为“解释：说明”；B 项为“宣布”；C 项为“表达；表情”；D 项为“印象”，根据句意，警察想了解事故的有关情况。故选 A。

stem: 32. When it comes to protecting the environment, cost should be _____.
choices: impossible<sep>irresponsible<sep>irrelevant<sep>unreasonable
analysis: 本题考查形容词的辨析。A 项为“不可能的”；B 项为“不负责任的”；C项为“无关紧要的；不相关的”；D 项为“不合理的”，根据句意，故选 C。

stem: 33. The translation of the story is _____ correct, except for a few problems at the end.
choices: completely<sep>partly<sep>mutually<sep>basically

stem: 34. _____ after his arrival in Paris, Tom called me at the office.

stem: 35. We must act as soon as possible because time is _____.
choices: coming out<sep>running out<sep>taking up<sep>giving up

stem: 36. The presentation will be very informal, so if you have questions or comments, feel free to _____ at any time.
choices: go over<sep>come across<sep>take place<sep>jump in
analysis: 本题考查动词短语的辨析。A 项为“复习”；B 项为“偶遇”；C 项为“发生”；D 项为“不假思索地做”，根据句意，故选 D。

stem: 37. A monument has been _____ in memory of the great inventor.

stem: 38. While Steve _____ his car, he _____ some dents on the doors.

analysis: 本题考查 while 引导时间状语从句的用法。从句中的动词用 doing 的形式，表示动作正在进行，根据句意，主句用一般过去时。had discovered 表示动作发生在 wash之前，不符合句意，故选 B。

stem: 39. She tried to express her feelings _____ she could.
choices: more honest than<sep>as honest as<sep>more honestly than<sep>as honestly as

stem: 40. We don t agree to the means _____ which he solved the problem.

stem: 41. Top universities in China should be evaluated based on talent cultivation and scientific research, _____ solely on rankings and other quantitative measures.

stem: 42. Studies of Sanxingdui Site are an important project _____ tries to explain the origins of Chinese civilization and _____ diverse cultures communicate and come together.

stem: 43. There is a clear link between humans and environmental problems. _____, wherever humans live, they damage the environment in some way.

stem: 44. Do you think people work too much nowadays? Not really, I think people have always worked hard for a living. I mean it s never been easy for anyone, has it? You have to work hard if you want to achieve anything in your life that s just the way it is. You said it. _____

analysis: 本题考查常用语的辨析。A 项为“我不同意你的观点”；B 项为“我完全同意”；C 项为“没意义；没道理”；D 项为“我不想努力工作”，根据句意，故选 B。

stem: 31. By today s standards, early farmers were_____because they planted the same crops repeatedly, exhausting the soil after a few harvests.
choices: stubborn<sep>tiresome<sep>ridiculous<sep>imprudent
analysis: 【答案】D 【句意】按照今天的标准，早期的农民是不明智的，因为他们反复种植同样的作物，在几次收成后耗尽了土壤的养分。 【解析】本题考查词汇辨析。stubborn 固执的；顽固的；倔强的； tiresome 讨厌的；烦人的；令人厌烦的； ridiculous荒唐的；荒谬的；愚蠢的；imprudent轻率的；不谨慎的；不明智的。题干意思是“按照今天的标准，早期的农民是_______，因为他们反复种植同样的作物，在几次收成后耗尽了土壤的养分。”，根据句意，填imprudent。所以这题选D。

stem: 32. After working at the company for a year, Mr Jones received a_____from assistant manager to manager.
choices: promotion<sep>profile<sep>promise<sep>progress
analysis: 【答案】A 【句意】琼斯先生在公司工作一年后，从助理晋升为经理。 【解析】本题考查词汇辨析。promotion晋升；提升；提拔；(体育运动队的)晋级；profile轮廓；简介；面部的侧影；概述；promise许诺；承诺；答应；progress进步；进展；进程；前进。根据句意，琼斯先生在公司工作一年后，从助理晋升为经理，因此答案选A。

stem: 33. I hear that movie is pretty exciting. It was_____exciting. I ve never seen a better movie.
choices: not at all<sep>more than<sep>far from<sep>anything but
analysis: 【答案】B 【句意】-我听说那部电影很刺激。 -这不仅仅是刺激，我从没看过比这更好的电影 【解析】本题考查固定搭配。not at all一点也不；more than不仅仅是..；比...更....；far from远没有；根本不；远远不；anything but单单除…之外；根本不；远非。根据最后一句“I've never seen a better movie，我从没看过比这更好的电影”结合选项应选“more than不仅仅是”，答案选B。

stem: 34. Kent assured his boss that he would_____all his energies in doing his new job.
choices: call on<sep>call at<sep>call off<sep>call forth
analysis: 【答案】D 【句意】肯特向老板保证他会把所有精力都用在做新工作上。 【解析】本题考查固定搭配。call on拜访；呼吁；要求；call at到…进行短暂访问；停留；call off取消；call forth（正）引起；使产生。根据句意，肯特向老板保证他会把所有精力都用在做新工作上。结合选项，填入call forth 使产生，答案选D。

stem: 35. It isn t cold enough for there_____a frost tonight, so I can leave Jim s car out quite safely.
choices: was<sep>being<sep>to be<sep>would be
analysis: 【答案】C 【句意】今天天气不冷，所以我可以把吉姆的车安全地留在外面。 【解析】本题考查语法。根据题干，本题考察It is for ... to do sth句式。因此选to be，答案选C。

stem: 36. Our corporate headquarters sit on a hill, high up_____the manufacturing plant.
choices: beyond<sep>above<sep>from<sep>across
analysis: 【答案】B 【句意】我们的公司总部坐落在一座山上，比制造厂的位置高。 【解析】本题考查介词。根据“high up高高地”一词可知该处填above，因此答案选B。

stem: 37. No one on the team will be able to go home_____this work is finished.
choices: if<sep>even<sep>whereas<sep>until
analysis: 【答案】D 【句意】在这项工作完成之前，队里没有人能回家。 【解析】本题考查连词。if如果；even甚至；whereas然而；until直到。根据主句句意“队里没有人能回家”，和从句的句意“这项工作完成”，结合选项应选“until直到”，答案选D。

stem: 38. If we had worked through the night, we_____have finished the report on time.
choices: will<sep>must<sep>might<sep>can
analysis: 【答案】C 【句意】如果我们通宵工作的话，我们就可能已经按时完成报告了。 【解析】本题考查情态动词。will have done 将来完成；must have done一定做了；might have done可能做了；can have done能做好，使用时一般宾语前置，例如，If we had worked through the night, we can have the report finished on time.因此该处排除D选项，再根据句意，选might合适，答案选C。

stem: 39. American deserts are sometimes quite green. _____, they cannot support crops.
choices: Nevertheless<sep>Therefore<sep>Naturally<sep>Moreover
analysis: 【答案】A 【句意】美国的沙漠有时很绿。然而，它们不能养活庄稼。 【解析】本题考察连词。Nevertheless然而；Therefore因此；Naturally自然地；Moreover而且，根据句意，此处选A。

stem: 40. Smart-phones have many advantages. They keep us_____about the_____news, and also provide entertainment.
choices: informed; latest<sep>to know; later<sep>learning; latter<sep>to think; late
analysis: 【答案】A 【句意】智能手机有很多优点。他们让我们了解最新消息，还能提供娱乐。 【解析】本题考察语法和词汇辨析，keep不和to do搭配，因此排除B，D。根据句意，智能手机是让我们了解最新信息，而不是滞后的信息，因此排除C选项，因此答案选A。

stem: 41. The palace is heavily guarded, because inside the walls_____.
choices: where sit the European leaders<sep>sit the European leaders<sep>the European leaders there sit<sep>that the European leaders sit
analysis: 【答案】B 【句意】宫殿戒备森严，因为在围墙里面坐着欧洲领导人。 【解析】本题考查倒装句。 “inside the wall”状语前置,紧跟谓语、主语，属完全倒装句，其余三项不符合语法规则，因此答案选择B。

stem: 42. Given these conditions, there will not be_____room left in one s brain for_____rational thought.
choices: a; the<sep>/; a<sep>/; /<sep>the; /

stem: 43. His plane is due to arrive at 4:30. I think we should go pick him up at the airport. Good idea. But we ll need to leave at 3 if we re going to be on time._____ You re right. And I don t think we should take a taxi. The subway s much faster.

stem: 44. Mr Lee called. He d like to set up an appointment with you at 11:00 tomorrow morning to go over the marketing plan. Can t do it. I ll be at a meeting with the accountants then._____ I ll call and find out. What time would be best for you?

stem: 45. What terrible weather. Have you ever seen such thick fog? I ve heard it s caused a lot of problems on the highway. I know. As a matter of fact, Jack called and said he ll be at least an hour late because the traffic is so heavy. _____ I did, and I wasn t delayed even one minute.

stem: 31. Apples in the supermarket are sold by _____ weight, and flowers can be sold by _____ dozen.
choices: /; a<sep>the; the<sep>the; a<sep>/; the

stem: 32. You should _____what you originally stated if you want your children s respect.

stem: 33. There s a lot of bad _____ between me and my brother.

stem: 34._____ the child, the more readily the mother _____ to his demands to avoid disappointing him.

stem: 36. Denotation refers to the actual dictionary definition of the word, _____ the attachment of an emotional response.

stem: 38. The researcher wants to test her new _____ about language learning. She s not sure if it will work, but she wants to find out.

stem: 39. Prices have risen in order to _____ the increased cost of raw materials.

stem: 40. There seems to be something wrong with the machine, _____?

stem: 41. It didn t worry me at all, I took _____ .

stem: 42. _____ , he would have felt sorry.
choices: Had he done it<sep>He had done it<sep>If he had it done<sep>Were he to do it

stem: 43. Which of the following is a metaphor?

stem: 44. I love performance art. As a matter of fact, David Blaine s my hero. David Blaine? The magician?_____ , I think he s crazy.

stem: 45. Sorry, could I possibly interrupt? _____ Well, would you mind repeating that last figure? I m afraid I missed it. Certainly. It was 15,788,000 dollars.

stem: 31. The rain was beating _____ the window and the sound made the couple feel quite put _____.
choices: against; out<sep>at; down<sep>on; off<sep>up; on
analysis: 本题考查固定搭配。beat against 撞上,打上，敲打；beat at 在比赛中击败某人；beat on火般照晒；beat up搅拌；搅匀；殴打；put out恼怒的，烦乱的；put down放下;put off推迟；put on穿上。该题第一空是指，雨水敲打在窗户上，因此填 beat against；该题第二空的意思是，这对夫妻感到有些恼怒，因此填put out。所以这题选A。 【句意】雨水敲打在窗户上，声音使这对夫妻感到非常沮丧。

stem: 32. Mick always left his homework until the last minute. This often _____ him needing to stay up all night to finish the work.

stem: 33. Some types of social networking site are popular but access is usually _____to teenagers and children.

stem: 34. We surely can arrive at the destination on time but we d better _____ some happenings on the trip.

stem: 35. All the audience was quite disappointed at the performance for it was not so _____ .
choices: conspicuous<sep>dramatic<sep>professional<sep>occupational
analysis: 本题考查词汇辨析。conspicuous明显的；dramatic戏剧的；professional专业的；occupational职业的。根据句意，这里应该是表演不够专业，因此答案选C。 【句意】所有的观众都对表演感到失望，因为表演不是那么专业。

stem: 36. _____ the advances of science, the discomforts of old age will no doubt always be with us.
choices: As for<sep>Besides<sep>Despite<sep>Even if
analysis: 本题考查连词。As for至于；Besides此外；Despite尽管；Even if即使。根据句意，前后是让步的关系，因此答案选C。 【句意】尽管科学不断进步，但老年人的不适无疑将永远伴随着我们。

stem: 37._____pretty late, they decided to leave _____ , as they didn t want to risk missing the last bus.
choices: As it being; right away<sep>Been; immediately<sep>It being; at once<sep>It was being; right now
analysis: 语法题。此题考查非谓语动词的用法。本句为现在分词短语作原因状语，分词的主语和句于的主语不一致，因此C为正确答案 【句意】已经很晚了，我们决定立刻离开，因为我们不想误车。

stem: 38. My best friend and I _____our differences in different ways. I like to talk about them but he likes to ignore them and _____they don t exist.
choices: amend; find out<sep>deal with; pretend<sep>learn about; forget<sep>sort out; make sure
analysis: 本题考查词汇辨析。amend修正，修订；deal with处理；learn about获得，学得; sort out分类。find out发现；pretend假装；forget忘记；make sure确信。根据句意，第一空的difference矛盾，分歧应该是搭配的是处理deal with；第二空意思是忽视这些矛盾，假装这些矛盾不存在。因此答案选B。 【句意】我和我最好的朋友以不同的方式处理我们之间的分歧。 我喜欢谈论它们，但他喜欢忽略它们，并假装它们不存在。

stem: 39. The doctor warns me that eating too much fat can _____heart disease and cause high blood pressure.
choices: attribute to<sep>contribute to<sep>devote to<sep>subscribe to
analysis: 本题考查固定搭配。attribute to归因于；contribute to导致；devote to专心于；subscribe to订阅。根据句意可知，这里应该是导致的意思，因此答案选B。 【句意】医生警告我，过多食用脂肪会导致心脏病并导致高血压。

stem: 40. Mr. Johnson left for the office earlier than usual _____traffic jam.
choices: at the risk of<sep>for the sake of<sep>in case of<sep>in spite of
analysis: 本题考查固定搭配。at the risk of 冒可能……的危险；for the sake of为了；in case of以防；万一；in spite of尽管。根据句意，这里应该是“以防，万一”的意思，因此答案选C。 【句意】以防发生交通堵塞，约翰逊先生比平时更早去了办公室。

stem: 41. Government reports, examination compositions, legal documents and most letters are the main situations _____formal language is used.
choices: at what<sep>in that<sep>in which<sep>on which
analysis: 本题考查语法。situation后面接定语从句修饰situation，又因situation前必须加上in才能构成介词短语放在句中，也就是in situation 在……状况下，将定语从句还原级Formal language is used in these situations，所以当它语序调整的时候in要留着，最后这里应该填in which，因此答案选择C。 【句意】政府报告、考场作文、法律文件和大多数商业信件是正式语言被使用的主要场合。

stem: 42. If something such as a painting or piece of writing is _____ , it is genuine rather than being an imitation.
choices: authentic<sep>authoritative<sep>exemplary<sep>solitary
analysis: 本题考查词汇辨析。authentic真品的，真迹的；authoritative命令式的，权威的；exemplary典范的；solitary单独的。根据句意，这里是“真实的，真迹”的意思，因此答案选A。 【句意】如果诸如绘画或作品之类的东西是真迹，那它就是真实的，而不是一种模仿。

stem: 43. Our holidays were ruined by the weather: _____have stayed at home!
choices: it may be as well we<sep>it was just as well we<sep>we might just as well<sep>we might as well to
analysis: 本题考查语法。题目前半句说“我们的假期被天气破环了”，后半句是“……呆在家里”，既然是呆在家里，那主语肯定是人，因此根据选项主语肯定是we，而不是it。又因为might as well do sth. 表示建议，不妨做某事。因此本题答案选C。 【句意】我们的假期被天气破坏了：我们不妨呆在家里！

stem: 44. ― Oh, no! Commercials again! I m sick and tired of watching the same commercials over and over again. ― _____ ― Is there any way we can live without advertisements? ― I really doubt it.
choices: That s not fair!<sep>I know what you mean.<sep>Do you have another choice?<sep>Can you just stop it!
analysis: 情景交际题。A. 这并不公平！B. 我知道你的意思，我也有同感。C. 你还有其他的选择吗？D. 你能阻止它吗！这里的上文说广告又来了，他们很讨厌广告，因此同伴应该是感同身受，根据句意，本题选B。 【句意】—不好了！ 广告又来了！ 我厌倦了一次又一次地观看相同的广告。 —我也有同感。 —有什么办法可以让我们的生活没有广告吗? —我真的对此表示怀疑。

stem: 45. ― I do believe that patience and motivation are more important than one s IQ in achieving success. ― _____
choices: Neither do I.<sep>You are going too far.<sep>Does it work?<sep>That makes sense.
analysis: 情景交际题。A.我也不是。B.你走得太远了。C. 它有效吗？D. 有道理。根据上下文，这里同伴应该是赞成对方的话，因此答案选D。 【句意】—我确实相信，耐心和动力比智商更重要。 —有道理。

stem: 31. Because my sister played basketball really well in high school, she was able to get a full _______ for college.
choices: admission<sep>fee<sep>scholarship<sep>tuition
analysis: 【C】本题考查固定搭配。A. admission准许进入;承认，B.fee报酬;费用，C. scholarship奖学金，D. tuition学费。根据句意，C为正确答案。get a full scholarship获得全额奖学金。 【句意】因为我姐姐在高中打篮球特别棒，所以她能够获得大学全额奖学金。

stem: 32. Nowadays in most of families a _______ a amount of money has been spent on books.
choices: considered<sep>consideration<sep>considering<sep>considerable
analysis: 【D】本题考查形近词辨析。此题主要是针对由consider词根扩展的形近词进行辨析。considered是动词consider的过去式；consideration是名词,“考虑”；considering是介词，意为“考虑到……，鉴于…”；considerable是形容词，意为“大量的”。根据句意，D为正确答案。 【句意】当今，很多家庭都把大量的钱用于购买书籍。

stem: 33. The island s real name is Rapa Nui, but it is called Easter Island because it was first _______ by Europeans on Easter Sunday, 1722, which used to be _______ to thousands of Pacific island people.
choices: found; house<sep>known about; lived<sep>discovered; home<sep>built; populated
analysis: 【C】本题考查固定搭配。be discovered by意思是“被……(第一个、出乎意料地)发现”; be home to sb.意思是“某人的家园”。根据句意，C为正确答案。 【句意】这座岛的真实的名字叫拉帕努伊岛，是由欧洲人在1722年复活节的时候发现的,因此也称复活岛，而且过去一直是太平洋岛上人民的家园。

stem: 34. _______ the research uncovered some problems, the company decided to stop the project.
choices: Wherever<sep>Since<sep>Despite<sep>Although
analysis: 【B】本题考查连词。根据句意，前后两句应为因果关系。四个选项中，只有B选项since表示因果关系。故B为正确答案。 【句意】因为这项研究揭示了一些问题，公司决定放弃这个项目。

stem: 35. Surveys show that people these days are increasingly willing _______ corruption and wrongdoing. Whistleblowing is therefore _______ increase.
choices: to report; independent of<sep>to report; bound to<sep>to be reported; essential to<sep>to be reported; dependent on
analysis: 【B】本题考查形容词。be willing to do“愿意做某事”；be bound to do“一定要做”；independent of“独立于，不依赖于”；be essential to“对……至关重要”，dependent on“依赖于”。根据句意，正确答案是B。 【句意】研究表明人们最近越来越愿意举报腐败以及不法行为，因此吹哨预警也一定会增加。

stem: 36. Increased legal protection will give employees more confidence to _______ their employers.
choices: stand up to<sep>track down<sep>catch up with<sep>check out
analysis: 【A】本题考察固定搭配。stand up to“对抗；抗争”，track down“追踪；搜寻”，catch up with“追赶；赶上”，check out“核实；结账退房”。根据句意，正确答案是A。 【句意】法律保护的加强给雇员更多信心去和雇主抗争。

stem: 37. _______ a smoke detector will give your family a chance to escape _______ a fire. Ask at your local fire station for advice.
choices: Putting; in any case<sep>Fixing; in a case of<sep>Installing; in case of<sep>Hanging; in the case of
analysis: 【C】本题考察词组搭配。install“安装”；fix“修理，修补”；hang“悬挂”；in case of“假如，万一，如果发生”；in any case“无论如何”，in the case of“假使、如果发生”。根据题意，正确答案是C。 【句意】如果发生火灾，安装烟雾报警器会给家人逃离的机会。您可以到当地的消防站咨询。

stem: 38. Angela was surprised to get such a bad grade on the test because she _______ for it for a long time.
choices: has studied<sep>didn t study<sep>was studying<sep>had studied
analysis: 【D】本题考察过去完成时。根据题意，题中study这一动作，发生在be surprised to动作以前，并已经完成的动作，因此用过去完成时。因此正确答案是D。 【句意】安吉拉对于这次考试的糟糕分数非常吃惊，因为她为此学习了好久。

stem: 39. The crowds were excited when the soldiers finally arrived because they _______ for three hours.
choices: had to wait<sep>had been waiting<sep>were to wait<sep>have waited
analysis: 【B】本题考察过去完成进行时。题中表示等待的动作状态，一直持续到警察的到来，也未结束，因此应该用过去完成进行时。因此正确答案是B。 【句意】当士兵最后赶到的时候，人群非常激动，因为他们已经等了三个小时。

stem: 40. Those were the four men _______ had got an award for their contribution to the country and _______ photos appeared on the front page of yesterday s newspaper.
choices: who; whose<sep>when; who s<sep>when; whose<sep>who; who s
analysis: 【A】本题考察定语从句。先行词为指人的名词，且在从句中作主语，用who连接；当先行词在从句中作定语修饰名词时，用whose来引导，表示所属关系，某人的或某物的。根据句意，正确答案是A。 【句意】这四个人因对国家的贡献而获奖，他们的照片登上了昨天报纸的头版。

stem: 41. We never got away with anything in Mrs. Podell s class she had _______ like a hawk.
choices: claws<sep>eyes<sep>paws<sep>teeth
analysis: 【B】本题考察习惯用语。have eves like a hawk明察秋毫。 【句意】在波德尔女士的课上我们从没有侥幸逃脱过任何惩罚，因为她明察秋毫。

stem: 42. Under no circumstances _______ around alone after dark.
choices: should you wander<sep>you should wander<sep>should not you wander<sep>you should not wander
analysis: 【A】本题考察倒装用法。Under no circumstances放在句首，应采用部分倒装。所以正确答案是A。 【句意】在任何情况下，你都不应该在天黑后独自徘徊。

stem: 43. What if I told everyone what I thought of them? _______ that, conversation would be impossible.
choices: Were you to do<sep>Should you have done<sep>Would you do<sep>Might you do
analysis: 【A】本题考查虚拟语气。虚拟语气省略if的倒装规律：在虚拟语气中，如果有had / were / should等助动词，可将其提到句首，省略if，变成倒装句。因此A为正确答案。 【句意】——如果我告诉每个人我对他们的看法怎么办? ——如果你那么做的话，对话是不可能的。

stem: 44. Lisa, I heard that you got a new job. I didn t even know you were looking. Why did you change? Well, I started to apply for jobs about a month ago. You know, the pay at my old job was too low, and the hours were so long. Now, I make more money, and my working hours are shorter. That s great! _______
choices: Of course!<sep>You really flatter me.<sep>No problem.<sep>Congratulations!
analysis: 【D】情景交际题。congratulations可以表示对对方的祝贺、恭喜等。 【句意】——丽莎，我听说你换了新工作，我都不知道你在找工作。为什么换工作啊? ——嗯，我一个月前就开始申请工作了。你知道我原来工资低，时间长，现在工资高而且工作时间短。 ——那真是太好了，恭喜你!

stem: 45. Do you want something to eat? The film doesn t start for another ten minutes and I m pretty hungry. Sure, I ll have some popcorn. No butter, please, but make sure they put on a lot of salt. All of that salt is not good for you, and it will make you thirsty. _______ Yes. I would like an orange juice, please.
choices: Do you see films a lot, by the way?<sep>What would you like to drink?<sep>Could you do me a favour?<sep>Do you like to eat chocolate?
analysis: 【B】情景交际题。因为对话中答语为“我想要橘子汁”，不难选出正确答案是B，你想喝点什么? 【句意】—你想吃点什么？电影还有10分钟开始，而且我非常饿。 ——好啊，我想吃爆米花，不要加奶油，但一定要多盐。 ——那么多盐对你不好，而且会让你觉得口渴。你想喝点什么？ ——我想要橘子汁。

stem: In education there should be a good__________among the branches of knowledge that contribute effective thinking and wise judgment.
choices: assignment<sep>balance<sep>combination<sep>disposal
analysis: 【B】本题考查固定搭配。assignment意为“任务，职责”；combination意为“结合，联合”，常与介词with或between ... and连用；distribution意为“分配，分布”；balance意为“平衡”，可与介词among搭配。本题意思是教育过程中必须保持各学科的平衡，以助于提高有效思维和明智决定。根据题意和搭配选项 【B】balance为正确答案。

stem: The fact that the golden eagle usually builds its nest on some high cliffs__________it almost impossible to obtain the egg or the young birds.
choices: relates<sep>reckons<sep>regards<sep>renders
analysis: 【D】本题为形近动词辨析题。render意为“使得”；reckon意为“认为；测算；指望”；regard意为“认为，看作”；relate意为“相关；讲述”。本题中render it impossible to do something为常用结构，意为“使得做某事成为不可能”，故【D】为正确答案。

stem: As time went by, computers became smaller and more powerful and they became personal too, as well as__________, with display sharper and storage capacity increasing.
choices: institutional<sep>universal<sep>fundamental<sep>beneficial
analysis: 【A】本题为句意理解题。随着时间的推移，电脑体积越来越小，功能越来越强大，它们成为了“个人”电脑和机构团体使用的电脑，其显示器越来越清晰，存储容量也越来越大。universal意为“普遍的；全体的；全世界的；共同的”，fundamental“十分重大的；根本的”，beneficial“有利的；有裨益的；有用的”，根据句意，应选择【A】institutional（机构的）。

stem: However, growth in the fabricated metals industry was able to__________some of the decline in the iron and steel industry.
choices: overcome<sep>overtake<sep>offset<sep>oppress
analysis: 【C】本题为动词词义辨析题。overcome意为“战胜”；overtake意为“追上，超越”；offset意为“抵消；补偿”；oppress则常用于被动语态，意为“压迫，压制”。本句中一方在增长，而另一方却在衰退，当然是相互“抵消”了，因此正确答案为【C】。

stem: This does not mean that adults must accept irresponsibility. __________, they can help students acquire a sense of commitment by having clearly stated rules.
choices: On the contrary<sep>On the average<sep>On the whole<sep>On the other hand
analysis: 【A】根据句意，可知前后是一种对立对比关系。“这并不意味着成年人不负责任，与此恰恰相反，他们要帮助学生学会承担义务”，因此【A】on the contrary为正确答案。【B】on the average意为“一般地说”；【C】on the whole意为“大体上,基本上”；【D】on the other hand意为“另一方面”，须和on one hand一起使用，也不符合上下文的意思。

stem: Otherwise, we will have__________giving to others our independence of thought and action.
choices: conveyed to<sep>consented to<sep>conformed to<sep>confided to
analysis: 【B】convey to“表达，传递（思想、感情等）” ；consent to“同意；准许；允许”；conform to“遵守，遵从，服从（规则、法律等）”；confide to“（向某人）吐露（秘密、隐私等）”。句意是“否则，我们将同意把我们的思想和行动的独立性交给他人。”故选B。

stem: More colleges are__________to let students sit in judgement on classmates__________bullying to curb Britain s classroom violence.
choices: concerned; blaming for<sep>crusading; relied on<sep>poised; accused of<sep>opposing; carrying out
analysis: 【C】句意：越来越多的学校准备让孩子们对那些被控恃强凛弱的同学进行评判，从而来控制英国的校园暴力。be poised to随时准备着；be accused of被指责；被指控；crusade长期坚定不移地奋斗；carry out执行；进行；完成。

stem: Has Lily finished writing her composition? No, but it__________an hour ago.
choices: should finish<sep>should be finished<sep>should have finished<sep>should have been finished
analysis: 【D】No表示作文还没有写完。should have done表示本该做还没有做。这里意思是她本该一个小时前完成作文，同时，作文是被完成，应该使用被动语态，故填should have been finished。

stem: Church, mosque and temple as we use the words refer to religious institutions, they Christian,__________Jewish, Islamic, Buddhist, and so on.
choices: be<sep>being<sep>were<sep>are
analysis: 【A】本题是省略whether和might后主谓倒装的让步状语从句，恢复后应为Church as we use the word refers to all religious institutions, whether they might be Christian, Islamic, Buddhist, Jewish, and so on. 句子意思：我们使用教会这个词来指称所有宗教机构，无论是基督教、伊斯兰教、佛教还是犹太教等等。

stem: Conversation becomes weaker in society that spends so much time listening and being talked to__________it has all but lost the will and the skill to speak for itself.
choices: that<sep>what<sep>which<sep>as
analysis: 【A】译文：在一个人们花很多时间听他人说话和听他人对自己说话的社会，社会已经失去了为自身说话的意愿和技巧，这时会话的力量就变弱了。第一个that引导的是以society为先行词的定语从句。so和第二个that构成so...that...句型，表示“太…以至于/以致”。that引导的是结果状语从句。spend time( in) doing sth.表示“花时间做某事”。介词but出现在all之后表示“除…之外什么都没有”，用以表示强调。

stem: So involved with their computers__________that leaders at summer computer camps often have to force them to break for sports and games.
choices: became the children<sep>become the children<sep>did the children become<sep>have the children become
analysis: 【D】当so，such用于句首加强语气时，要用倒装句。本题中so involved with their computers位于句首，说明孩子们对电脑非常着迷，句中的谓语动词become要部分倒装，由于是一般过去，因此正确的倒装形式为did the children be come。

stem: Among isolated peoples, who are not often reached__________traders__________outside, commerce usually means barter.
choices: of; from<sep>from; by<sep>by; from<sep>of; by
analysis: 【C】句意：在与世隔绝的民族中，外界的商人往往接触不到他们，商业通常意味着物物交换。此处，by是被动语态中引出动作发出者的介词，from表示这些商人是来自外界。

stem: Hey, Janet, have you finished the report yet? Sarah was asking about it. I m afraid not. I m about to go to Rome for a conference and I won t be able to finish the report before I go. Oh. __________ The conference only lasts three days, so I m not in Rome for long just the weekend. Then I ll be working on the report all next week.
choices: When do you think it will be ready?<sep>What are you going to talk about?<sep>Where will the conference be held?<sep>How long will you need to finish the report?
analysis: 【A】A选项：你认为什么时候会准备好？；B选项：你打算谈些什么？；C选项：会议将在哪里举行？；D选项：你需要多长时间来完成报告？根据下文可知，“会议只持续三天，所以我在罗马的时间不长，只有周末。然后，那我下周整个星期都在写报告。”，这是对A选项的呼应。

stem: OK, so it s Millie s turn to give her tutorial today, isn t it? That s right. I m going to talk about renewable energy sources, and specifically solar towers. I m not sure how much you already know about solar towers, so I thought I d start with a few questions. __________ Don t they somehow use the sun s energy to create electricity?
choices: To start with, do you know how old this idea is?<sep>First of all, does anyone know how solar towers work?<sep>If these towers are so tall, how do they cope in high winds?<sep>Everyone seems to know something about the towers, don t they?
analysis: 【B】A选项：首先，你知道这个想法有多久了吗？；B选项：首先，有人知道太阳能塔是怎么工作的吗？；C选项：如果这些塔这么高，它们如何应对大风？；D选项：似乎每个人都对这些塔有所了解，不是吗？根据下文可知，“他们不是以某种方式利用太阳的能量来发电吗？”，可知选B。

stem: Well, today s topic for debate is home schooling . And the question we re asking is, Is it better for us to educate our children at home than send them to school? What do you think, Tina? ____________Personally, I feel the teachers did a really good job and I have benefited from the experience. What about you, Nick?
choices: If he d been educated at home, he d probably feel quite different.<sep>Well, I went to a normal school and enjoyed playing with schoolmates.<sep>I think being educated at home would be a good choice for children.<sep>Well, I was educated at an ordinary school and I don t have any regrets.
analysis: 【D】A选项：如果他在家里接受教育，他的感觉可能会很不同。；B选项：嗯，我上的是普通学校，喜欢和同学们一起玩。；C选项：我认为在家里接受教育对孩子来说是个不错的选择。；D选项：嗯，我在一所普通学校接受教育，我没有任何遗憾? 根据下文可知，“就我个人而言，我觉得老师们做得非常好，我从这段经历中受益匪浅。”可知Tina没有在家接受教育，B选项“和同学们一起”玩和后文并没有关系。

stem: 31. Brighton is literally overflowing _____ hotels, guest houses and bed and breakfasts so you can still find accommodation at the last minute.
choices: about<sep>with<sep>under<sep>for
analysis: 【B】本题考查固定搭配。overflow with 充满着。该题的意思是，布林顿有非常多旅馆，因此填overflow with。所以这题选B。 【句意】布莱顿的酒店、招待所、住宿和早餐实在是太多了，所以你仍然可以在最后一刻找到住宿。

stem: 32. Would you spend money on a product claiming to make you invisible or _____ one that allegedly helps you to lose weight while asleep?
choices: else<sep>other<sep>an other<sep>another
analysis: 【D】本题考查词汇辨析。else别的；other其他; an other又一；another另一个。根据句意，这里应该是指另一个产品，因此选D。 【句意】你会把钱花在一个声称能让你隐形的产品上，或者一个号称能帮你在睡觉时减肥的产品上吗？

stem: 33. I d sooner you _____ your essay now along with the others.
choices: did hand in<sep>had handed in<sep>hand in<sep>handed in
analysis: 【D】本题考查语法。would sooner do sth. 宁愿做某事，考察虚拟语气，主句would do，虚拟语气用一般过去时，因此答案选D。 【句意】我希望你现在就把论文和其他人的一起交上来。

stem: 34. We should try to reduce the cost of _____ as much as possible.
choices: trip<sep>journey<sep>travel<sep>voyage
analysis: 【C】本题考查词汇辨析。trip短程旅行；journey行程；travel旅游；voyage航海。根据句意，这里应该是减少旅游的开支，因此答案选C。 【句意】我们应该尽量减少旅行的费用。

stem: 35. An _____ is made up from the first letters of the name of something like an organization or a product.
choices: acronym<sep>appendix<sep>alignment<sep>abbreviation
analysis: 【A】本题考查词汇辨析。acronym首字母缩略词；appendix附录；alignment对齐；abbreviation缩写。根据句意，首字母缩略词是由某个组织或产品名称的首字母组成的，因此答案选A。 【句意】首字母缩略词是由某个组织或产品名称的首字母组成的。

stem: 36. Polar bears and seals were _____ on camera by a photographer who grew up in the Arctic and was trained _____ a marine biologist.
choices: spotted; by<sep>witnessed; for<sep>captured; as<sep>observed; to
analysis: 【C】本题考查词汇辨析。spotted发现; witnessed目击; captured捕捉; observed观察; 第一空指北极熊和海豹被看到，第二空指摄影师被当做海洋生物学家来训练，因此是be trained as，答案选C。 【句意】一名在北极长大、受过海洋生物学家训练的摄影师用相机捕捉到了北极熊和海豹。

stem: 37. Tina kept _____ at her watch to check how much time she had to finish the exam.
choices: gazing<sep>noticing<sep>glancing<sep>viewing
analysis: 【C】本题考查词汇辨析。gaze凝视；notice注意；glance一瞥；view观察，本题指Tina考试时不停瞥她的表来关注时间，因此C为正确答案。 【句意】蒂娜不停地看表，看还有多少时间才能完成考试。

stem: 38. These viewpoints were _____ self-evident when Galileo first suggested them.
choices: at any rate<sep>by no means<sep>in any case<sep>on the average
analysis: 【B】本题考查固定搭配。at any rate无论如何；by no means绝不；in any case在任何情况下；on the average平均。根据句意，答案选B。 【句意】当伽利略第一次提出这些观点时，它们绝不是不证自明的。

stem: 39. Representatives are _____ an investigation into the scandal.
choices: calling for<sep>calling out<sep>calling in<sep>calling up
analysis: 【A】本题考查固定搭配。call for要求；call out大声喊；call in召集；call up号召。根据句意可知，这里应该是议员们要求调查的意思，因此答案选A。 【句意】议员们要求对这一丑闻进行调查。

stem: 40. I always enjoy spending time with Dick because he s got such a fantastically _____ sense of humour.
choices: contradictory<sep>quirky<sep>conventional<sep>skeptical
analysis: 【B】本题考查词汇辨析。contradictory矛盾的；quirky奇怪的；conventional传统的；skeptical怀疑的。根据句意，这里应该是"奇特的幽默感"的意思，因此答案选B。 【句意】我总是喜欢和迪克在一起，因为他有一种奇特的幽默感。

stem: 41. _____ his research, Dr. Olsweus has designed a program that has reduced bullying _____ 50 percent in 42 Norwegian schools.
choices: For sake of; to<sep>On the basis of; by<sep>In response to; by<sep>With regard to; to
analysis: 【B】本题考查固定搭配。For sake of为了; On the basis of基于；In response to作为回应; With regard to以示敬意。Reduce sth. by...减少了...因此答案选择B。 【句意】基于他的研究，Olsweus博士设计了一个项目，在42所挪威学校减少了50%的欺凌行为。

stem: 42. Once known as the Golden State because of its gold mine, _____ .
choices: there are few metallic minerals mined in North Carolina today<sep>today in North Carolina few metallic minerals are mined<sep>North Carolina today mines few metallic minerals<sep>few metallic minerals are mined in North Carolina today
analysis: 【C】本题考查句意理解。题目前半句说“北卡罗莱纳曾因金矿而被称为‘金州’，根据句意，人们大量开采金矿，北卡罗莱纳现在已经很少开采金属矿物了。 【句意】北卡罗莱纳曾因金矿而被称为‘金州’，现在已经很少开采金属矿物了。

stem: 43. _____ all her success, Taylor has firmly avoided the glitzy glare of fashion s fast lane.
choices: Despite<sep>Along with<sep>Owing to<sep>Even
analysis: 【A】本题考查词汇辨析。Despite即使；Along with随着；Owing to由于；Even虽然。本题前后两个半句是让步关系，因此本题答案选A。 【句意】尽管泰勒取得了成功，但她一直坚决避开时尚快车道上耀眼的光芒。

stem: 44. How are things going with you and your roommate? Not very well. We re supposed to share the groceries, but I end up feeding him three meals a day. My grocery bill is huge, you know. I know how you feel. I used to have a roommate like that too. I just don t know how to tell him that he should pay half the grocery bill, because sometimes he treats me to a meal in a restaurant. Well, _____ Maybe you just need to have a heart-to-heart talk with him. If he refuses to mend his ways, then ask him to move out.
choices: behind bad luck comes good luck.<sep>by the skin of your teeth.<sep>what s done cannot be undone.<sep>honesty is the best policy.
analysis: 【D】情景交际题。A.坏运气之后是好运。B.差一点；C.覆水难收；D.诚实是最好的策略。这里的提到和舍友之间的矛盾，同伴建议他开诚布公地和舍友谈一谈，根据句意，本题选D。 【句意】——你和你室友最近怎么样? ——不太好。我们本来应该分享食品杂货，但我最后一天买三顿饭。你知道，我的购物账单是一大笔。 ——我知道你的感受。我以前也有一个这样的室友。 ——我只是不知道蒺我不知道如何告诉他，他应该支付一半的食品杂货账单，因为有时他请我去餐厅吃饭。 ——好吧，也许你只需要和他谈心，诚实是最好的策略。如果他拒绝改变，叫他搬出去。

stem: 45. John: She s really pretty, isn t she? Her skin looks so baby smooth! Becky: Well, it s just that she puts lots of make-up on her face. Actually, _____ John: Ah, I can smell jealousy in the air!
choices: I don t care what other people think.<sep>natural beauty comes from within.<sep>I really miss the good old days.<sep>you d better take care of yourself.
analysis: 【B】情景交际题。A.我不在乎别人怎么想。B.自然美来自内在。C.我真的很想念过去的好时光。D.你最好照顾好自己。根据上下文，这里Becky认为那个女孩是通过化浓妆来变美，因此答案选B。 【句意】约翰：她真漂亮，是吗？她的皮肤看起来像婴儿一样光滑！ 贝琪：嗯，她只是在脸上化了很多妆。实际上，自然美来自内在。 约翰：啊，我能闻到空气中嫉妒的味道！

stem: Catherine set _____ to write a short novel, but it got longer and longer as she wrote it.
choices: about<sep>in<sep>off<sep>out
analysis: 本题考察set的相关短语。set about：动手，开始，后常加动词的ing形式表示“开始做某事”；set in：（不好的事情）产生，开始；set off：出发,侧重于去某个地方，后常加“for+地点”表示“出发去某地”；set out：开始，侧重于（怀着目标）开始工作，展开任务，后常加动词不定式表示“开始做某事”。由句意“Catherine开始创作一本短篇小说，但是写着写着却越写越长”和set短语后面的不定式可知，本题应该选择set out to do来表示开始某项任务。故本题选D。

stem: They started the business in _____ of making a lot of money quickly, but things didn t work _____ that way.
choices: belief; in<sep>certainty; on<sep>expectation; out<sep>likelihood; to
analysis: 本题考查词汇和work相关短语。belief，信仰；certainty，确定性；expectation，期望；likelihood，可能性。work in，把…加进；把…混入；work on，从事，继续做某事；work out，进展（顺利），完成；work to，根据…行事。由句意“开始做生意时，他们期望着能很快挣到很多钱，但是事情并没有按期望的方向进展。”可知C选项比较合适。故本题选C。

stem: Unfortunately, the clerk _____to tell me that the ticket I bought was not valid before 9 am.
choices: disregarded<sep>ignored<sep>missed<sep>omitted
analysis: 本题考查词汇。disregard，不理会，漠视，侧重于故意不理睬；ignore，忽视，不予理睬，侧重于有意识不理睬；miss，丢失，避开；omit，漏掉，遗漏，可表示有意或者因疏忽而忘记。由句意“不幸的是，那个职员忘记告诉我我买的票9点前无效”可推断原文应该是因疏忽而忘记的意思，D选项比较合适。故本题选D。

stem: The CEO of the company seemed to be _____ to losing and didn t make much more effort.
choices: suspected<sep>resigned<sep>agreeable<sep>content
analysis: 本题考查形容词。be suspected to，对...持怀疑态度；be resigned to，听任...，顺从...；be agreeable to，同意...；be content to，对...满意。由句意“公司总裁似乎已经听任了他们的失败，不再做出更多努力了”可以推断出原文需要 “听任，顺从”的意思，B选项比较合适。故本题选B。

stem: When questioned by the press, the Minister of Foreign Affairs _____to discuss the matter.
choices: declined<sep>denied<sep>rejected<sep>refuted
analysis: 本题考查动词。decline，谢绝，婉拒；deny，拒绝，否认；reject，拒绝，不予考虑；refute，反驳，驳斥。由句意“当被记者提问时，外交部长婉拒了这件事的讨论”可知A选项“婉拒”比较符合题干的情形。故本题选A。

stem: Much of what the chairperson said had little _____to the issue we were focusing on today.
choices: accordance<sep>concern<sep>involvement<sep>relevance
analysis: 本题考查名词。accordance，一致；concern，关心，担心；involvement，加入，插手；relevance，相关性，关联。由句意“主席所说的很多都与我们今天所关注的问题没有什么关系”可知D选项比较合适。故本题选D。

stem: She paints _____ for pleasure, not because she wants to make any money out of it.
choices: carefully<sep>directly<sep>purely<sep>tremendously
analysis: 本题考查副词。carefully，细心地；directly，直接地；purely，纯粹地，仅仅； tremendously，极大地，非常地。由句意“她画画仅仅是为了快乐，而不是想从中赚钱”可知C选项比较合适。故本题选C。

stem: I m not _____ your version of events but I think that you have interpreted them wrongly.
choices: disputing<sep>discharging<sep>diffusing<sep>differing
analysis: 本题考查动词。dispute，质疑（事实、声明或理论），对…表示异议；discharge，准许（某人）离开；解雇；diffuse，传播，扩散；differ，不同于，有别。由句意“我不是在质疑你对事件的描述，但是我觉得你对事件的解释有误”可知A选项比较合适。故本题选A。

stem: _____, the purpose of the United Nations is to maintain peace and security and encourage respect for human rights.
choices: Broad speaking<sep>Broadly speaking<sep>Broadly spoken<sep>Speaking broadly
analysis: 本题考查固定搭配。broadly speaking，总的来说，概括地说，固定搭配。本题题干句意是“总的来说，联合国的宗旨是维护和平与安全，鼓励尊重人权。”故本题选B。

stem: The problem of studying, _____enough to start with, becomes almost impossible when you are trying to do _____in one weekend.
choices: hard; three weeks work<sep>hardly; three week s workout<sep>heavy; three week s workforce<sep>unpleasant; three weeks workload
analysis: 本题考查词汇。hard，作副词时表“努力地，艰难地”；hardly，副词，几乎不；heavy，作副词时表“大量地”；unpleasant，形容词，不愉快的。work，作为名词时表示“工作，功课”；workout，训练，锻炼；workforce，劳动力，全体员工；workload，工作量，工作负担。由句意“学习这件事，一开始就已经很困难，而当你试图在一个周末完成三周的功课时，就变得几乎不可能了。”可知A选项比较合适。故本题选A。

stem: Many managers in service industries are more comfortable _____demands for more money than with demands for better communication.
choices: bringing down<sep>coping with<sep>depending on<sep>working out
analysis: 本题考查短语。bring down，击败，垮台；cope with，对付，应对；depend on，依赖，取决于；work out，进展（顺利），完成。由句意“相比起寻求更佳沟通的需求，许多服务行业的管理者更愿意应对寻求更多资金的需求。”可知B选项比较合适。故本题选B。

stem: Mr. Smith had an unusual _____: he was first an office clerk, then a sailor, and ended up as a school teacher.
choices: career<sep>occupation<sep>position<sep>profession
analysis: 本题考查名词。选项所提供的词汇均有工作，职业的意思，但career侧重于职业生涯；occupation侧重于行业，事业；position侧重于职位；profession侧重于具有某种专业知识的职业。由句意“史密斯先生有着与众不同的职业生涯：他先是一名办公室职员，然后是一名水手，最后成为一名学校教师。”可知这里应该使用career表示职业生涯。故本题选A。

stem: After the lecture, the students said that they didn t quite _____and asked me to repeat what I had said.
choices: attend to<sep>catch on<sep>sum up<sep>watch out
analysis: 本题考查短语。attend to，处理，照顾；catch on，明白，懂得；sum up，总结，概括；watch out，小心，提防。由句意“讲座结束后，学生们说他们不太明白，让我重复一遍”可知B选项比较合适。故本题选B。

stem: ― What s your research subject for this semester? ― Sea Plants. I m going to study sea plants in Antarctica. ― _____I m thinking of Women in East Asia.
choices: What do you think of modern women s lives?<sep>Have you ever read The Little Women ?<sep>What subject do you have in mind?<sep>This was how they were treated.
analysis: 本题考查句子衔接。A选项句子意思是，你觉得现代女性的生活怎么样；B选项句子意思是，你读过《小妇人》吗；C选项句子意思是，你正在考虑什么课题；D选项句子意思是，他们就是这样被对待的。由对话意思：“——这学期你的研究课题是什么？——‘海洋植物’。我要研究南极洲的海洋植物。——_____。我正在考虑‘东亚妇女。’”可知选项的意思应该是“你在考虑什么课题呢？”，所以C选项比较能够衔接上下文。故本题选C。

stem: ― You know Dr. Johnson, don t you? He s acting in a rather strange way these days. ― _____ ― He gave me a weird look this morning. ― Maybe it s because you dyed your hair red.
choices: Don t you think he s handsome?<sep>How come you look so worried?<sep>Is he related to you?<sep>What are you driving at?
analysis: 本题考查句子衔接。A选项句子意思是，你不觉得他很帅吗；B选项句子意思是，你怎么看起来这么担心；C选项句子意思是，他和你有关系吗；D选项句子意思是，你意指什么。由对话意思：“——你认识约翰逊医生对吧？这些天他表现得很奇怪。——_____。——今天早上他奇怪地看了我一眼。——也许是因为你把头发染成了红色。”可知选项的意思应该是“你指的那件事？”，所以C选项比较能够衔接上下文。故本题选C。

stem: 31. I know Megan seems nosey, but her _____ are good; she only wants to help.
choices: intentions<sep>plans<sep>aspirations<sep>beliefs
analysis: 【A】本题考察名词辨析。intention：目的，意图；plan：计划；aspiration：渴望，抱负；belief：信仰。由句意“我知道梅根看起来有点多管闲事了，但是她的意图是好的，她只是想帮忙。”可知，本题应该选择intentions来表示“目的，意图”。故本题选A。

stem: 32. Albert is remarkably _____ ; he can come up with a solution for any problem that comes his way.
choices: ambitious<sep>resourceful<sep>reluctant<sep>impatient
analysis: 【B】本题考查形容词辨析。ambitious，有野心的；resourceful，机敏的，足智多谋的；reluctant，不情愿的；impatient，没耐心的。由句意“艾伯特非常机智，他能想出解决他所遇到的所有问题的办法。”可知，B选项“机敏的，足智多谋的”比较合适。故本题选B。

stem: 33. My friend Tammy is very _____ . She always surprises us with her behaviour.
choices: uncertain<sep>unprejudiced<sep>unpredictable<sep>unaware

stem: 34. Managers prefer to select people who have been _____ to many different types of office environments.
choices: displayed<sep>exposed<sep>opened<sep>experienced
analysis: 【B】本题考查动词辨析。display，展出，显示，及物动词，后面直接加名词；expose，暴露，揭露，及物动词，常用介词搭配为expose sb. to sth.，意思为“使接触，使体验”；open，打开，展开，及物动词，后面直接加名词；experience，经历，体验，及物动词，后面直接加名词。在本题中，我们发现横线后面还有一个介词to，再由句意“经理更倾向于选择体验过不同办公环境的人”可知，这儿应该使用搭配“expose sb. to sth.，使接触，使体验”，且为被动形式。由此可知B选项比较合适。故本题选B。

stem: 35. Jim _____ talking about his success for so long that we began to feel annoyed.
choices: set up<sep>carried out<sep>set in<sep>carried on
analysis: 【D】本题考查短语辨析。set up，建立，设立；carry out，实施，执行；set in，（不好的事情）产生，开始；carry on，继续，坚持，喋喋不休。由句意“吉姆喋喋不休地讨论着他的成功，说得时间太长以至于我们开始感到不耐烦。”可知，D选项“继续，喋喋不休”比较符合题干的情形。故本题选D。

stem: 36. Jack s plan is to lose 5 pounds by this summer. He will try to exercise more and _____ eating sweet things.

analysis: 【A】本题考查短语辨析。cut down on，削减，减少；get rid of，摆脱，甩掉；put up with，忍受，容忍；run up against，突然遇到(问题)，突然碰到(困难)。由句意“杰克计划今年夏天减掉5磅。他将努力多运动，少吃甜食。”可知，A选项比较合适。故本题选A。

stem: 37. John is very persistent. He won t _____ no matter how difficult it is. He ll keep trying.
choices: mix up<sep>keep up<sep>break up<sep>give up
analysis: 【D】本题考查短语辨析。mix up，混淆，弄混；keep up，坚持，跟上；break up，分裂，结束（关系）； give up，放弃，认输。由句意“约翰非常执着。不管有多困难，他都不会放弃。他会一直尝试。”可知，D选项“放弃，认输”比较合适。故本题选D。

stem: 38. Susan would really like to join the debate team but she _____ ever has any free time.
choices: nearly<sep>almost<sep>neither<sep>hardly
analysis: 【D】本题考查副词辨析。nearly，几乎，差不多；almost，几乎，差不多；neither，也不；hardly，几乎不。由句意“苏珊很想加入辩论队，但她几乎没有空闲时间”可知，本题需要表否定意义的副词，排除A选项和B选项。C选项意思是“也不”，不合题意，而D选项“几乎不”比较合适。故本题选D。

stem: 39. I don t know when the rain will stop. It _____ all morning and the sky is still dark.
choices: has been raining<sep>rains<sep>rained<sep>had rained
analysis: 【A】本题考查动词时态。由句意“我不知道雨什么时候能停。整个早晨都一直在下雨，天依然很黑。”可知，雨应该是从过去的某个时间点开始下，并且持续到现在，且一直在进行中。因此，本题应该使用现在完成进行时态，A选项符合题意，故本题选A。

stem: 40. The content of the second lecture in the Tiangong Class series was selected from opinions and suggestions collected from the public, and has been designed _____ facility conditions on China s space station.
choices: on top of<sep>in spite of<sep>in line with<sep>instead of
analysis: 【C】本题考查短语辨析。on top of，在…之上，完全控制某事物；in spite of，尽管，不管；in line with，符合……的（地），与……一致的（地）；instead of，而不是，代替。由句意“‘天宫课堂’系列第二讲的内容是从公众提出的意见和建议中选出的，并且其设计也符合中国空间站的设施条件。”可知，C选项比较合适。故本题选C。

stem: 41. Two members of your group have not arrived yet. Should we continue to wait? I m worried. Something _____ to Mark because he s never late and hasn t missed even one rehearsal so far.
choices: ought to happen<sep>must have happened<sep>is happening<sep>may happen
analysis: 【B】本题考查动词时态。ought to happen，应该遇到；must have happened，一定已经遇到了；is happening，正在遇到；may happen，可能遇到。再由句意“——你组内的两名成员尚未到达。我们还要继续等待吗？——我有点担心。马克一定是遇到了一些事，因为他从来没有迟到过，迄今为止甚至没有错过一次排练。”可知，说话者的语气比较肯定，认为马克之前从未迟到过，今天一定是遇到了什么事情，且到目前这一刻事情已经发生了，所以用must和现在完成时态比较合适。故本题选B。

stem: 42. Can I go to the local club? Yes, _____ you are back before midnight.
choices: in order that<sep>on condition that<sep>until<sep>nevertheless
analysis: 【B】本题考查连词辨析。in order that，为了；on condition that，在…条件下，条件是；until，直到；nevertheless，然而，不过。由句意“——我可以去当地的俱乐部吗？——可以，条件是你午夜前要回来”可知，这里应该使用on condition that。故本题选B。

stem: 43. Do you mind if I see what s on the other channel? _____. I wasn t really watching this anyway.

stem: 44. How long have you been looking for a new job? I just started this week. Didn t you have any interviews with those firms that came to our campus last month? stem: 31. There were many people present and he appeared only for a few seconds, so I only caught a _____ of him.

stem: 32. A thorough study of biology requires _____ with the properties of trees and plants, and the habit of birds and beasts.

stem: 34. Mr Wang had an unusual _____ : he was first an office clerk, then a sailor, and ended up as a school teacher.

stem: 35. Tom s mother tried hard to persuade him to _____from his intention to invest his savings in the stock market.

stem: 36. Computer studies of the decrease in mammoth numbers suggest that it was a particular _____ of over-hunting by humans and _____ in the climate at the time which led to their disappearance.

stem: 38. Strangely, some people find that they can smell one type of flower but not another, _____others are sensitive to the smells of both flowers.
choices: when<sep>since<sep>for<sep>whereas
analysis: 句意：奇怪的是，有些人发现他们能闻到一种花香，却闻不到另一种花香，而另一些人却可以闻到这两种。前后两个句子完整不缺任何成分，同时两个小句间由逗号连接，因此，该处为逻辑衔接词；接下来，我们对比前后两个句子之间的句子意思，前面部分“some people find that they can smell one type of flower but not another”（有些人发现他们能闻到一种花香，却闻不到另一种花香），后面一句“others are sensitive to the smells of both flowers”（另一些人却可以闻到这两种），在这两个小句子中，不难发现，句子之间是转折关系，而四个选项中只有whereas能用于引导表示转折关系的并列句。when考虑到，既然，当…时，在…时；since 因为，由于，既然，自…以来，自…以后；for 为了，因为，给，对于，至于，适合于；whereas然而，鉴于，反之。

stem: 40. Why didn t you come to Wang Li s birthday party yesterday? Well, I _____ , but I forgot it.

analysis: 句意为：你昨天为什么没有来王莉的生日派对你呢？我本来要去的，但是我忘记了。根据句意“我本应该去的，但是我忘记了”以及but后面的forgot可知，本句表示的是与过去事实相反的虚拟语气，前面应该使用“情态动词+have done”的形式，排除A、B两项。must have done一定做了某事，表推测，而不表示虚拟；should have done表示本应该做某事，实际上却未做，本题在have的后面承前省略了come，符合句意，故C正确。本题考查虚拟语气，but是个含蓄的虚拟条件句，所以一定要根据上下文语境，理解句意。另外，还要记牢情态动词+have done的意思，must have done过去肯定做了某事，should have done 本应该做而实际未做，can't have done 过去不可能做了某事，shouldn't have done 本不应该做而实际做了，need have done 本有必要做某事，needn't have done本没有必要做某事。

stem: 31. The longer you go without practising a language, the more your language skills will _____.
choices: delay<sep>intervene<sep>diminish<sep>multiply
analysis: 【C】本题考查近义词辨析。句意为“你不练习一种语言的时间越长，你的语言技能就会下降越多。”A选项delay“延迟”；B选项intervene“干涉”；C选项diminish“减损、损耗”；D选项multiply“成倍增加”。因此横线处只有C选项符合题意，故正确答案为C项。

stem: 32. Researchers have a programme _____ mind where a computer chip, installed in the brain, will save memories in order _____ they can later be transferred onto a computer.
choices: on; that<sep>with; to<sep>in; that<sep>for; to
analysis: 【C】本题考查介词搭配。句意为“科学家正在脑海中构思一个项目，计划将电脑芯片植入人脑，可以储存人的记忆以供日后将记忆输入电脑之用。”“have…in mind”表示“思考、构思”；“in order that”表示“为了……，以供……之用，后面接句子，in order to后面接不定式。因此横线处只有C选项符合题意，故正确答案为C项。

stem: 33. _____ school policy, the students had a holiday between Christmas and New Year.
choices: On behalf of<sep>With the exception of<sep>In case of<sep>In line with
analysis: 【D】本题考查固定搭配。句意为“配合学校政策安排，学生们在圣诞节和新年之间度过了节日。”A选项on behalf of“代表……；以……的名义”；B选项with the exception of“除去、除了”；C选项in case of“在……的情况下”；D选项in line with“与……一致”，引申为“按照”。因此横线处只有“与……一致”符合题意，故正确答案为D项。

stem: 34. If Tom _____ so fast, he wouldn t _____.
choices: hadn t been driving; have been injured<sep>hadn t been driving; have injured<sep>didn t drive; have injured<sep>didn t drive; have been injured
analysis: 【A】本题考查虚拟语气。句意为“如果汤姆当时没有把车开那么快，他就不会受伤了。”对过去的事实虚拟，从句用had done形式。在采用省略if的倒装结构时，需将had提前，主句则使用would have done的形式。故正确答案为B项。

stem: 35. Poems often contain words that _____.
choices: spin<sep>circle<sep>recycle<sep>rhyme
analysis: 【D】本题考查近义词辨析，句意为“诗歌常常包含押韵的词汇。”A选项spin“纺织，转圈”；B选项circle“盘旋，旋转；环行”；C选项recycle“回收”；D选项rhyme“押韵”因此横线处只有“押韵”符合题意，故正确答案为D项。

stem: 36. Buckingham Palace, Windsor Castle and the Palace of Holyroodhouse are the official _____ of the Sovereign and, as such, serve as both home and office for the Queen.
choices: venues<sep>residences<sep>locations<sep>occupations
analysis: 【B】本题考查近义词辨析。句意为“白金汉宫，温莎城堡和圣十字架宫是君主的正式住所。此类场所，既是皇后的家，也是办公室。” A选项venue“场地、会场”；B选项residences“居所，住所”, official residence表示“官邸”；C选项location“地点”，D选项occupations “场合，职业”。因此横线处只有“居所，住所”符合题意，故正确答案为B项。

stem: 37. The relationship between words alligator and animal is that of _____.
choices: antonymy<sep>synonymy<sep>hyponymy<sep>homonymy
analysis: 【C】本题考查近义词辨析。句意为“单词‘鳄鱼’和‘动物’之间的关系属于______关系。” A选项antonymy“反义词”；B选项synonymy”近义词“；C选项hyponymy“下位词，下义词”；D选项homonymy“同形同音异义词”。“鳄鱼”属于“动物”概念的一个下属分支概念，即被“动物”概念包括，符合语言学上对“下位词”的定义，因此横线处只有“下位词”符合题意，故正确答案为C项。

stem: 38. We had expected that Bella would win, and she _____.
choices: did win<sep>would win<sep>had won<sep>has won
analysis: 【A】本题考查动词时态。句意为“我们预料到贝拉会赢的，而她真的赢了。”由于本句时态是过去式，did放在动词win前面表示对于“她赢了”这一事实的强调语气，win要用原形。C选项had won是过去完成时，D选项has won是现在完成时，不符合本句的时态。B选项为干扰选项，由于“她赢了”是实际发生的事情，而不是虚拟语气，所以不能选would win。因此横线处只有“did win”符合题意，故正确答案为A项。

stem: 39. Voicing of explosives is a distinctive feature in _____.
choices: Chinese only<sep>English only<sep>both Chinese and English<sep>neither Chinese nor English
analysis: 【C】本题考查语言常识。句意为“在汉语和英语中，爆破音都是一个很明显的特征。”汉语和英语都有爆破音，因此横线处只有“both Chinese and English”符合题意，故正确答案为C项。

stem: 40. The reason people feel that they have to follow fashion is that they are faced with _____ advertising
choices: domineering<sep>insistent<sep>notorious<sep>incessant
analysis: 【D】本题考查近义词辨析。句意为“人们感到他们不得不赶时髦的原因是他们面对着无止境的广告。” A选项domineering“盛气凌人的; 专横跋扈的”；B选项insistent“坚持的；迫切的；显著的”；C选项notorious“臭名昭著的”；D选项incessant“不断的；不停的；连续的”。B选项不符合题意；A选项“盛气凌人的; 专横跋扈的”、C选项“臭名昭著的”一般用来形容人。因此横线处“不停的，无止境的”最符合语义，故正确答案为D项。

stem: 41. I ve never been to Zurich, but that s the city _____.
choices: which I like to visit mostly<sep>I d most like to visit<sep>where I like to visit<sep>I d like to visit it
analysis: 【B】本题考查定语从句。“我从来没去过苏黎世，但是那是我最想游览的城市。”句中“城市”是宾语，横线上的内容用来对“城市”进行修饰和补充。B选项I'd most like to visit 修饰了“城市”，省略了指代“城市”的代词that/which，符合题意。A选项which I like to visit mostly中，“mostly”表示“通常”而非程度上的“最”，偏离了句子的本意。C选项where I like to visit，代词where使用不当，应改为that或which。D选项是结构完整的句子，不能插入定语从句中。因此横线处只有I'd most like to visit符合题意，故正确答案为B项。

stem: 42. What figures of speech is applied in the sentence Hope is a good breakfast, but it is a bad supper.
choices: metonymy<sep>personification<sep>simile<sep>metaphor
analysis: 【D】本题考查语言常识。句意为“‘希望是顿美好的早餐，但却是顿糟糕的晚餐’这句话用了什么修辞手法”。考查了修辞学中的常见修辞手法。A选项metonymy“转喻”， 指的是甲事物与乙事物两者实质上并不相似，但在社会生活之中往往有联系，利用这种关系用甲事物的名称代替乙事物，例如用“白大褂”转喻“医生”。其内在的思维关系不是相似关系而是联想关系；B选项personification“拟人”， 指的是把物比作人，赋予物以人的情感；C选项simile“明喻”，是将具有某种共同特征的两种不同事物连接起来的一种修辞手法，表达方法是“A像B”，常用as或like等词；D选项metaphor“暗喻”，本体和喻体之间在形式上是相合的关系，说甲（本体）是（喻词）乙（喻体）。喻词常由“是、就是、成了、成为、变成等表判断的词语来充当。”本句把希望比作早餐、晚餐，但没有把物比作人，排除B选项“拟人”；“希望”和“早餐”、“晚餐”并不存在社会生活中的固定联系，排除A选项“转喻”；由于句中使用了“是”而不是“像”，“希望”和“早餐”、“晚餐”之间在形式上是相合的关系，因此“暗喻”更符合题意，故正确答案为D项。

stem: 43. Allen has been _____ to think of a suitable New Year gift.
choices: racking his brains<sep>in two minds<sep>feeling out of place<sep>in conflict
analysis: 【A】本题考查固定搭配。句意为“艾伦为了挑个合适的新年礼物已经想破了脑袋。”A选项rack sb's brain“挖空心思地努力思考、理解；想破脑袋”；B选项be in two minds“犹豫不决、拿不定主意”；C选项feel out of place“感到拘束、尴尬、格格不入”；D选项in conflict“有矛盾；不一致”。C和D不是挑选礼物的状态，不符合句意。B选项“犹豫不决、拿不定主意”可以表达选礼物时的心情，但如果使用“be in two minds”，后面应该搭配“about a suitable New Year Gift”而不是“to think of”. 因此“挖空心思地努力思考、理解”更符合题意，故正确答案为A项。

stem: 44. Is there anything bothering you? Just one thing. A school called me this morning to see if I could teach a few hours there this weekend and I don t know what to do. Do you have any other plans this weekend? I m supposed to work on a paper that will be due on Monday. _____ You re right. I probably should just work on my paper. Thanks!
choices: Just breathe deeply when you feel upset.<sep>You re over reacting. The situation is not that bad.<sep>Try not to take on more than you can handle.<sep>I would probably worry if I were you.
analysis: 【C】情景交际题。句意为“——你有什么烦心的事吗？——就只有一件事。有一所学校今天早上打电话给我，想知道我这个星期能不能在他们那里上几个小时的课，而我不知道该怎么做。——你这个周末有别的计划吗？我应该会写一篇论文，到星期一要提交。——______________。——你说得对。我可能就是应该完成我的论文，谢谢！”根据对话情境可知，横线处是建议对方优先去完成论文。C项Try not to take on more than you can handle“尽量不要承担超出你能力范围的工作”是建议对方去写论文，符合语义。A项Just breathe deeply when you feel upset“难过的时候就深呼吸”，B项 You're over reacting. The situation is not that bad. “你反应过度了。情况并没有那么糟糕”，D项I would probably worry if I were you“如果我是你，我可能会担心”均不符合语义，故正确答案为C项。

stem: 45. Can I borrow your old exam papers for Intermediate Accounting? I want to use the questions to test myself before the real exam. _____
choices: I highly recommend it.<sep>Dora hasn t returned them to me, so I don t have them.<sep>I haven t taken the exam yet.<sep>They contain a lot of multiple choice questions.
analysis: 【B】情景交际题。句意为“——我可以借一下你以前的中级会计考试试卷吗？我想在真正的考试之前，用题目来考考自己。——______________。” 根据对话情境可知，横线处是回应对方借走自己试卷的要求，应有表态“可以借”/“不能借”。B选项Dora hasn't returned them to me, so I don't have them“朵拉还没还给我，所以我这没有”表态不能借，符合对话主题。A选项I highly recommend it“我强烈推荐”不符合回应对方借自己试卷要求的语境。C选项I haven't taken the exam yet“我还没有参加考试”、D选项They contain a lot of multiple choice questions“它们包含了很多选择题”与对方所提出的要求无关。故正确答案选B项“朵拉还没还给我，所以我这没有”。

stem: 31. His father told him that he couldn t hope to catch a big fish _____ a small rod like that, but he insisted trying.
choices: by; about<sep>by; on<sep>with; on<sep>with; with
analysis: 本题考查短语搭配和介词。句意为“他的父亲告诉他不要抱有用那样的小鱼竿钓大鱼的希望，但他坚持要尝试”。介词 by 表示“用......方式”，介词 with 表示“用......工具”，本句介词后面跟的是鱼竿，一种工具，所以介词 with 符合本句句意。insist on doing sth，固定搭配，坚持做某事。故正确答案为 C 项。

stem: 32. He suddenly saw Karen _____the room. He pushed his way _____the crowd of people to get to her.
choices: across; across<sep>across; through<sep>over; along<sep>over; through
analysis: 本题考查介词。句意为“他突然看到了房间对面的凯伦。他穿过人群要去到她身边”。对于第一个空，介词 across 表示“在......对面”，介词 over 表示“在...上面”，所以介词 across 符合句意。对于第二个空，介词 across 表示“从…一边到另一边”，介词 through 表示“穿过”，介词 along 表示“沿着”，所以介词 through 符合句意。故正确答案为 B 项。

stem: 33. My grandparents have lived near the railway station for so long that they ve grown _____ to the noise of the trains.
choices: accustomed<sep>aware<sep>familiar<sep>unconscious
analysis: 本题考查固定搭配。句意为“我的祖父母在火车站附近住了很长时间，他们已经习惯了火车的噪音”。A 选项，accustomed，习惯的, “grow/be/get accustomed to..., 固定搭配，习惯于......”。B 选项，aware，知道的, “be aware of..., 固定搭配，知道......”。C 选项，familiar，熟悉的, “be familiar with..., 固定搭配，熟悉......”。D 选项，unconscious，无意识的, “be unconscious of..., 固定搭配，未意识到......”。根据句意和介词搭配可得 A 选项符合题意，故正确答案为 A 项。

stem: 34. The engineer says the working of the new type of machine _____that of the human brain.
choices: compromises with<sep>competes with<sep>contrasts to<sep>corresponds to
analysis: 本题考查固定搭配。句意为“工程师说新型机器的运作和人脑相对应”。compromises with，和......妥协；compete with，与......竞争；contrast to，和......对比；correspond to，与......相对应。根据句意，D 选项符合题意，故正确答案为 D 项。

stem: 35. When he could afford it, Jeffery used to _____ half a chicken and salad with white wine.
choices: eat up<sep>drop off<sep>take over<sep>pick up
analysis: 本题考查固定搭配。句意为“当杰夫瑞能负担得起时，他习惯吃完半只鸡，并用沙拉配白葡萄酒”。eat up，吃完；drop off，中途放下，减少；take over，接管，取代；pick up，采摘，学会。根据句意，A 选项符合题意。故正确答案为 A 项。

stem: 36. Owing to religious differences, the two neighboring countries have been _____for generations.
choices: under attack<sep>on bad terms<sep>out of line<sep>in sharp contrast
analysis: 本题考查短语辨析。句意为“由于宗教差异，这两个邻国世代不和”。under attack，被攻击；on bad terms，不和，关系不好；out of line，不一致，不符合；in sharp contrast，成鲜明对比。根据句意，B 选项符合题意。故正确答案为 B 项。

stem: 37. Jack felt really embarrassed about the way he had behaved toward Rose so he decided to _____ her for a few days.
choices: get rid of<sep>back away from<sep>run up against<sep>steer clear of
analysis: 本题考查短语辨析。句意为“杰克对于他对罗斯的行为感到非常不好意思，所以他决定接下来几天避开她”。get ride of，摆脱；back away form，（由于恐惧或厌恶等）后退；run up against，偶遇；steer clear of，避开，绕开。根据句意，D 选项符合题意。故正确答案为 D 项。

stem: 38. Many _____ prefer to use the word Ms instead of Miss or Mrs before their names in business correspondence.
choices: woman managers<sep>woman staffs<sep>women managers<sep>women staffs
analysis: 本题考查名词作定语。句意为“在商务信函中，许多女性经理喜欢在姓名前用 'Ms' 而不是 'Miss' 或 'Mrs'”。根据句意，这里应该是指女性经理，而非女性员工，所以B选项和D选项错误。在英语中可以将名词作为形容词性的定语，来修饰另一个名词，说明它的性质。如果man或woman修饰的是复数名词，表示其性别，则man或woman也要用复数形式，故正确答案为C项。

stem: 39. Following the flood, _____ in the disaster-affected area _____major repair work.
choices: each of building; needs<sep>each building; need<sep>every building; need<sep>every building; needs
analysis: 本题考查 each 和 every 的辨析。句意为“洪水过后，受灾地区的每一栋建筑都需要大修”。each of 后面的名词得是复数形式，所以 A 选项错误；each building 和 every building 都表示单数概念，所以后面的动词要用单三形式，所以 B 选项和C 选项错误。故正确答案为 D 项

stem: 40._____, a man who can express himself effectively has a higher possibility of success than a man who has a poor command of language.
choices: Other things being equal<sep>Other things to be equal<sep>Were other things equal<sep>Equal with other things
analysis: 本题考查常见搭配。句意为“在其他条件相同的情况下，一个能够有效表达自己的人比一个语言能力差的人更可能成功”。other things being equal，常见副词搭配，意思是“在其他条件相同的情况下”。故正确答案为 A 项。

stem: 41. The corrupt official was _____neglecting his duty.
choices: accused of<sep>admitted to<sep>deprived of<sep>forced to
analysis: 本题考查固定搭配。句意为“那个贪官被指控玩忽职守”。be accused of，被指控......；be admitted to，被…录取；be deprived of，被剥夺......；be forced to，被迫。根据句意，A 选项符合题意，故正确答案为 A 项。

stem: 42. We have been warned that _____ may we use the telephone in the office for person affairs.
choices: by all means<sep>in exceptional cases<sep>under no circumstances<sep>with permission
analysis: 本题考查固定搭配。句意为“有人警告我们，在任何情况下，我们都不能使用办公室的电话处理个人事务”。by all means，当然可以，一定；in exceptional cases，特殊情况下；under no circumstances，任何情况下都不；with permission，在允许的情况下。根据句意，C 选项符合题意，故正确答案为 C 项。

stem: 43. Being a celebrity or a pop star can be quite a hard life, with a lot of travelling _____ heavy schedules.
choices: in spite of<sep>in terms of<sep>owing to<sep>dedicated to
analysis: 本题考查固定搭配。句意为“成为名人或流行歌星后生活可能会很难，因为日程安排很紧，经常出差”。in spite of，尽管，不管；in terms of，根据，按照；owing to，由于；dedicated to，献给。根据句意，C 选项符合题意，故正确答案为 C 项。

stem: 44. ― What do you think is the most important thing for success? It must be high IQ. ― _____I believe patience and motivation are more important than IQ. ― That makes sense.
choices: It s none of your business.<sep>Well, I think otherwise.<sep>Yeah, that s just what I was thinking.<sep>That makes a big difference.
analysis: 本题是情景交际题。句意为“―你认为成功最重要的是什么？我认为一定是高智商。―嗯，我不这么认为。我觉得耐心和动力比智商更重要。―你说的很有道理”。It's none of your business，不关你的事；Well, I think otherwise，嗯，我不这么认为；Yeah, that's just what I was thinking，是的，这也是我的想法；That makes a big difference，这有着重大影响。除了 B 项，其他均不符合情景大意，故正确答案为 B 项。

stem: 45. ― Do you have any particular gift in mind for the coming Mother s Day? ― _____
choices: I m afraid I can t.<sep>I really don t mind.<sep>My mother likes receiving gifts.<sep>I m going to buy some flowers.
analysis: 本题是情景交际题。句意为“―对于即将到来的母亲节，你有准备什么特别的礼物吗？―我打算买些花”。I'm afraid I can't，恐怕我不能；I really don't mind，我真的不介意；My mother likes receiving gifts，我妈妈喜欢收到礼物；I'm going to buy some flowers，我打算买些花。结合上文句意， D 选项符合情景，故正确答案为 D 项。

stem: 31. In the speaking_____of the test, students must answer five questions from the instructor.
