stem: 33. At the time, players were allowed, but not required, to wear helmets, and most players chose to go helmet-less, _____ the risk of severe head trauma.
choices: despite<sep>instead of<sep>nevertheless<sep>because of
analysis: 【A】本题考查词汇短语辨析。despite，介词，即使，尽管；instead of，介词，而不是；nevertheless，连词，然而，不过；because of，介词，因为。由句意“当时，球员可以戴头盔，当然这不是强制要求，但是尽管头部有可能受到严重创伤，大多数球员还是选择不戴头盔”可知，B选项和D选项意思不太合适。因为选项处后面接的是名词“the risk of severe head trauma”，所以选项处应该使用介词despite，而不是连词nevertheless。故本题选A。

stem: 34. The witness _____ everyone that he hadn t had anything to do with the crime.
choices: revealed<sep>argued<sep>convinced<sep>insisted
analysis: 【C】本题考查动词辨析。review，检查，回顾；argue，争论，争辩；convince，说服，使信服；insist，坚持，坚决要求。由句意“证人让所有人相信他与这项犯罪活动无关”可知，这儿应该使用“convince”。故本题选C。

stem: 35. When you are interviewing someone, it is obviously necessary to ask questions relevant to their job experience, but discussing someone s other _____ is also useful.
choices: deeds<sep>accomplishments<sep>compliments<sep>holdings
analysis: 【B】本题考查名词辨析。deed，行为，行动；accomplishment，成就，成绩；compliment，恭维，称赞；holding，股份，私有财产。由句意“当你面试一个人时，显然询问与他工作经历相关的问题是很有必要的，但讨论一下他的其它成就也很有用”可知，B选项“成就，成绩”比较符合题干的情形。故本题选B。

stem: 36. Within the US government, the sector that manages federal land and territories along with natural resources and energy conservation is the Department of the _____ .
choices: Agriculture<sep>Defense<sep>Homeland Security<sep>Interior
analysis: 【D】本题考查百科知识。the Department of the Agriculture，农业部；the Department of the Defense，国防部；the Department of the Homeland and Security，国土安全部；the Department of the Interior，内政部。本题句意为“美国政府内，管理联邦土地、领土以及进行自然资源和能源保护的部门是_____部门”A选项农业部负责和执行有关农业、林业、农村经济发展和粮食的行政事务；B选项国防部是总统领导与指挥全军的办事机构，又是向各联合司令部发布总统和国防部长命令的军事指挥机关；C选项国土安全部负责美国境内的边境管制、情报统筹、紧急应变、防止恐怖活动以及移民事务等；D选项内政部担负着保护、开发美国联邦政府所有土地（包括联邦所属（或管辖）的海洋水域）上国土资源的重要之责，是美国联邦政府有关公共土地（包括联邦所管辖的海洋水域）和其他矿产、石油等资源的主要管理部门。由此可知D选项符合描述，故本题选D。

stem: 37. The new education system shows that it is possible to carry _____ very extensive readjustments with a view to making a system more flexible and adapted to individualized learning.
choices: off<sep>through<sep>over<sep>away
analysis: 【B】本题考查短语辨析。carry off，成功完成，赢得；carry through，（常指艰难地）做，完成；carry over，（使）延续，（使）延伸；carry away，拿走，带走。由句意“新的教育系统表明，可以做出有关调整来使系统更加灵活且能够适应个性化学习”可知，调整还没有做出，且是有一定难度的，所以B选项“（常指艰难地）做，完成”比较合适。故本题选B。

stem: 38. When an editor writes their opinion about an event or idea, the column is called a(n) _____.
choices: review<sep>editorial<sep>document<sep>issue
analysis: 【B】本题考查名词辨析。review，书评；editorial，(报刊的)社论；document，公文，文献；issue，重要议题。由句意“编辑写下他们对某个事件或想法的看法的栏目被称为_____”可知，editorial符合题意。故本题选B。

stem: 39. I honestly can t tell one twin from the other as they are just like two _____ in a pod.
choices: buds<sep>seeds<sep>grains<sep>peas
analysis: 【D】本题考查名词辨析。bud，芽，苞；seed，种子；grain，谷物；pea，豌豆粒。由句意“老实说，我不能分辨出双胞胎，因为他们就像一个豆荚里的两粒豌豆”可知，pea符合题意。故本题选D。

stem: 40. You should read not only newspapers but also novels so that you can see examples of _____ language.
choices: idiomatic<sep>pure<sep>symbolic<sep>genuine
analysis: 【A】本题考查形容词辨析。idiomatic，惯用的，表达方式地道的；pure，纯净的；symbolic，象征的；genuine，真诚的。由句意“你不仅应该阅读报纸，还应该阅读小说，这样你才可以看到地道的语言是什么样的”可知，A选项比较符合题意。故本题选A。

stem: 41. On social occasions, she always gives herself airs and graces, which means she always _____ .
choices: applies a lot of makeup<sep>moves around like a cloud<sep>behaves like she is important<sep>gives herself plenty of time
analysis: 【C】本题考查动词短语。A选项意思是化妆；B选项意思是像云一样四处移动；C选项意思是表现得好像她很重要；D选项意思是给自己很多时间。由本题句意“在社交场合中，她总是装腔作势，也就是说她总是表现得好像她很重要”可知，C选项比较符合题意。故本题选C。

stem: 42._____ is applied in the sentence Ursala kicked the bucket last year.
choices: Simile<sep>Analogy<sep>Hyperbole<sep>Euphemism
analysis: 【D】本题考查修辞手法。simile，明喻，是指一种喻体、本体、比喻词同时出现的比喻；analogy，类比，是指将两个本质上不同的事物就其共同点进行比较的修辞方式；hyperbole，夸张，是为了达到某种表达效果的需要，对事物的形象、特征、作用、程度等方面着意夸大或缩小的修辞方式；euphemism，委婉语，指的是一种用委婉、迂回、不引起听者或读者反感的词语代替某些粗鲁、生硬、或令人不悦的词语修辞方式。本题句子“Ursala kicked the bucket last year，乌拉萨去年过世了”中应用的应该是委婉语的修辞手法，所以D选项符合题意。故本题选D。

stem: 43. Eurasia , taikounaut , smog and sitcom are examples of _____ in English lexicology.
choices: acronym<sep>conversion<sep>clipping<sep>blending
analysis: 【D】本题考查构词法。acronym，首字母缩略法，是一种将相关词句的第一个字母缩写而组合成一个新词的构词法；conversion，转化法，是由一种词类转化为一种或几种词类的构词法；clipping，截略法，是将长词加以略写，从而构成新词，但意思保持不变的构词法；blending，混成法，是指将两个词混合或各取一部分紧缩而成一个新词的构词法，前半部分表属性，后半部分表主体。由于“Eurasia”, “taikounaut”, “smog”和“sitcom”都是两个词各取一部分组合成一个新词，所以D选项符合题意。故本题选D。

stem: 44. Excuse me, I ve never been to this cafe before, and I was wondering if there s anything in particula you d recommend. _____
choices: What a pleasant surprise! I ve never seen you come to any of our recent events before.<sep>This is also my first time here. I just moved to the city, and I was hoping to meet some new people.<sep>All the coffee is quite good, but I think the cold-brewed coffee is especially worth trying.<sep>This coffee shop is so personal and cozy. Next time I come, remind me to bring my camera.
analysis: 【C】本题考查句子衔接。A选项句子意思是：多么令人愉快的惊喜！我之前从未见你参加过我们近期的活动；B选项句子意思是：这也是我第一次来这里。我刚搬到这座城市，希望能结识一些新朋友；C选项句子意思是：所有的咖啡都不错，但我认为冷冲咖啡特别值得一试；D选项句子意思是：这家咖啡店很私密且舒适。下次我来的时候，提醒我带上相机。由对话意思：“——对不起，我以前没来过这家咖啡馆，我想知道你有没有什么特别推荐的饮品。”可知，对话缺少的句子应该是在推荐咖啡，所以C选项比较能够衔接上下文。故本题选C。

stem: 45. So, what do you like to do in your free time? I m a huge movie buff. I have a soft spot for action movies and go to film festivals every chance I get. I plan to major in cinematography. I totally get the appeal! I m into photography myself, so I really appreciate the elements of visual composition. I have a friend who s into photography, too. You should meet her so you can compare notes. In fact, she told me she was coming tonight._____ Sure, it s always great to meet people with similar interests.
choices: You two already know each other?<sep>Do you want me to introduce you?<sep>Are you both in the photography club in our school?<sep>Do you want to see the exhibition of Chinese ceramics?
analysis: 【B】本题考查句子衔接。A选项句子意思是，你们两个已经互相认识了吗；B选项句子意思是，你想让我介绍一下你吗；C选项句子意思是，你俩都是我们学校的摄影俱乐部的吗；D选项句子意思是，你想去看中国陶瓷展吗。由对话意思：“——那么，你喜欢在空闲时间做什么？——我是个超级电影迷。我喜欢看动作片，一有机会就去看电影节。我计划主修电影摄影。——我完全懂你！我自己也喜欢摄影，所以我非常欣赏视觉构图的元素。——我有一个朋友也喜欢摄影。你应该见见她，这样你就可以比较一下你们的笔记了。并且，她告诉我她今晚要来。你想让我介绍一下你吗？——当然，能遇到志同道合的人太棒了”，可知B选项“介绍对方认识”比较能够衔接上下文。故本题选B。

stem: 31. For decades scientists have debated how the brains of young children _____ how to communicate using language.
choices: wipe out<sep>set out<sep>take out<sep>figure out
analysis: 本题考查短语搭配。句意为“几十年来，科学家们一直在争论小孩子的大脑如何通过语言进行交流”。wipe out，抹杀，擦净；set out，出发，动身；take out，拿掉，扣除；figure out，想明白，弄清楚。结合句意应是“科学家要弄清楚”，要用短语"figure out"。故正确答案为 D 项。

stem: 32. Then he stood awkwardly beside the box, feeling _____ miserable, not knowing what to do next.
choices: finally<sep>utterly<sep>nearly<sep>actually
analysis: 本题考查副词搭配。句意为“他不知所措地站在箱子旁边，感到非常痛苦，不知道该做什么”。finally，终于，最终；utterly，全部地，完全地；nearly，几乎；actually，事实上。结合句意应是“他感到非常地混乱痛苦”。故正确答案为 B 项。

stem: 33. The problem was that strange things often happened around Harry and it was just _____the Dursleys he didn t make them happen.
choices: no good telling<sep>good at telling<sep>afraid to tell<sep>hesitant to tell
analysis: 本题考查固定句型。句意为“问题0是奇怪的事情经常发生在哈利身上，即使你告诉德思力一家这些事情不是他造成的也没有用”。"It is no good/use+ doing"意为“做什么是没好处，没有用”，为固定句型。B 项错在 good 后面应该为"to do"；C 项和 D 项的"afraid"和"hesitant"只能用来形容人，不能放在句中。故正确答案为 A 项。

stem: 34. The warming of our globe is often _____ human activity, such as the burning of fossil fuels, especially in industrialized nations.
choices: depended on<sep>excused for<sep>blamed on<sep>judged by
analysis: 本题考查短语搭配。句意为“尤其是在工业化国家，全球变暖常被归咎于人类活动，像化石燃料的燃烧”。depended on，依赖于；excused for，做理由；找借口；blamed on，错在，归咎于；judged by，由……判断。根据句意，“全球变暖被归咎于人类活动”，故正确答案为 C 项。

stem: 35. Some friends and I went out to have a big meal yesterday and we divided the bill so that we all paid equal _____.
choices: numbers<sep>plenty<sep>amounts<sep>quantity
analysis: 本题考查名词辨析。句意为“昨天我和一些朋友出去吃了一顿大餐，我们分摊了账单，所以我们都付了一样多的钱”。numbers，数字，用来修饰可数事物；plenty，很多的，为形容词，不能放在 equal 之后；quantity，数量，不能用来修饰 money，常用来修饰大数量的可数事物。故正确答案为 C 项。

stem: 36. Videotaped interviews should only be excluded if admitting them would be _____ the interest of justice.
choices: similar to<sep>contrary to<sep>owing to<sep>subject to
analysis: 本题考查短语辨析。句意为“只有在承认录影采访有悖于司法利益的情况下，才能够排除录影采访”。similar to，与……相同；contrary to，与……相反；owing to，由于；subject to，服从于。故正确答案为 B 项。

stem: 37. Electricity would improve education, allow greater communication, let doctors store medicines that must stay cold, and _____.
choices: do much more<sep>the more the better<sep>far and away<sep>come what may
analysis: 本题考查句子搭配。句意为“电力可以改善教育，促进交流，让医生储存必须冷藏的药物，以及做更多的事情”。do much more，做更多的事；the more the better，越多越好，混淆主语将"medicines" 错认为主语，但正确主语应为"electricity"，far and away，很远；come what may，无论如何。故正确答案为 A 项。

stem: 38. Jack s teacher thinks that students lose _____ when they depend on calculators, but _____ math teachers disagree.
choices: something; other<sep>something; others<sep>anything; other<sep>anything; others
analysis: 本题考查否定句型。句意为“杰克的老师认为学生依赖计算器会失去一些东西，但其他数学老师不这么认为”。Something 在否定句中应变为 anything，但第一空为肯定句，所以选 something；others 后面不能够加名词，相当于“other+名词”，故正确答案为 A 项。

stem: 39. _____ , the flow of water was hard to control, so the water clocks were not very accurate.
choices: Therefore<sep>Though<sep>However<sep>Otherwise
analysis: 本题考查连接词。句意为“然而水的流量很难控制，所以水钟不是很准确”。therefore，因此；though，尽管；however，无论如何；otherwise，否则，不然。只有 C 项可以和 so 之后的句子构成逻辑关系，故正确答案为 C 项。

stem: 40. A transplant is an operation to move a body part, _____ a heart or a kidney, from one person to another.
choices: as for<sep>as well as<sep>in addition to<sep>such as
analysis: 本题考查连词应用。句意为“移植是将身体的一部分，如心脏或肾脏，从一个人转移到另一个人的手术”。as for，至于；as well as，和…一样；in addition to，除此之外；such as，例如。根据句意，故正确答案为 D 项。

stem: 41. Mr Patrick Gray s lecture at Walden Books, which was originally scheduled _____ tomorrow afternoon has been postponed _____Tuesday evening.
choices: during; on<sep>to; to<sep>for; until<sep>in; in
analysis: 本题考查固定搭配。句意为“帕特里克·格雷先生原定于明天下午在瓦尔登书店的讲座被推迟到了周二晚上。” schedule something for+时间表示“预定；安排”，故正确答案为 C 项。

stem: 42. The copy machine _____ for several days before someone finally called for service.
choices: has worked<sep>had worked<sep>has not been working<sep>had not been working
analysis: 本题考查时态。句意为“在有人打电话要维修之前，那复印机就已经坏了”。由"finally called"得知动作发生在过去，但因为主语的动作发生在 called 之前，所以为过去的过去，应用过去完成式，故正确答案为 D 项。

stem: 43. The thief wore gloves the whole time so that his fingerprints didn t _____ .
choices: give him in<sep>give him out<sep>give him away<sep>give him up
analysis: 本题考查固定短语。句意为“小偷一直戴着手套，这样他的指纹就不会暴露他的身份”。give in，屈服，让步；give out，分发；give away，暴露，出卖”；give up，放弃。结合句意，故正确答案为 C 项。

stem: 44. Lara, you ve become very famous. Has this changed your life? _____ I mean, people do recognize me if I go shopping or something, but I don t actually go out very much.
choices: Not very much really.<sep>I bet you did.<sep>I couldn t agree with you more.<sep>Give me a break.
analysis: 本题是情景交际题。句意为“-劳拉，你已经很出名了。这改变了你的生活吗?-其实没有改变太多。如果我去购物什么的，人们会认出我，但是我不经常出去”。not very much really，其实不然；I bet you did，我确定你这样做了；I couldn't agree with you more,我非常同意你说的话；give me a break，饶了我吧。除了 A 项，其他均不符合句意，故正确答案为 A 项。

stem: 45. How come you are walking like that? My ankle s killing me! _____ If I were you, I would lie down and put some ice on it to keep the swelling down.
choices: Why not call a policeman?<sep>Does it really work well?<sep>Sorry to have troubled you.<sep>Oh dear, you poor thing!
analysis: 本题是情景交际题。句意为“-你怎么这样走路?-我的脚踝太疼了！-你这个可怜的家伙我要是你的话，会躺下来敷点冰来消肿”。Why not call a policeman，为什么不报警；Does it really work well，那真的有效吗；Sorry to have troubled you，抱歉打扰你了；Oh dear, you poor thing，啊，你太可怜了。选项 ABC 与对方所说的事情无关，故正确答案为 D 项。

stem: 31. Although Michael and Craig are the same size, Michael is_____Craig.
choices: more strong to<sep>less strong to<sep>not as strong as<sep>not as stronger as
analysis: 【C】本题考察比较级用法。strong的比较级形式为stronger，而非more strong和less strong，所以A选项和B选项错误。as有一个常见结构为“as+形容词/副词原级+as”，意为“和……一样”，所以D选项错误，C选项正确。本题句意“虽然Michael和Craig的体型相同，但Michael不如Craig强壮”。故本题选C。

stem: 32. Tony_____burst into the room while I was wrapping his birthday present.
choices: luckily<sep>suddenly<sep>finally<sep>naturally
analysis: 【B】本题考查副词辨析。luckily，幸运地；suddenly，突然地；finally，最后地，终于；naturally，自然地。由句意“我在给托尼包装生日礼物时，托尼突然冲进了房间”可知，B选项“突然地”比较合适。故本题选B。

stem: 33. Brendan was feeling more_____about the future after he got a promotion at work.
choices: optimistic<sep>proud<sep>inspiring<sep>encouraging
analysis: 【A】本题考查形容词辨析。optimistic，乐观的；proud，自豪的；inspiring，鼓舞人心的，激励的；encouraging，令人鼓舞的，振奋人心的。proud常用搭配为 “be proud of, 为...自豪”, 后面的介词是of而非about，所以B选项错误。又因为以-ing结尾的分词形容词表示主语所具有的特征，主语多为表示“事物”的名词；而以-ed结尾的分词形容词通常表示主语所处的状态或感受，主语多为“人”，所以inspiring和encouraging在此处形容Brendan这个人不合适，C选项和D选项错误。再由句意“布伦丹在晋升工作后对未来的态度更加乐观”可知，A选项“乐观的”比较合适。故本题选A。

stem: 34. Jackie_____her leg on that ski slope it was very steep and she s not an experienced skier.
choices: could have broken<sep>should have broken<sep>mustn t break<sep>needn t have broken
analysis: 【A】本题考查“情态动词＋have done”的虚拟语气用法。A选项“could have done”可以表示主观猜测，即对已发生动作或者已经存在的状态做出主观猜测，通常译为“可能（已经）”。B选项“should have done”表示过去本应该做某事却没有做。C选项“mustn't do”表示一定没做过某事，不表示推测。D选项“needn't have done”表示没必要做某事，但是却做了。由句意“杰姬可能在滑雪坡上摔伤腿了——陂很陡而且她不是一个经验丰富的滑雪运动员”可知，这儿应该是根据破折号后面的一句话来主观推测出杰姬可能摔伤了，所以A选项比较合适。故本题选A。

stem: 35. The holiday resort_____excellent restaurants and luxurious suites with a view of the sea.
choices: indicates<sep>appears<sep>features<sep>attracts
analysis: 【C】本题考查动词辨析。indicate，表明，指示；appear，出现，呈现；feature，以…为特色；attract，吸引。由句意“这个度假胜地以高级餐厅和海景豪华套房为特色”可知，C选项“以...为特色”比较符合题意。故本题选C。

stem: 36. I d rather you_____David s bike without asking him first. He d be furious if you do so.
choices: don t borrow<sep>didn t borrow<sep>haven t borrowed<sep>not borrowed
analysis: 【B】本题考查would rather的虚拟语气用法。would rather，宁愿。它后面加句子时，句子的谓语动词习惯上使用虚拟语气。其后面的句子为一般过去时时则表示现在或者将来的愿望，为过去完成时时则表示过去的愿望。根据句意“我宁愿你不在没问大卫的情况下借他的自行车。如果你这样做，他会生气的”可知，“borrow” 这个动作还未发生，所以需要使用一般过去时来表示。故本题选B。

stem: 37. The manager told his staff that they would_____the changes that were taking place in the company.
choices: rush into<sep>put up<sep>benefit from<sep>connect with
analysis: 【C】本题考查短语辨析。rush into，冲进；put up，建造，张贴；benefit from，从...获益；connect with，与...联系。由句意“经理告诉他的员工，他们将从公司正在发生的变化中获益”可知，C选项“从...获益”比较合适。故本题选C。

stem: 38. Sally is upset because she lost her set of keys for the building; _____all the locks have to be replaced.
choices: as a result<sep>at a loss<sep>all in all<sep>in no case
analysis: 【A】本题考查短语析。as a result，结果，因此；at a loss，不知所措，困惑；all in all，总之；in no case，决不。由句意“萨莉很难过，因为她丢了大楼的一套钥匙；为此所有的锁都必须更换”可知，A选项“结果，因此”比较合适。故本题选A。

stem: 39. The people of this town are so_____. They take you into their homes and offer you all that they can.
choices: intelligent<sep>dependent<sep>courageous<sep>hospitable
analysis: 【D】本题考查形容词辨析。intelligent，机智的，聪明的；dependent，独立的；courageous，勇敢的；hospitable，热情好客的。由句意“这个镇上的人是如此的热情好客。他们会把你带到家里，为你提供他们所能提供的一切”可知，D选项“热情好客的”比较合适。故本题选D。

stem: 40. _____being very tired after work, Maria still volunteers every evening at a local homeless shelter.
choices: Instead of<sep>In spite of<sep>In place of<sep>Because of
analysis: 【B】本题考查短语辨析。instead of，而不是；in spite of，尽管，不管；in place of，代替；because of，因为。由句意“尽管工作后很累，玛丽亚仍然每天晚上在当地的一家收容所做志愿者”可知，B选项“尽管，不管”比较合适。故本题选B。

stem: 41. The_____of the village have an interesting custom: on 1st May they collect white flowers from the mountains.
choices: visitors<sep>passengers<sep>inhabitants<sep>tourists
analysis: 【C】本题考查名词辨析。visitor，参观者；passenger，乘客；inhabitant，居民；tourist，游客。由句意“村里的居民有一个有趣的习俗：5月1日他们会去山上采白花”可知，C选项“居民”比较合适。故本题选C。

stem: 42. With regard to other matters, I would like to make a few suggestions, _____I hope you can take into consideration.
choices: that<sep>where<sep>which<sep>when
analysis: 【C】本题考查定语从句。本句后面的句子是一个定语从句，用来修饰前面的suggestions。在定语从句中，which，that，when和where都可以做定语从句的关系词，但是which和that是关系代词，可以在从句中作主语或者宾语；而when和where是关系副词，在句子中作状语。此处需要的关系词在句中作宾语，所以B选项和D选项错误。而这个定语从句为非限制性定语从句，需要用which来引导，所以A选项错误，C选项正确。本题句意为“关于其他问题，我想提几点建议，希望你能考虑一下这些建议”。故本题选C。

stem: 26. Please don t ask for personal information about our employers, as we keep that information ____.

stem: 29. Americans who don t drink Pepsi are said to be ____ of the Pepsi generation .

stem: 31. A variety of activities should be organized ____ participants can remain active as long as they want.

stem: 32. If I were in a movie, then it would be about time that I ____ my head in my hands for a cry.

stem: 36. Military music may have ____ from attempts to get people ready for ____ by using fast music with drumming to stimulate their hearts to beat faster.

stem: 28. The presence of the president resulted in ____ security, which consisted of security men sealing all gates except for one so that the president could leave.

stem: 29. You should ____ your boss and not let him criticize your work so unjustly.

stem: An increasing proportion of our population unable to live without advanced medical ____, will become progressively more reliant on expensive technology.
choices: interference<sep>interruption<sep>intervention<sep>interaction
analysis: 【解析】句意：越来越多的人们在没有先进医疗介入的条件下难以生存，会对昂贵的医疗技术产生过度依赖。A. interference：干扰，与句意不符。B. interruption：中断，与句意不符。C. intervention：干预，与句意相符。D. interaction：互动，与句意不符。

stem: Sometimes the student may be asked to write about his ____ to a certain book or article that has some bearing on the subject being studied.
choices: comment<sep>reaction<sep>impression<sep>comprehension
analysis: 【解析】句意：有时候学生可能会被要求写一篇关于他对某本书或文章的反应的文章，这本书或文章与正在学习的主题有一定的关联。A. comment：评论，与句意不符。B. reaction：反应，与句意相符。C. impression：印象，与句意不符。D. comprehension：理解，与句意不符。

stem: Profiles of former members are preserved ____ people want to reactivate their accounts.
choices: in case<sep>in that<sep>even if<sep>so that
analysis: 【解析】句意：以前用户的个人资料被保留下来，以便人们想要重新激活他们的账户。A. in case：以防万一，与句意相符。B. in that：因为，与句意不符。C. even if：即使，与句意不符。D. so that：以便，与句意不符。

stem: These days, much of the family conversation ____ her. What are we going to do about Grandma?
choices: talks about<sep>centres on<sep>speaks of<sep>attaches to
analysis: 【解析】句意：最近的家庭谈话话题有提及关于她。通过分析，故选talks about，A选项。A. talks about：谈论。B. centres on：以…为中心。C. speaks of：提到。D. attaches to：附着在。由于主语是conversation，这里用talk about最为恰当。

stem: Take, ____, what happened during my Christmas holidays when I was eleven.
choices: for all<sep>for instance<sep>for good<sep>for ever
analysis: 【解析】句意：以我十一岁时圣诞假期发生的事情为例。根据固定搭配，故选B。A. for all：对于所有，与句意不符。B. for instance：例如，与句意相符。C. for good：永远，与句意不符。D. for ever：永远，与句意不符。

stem: If you don t do good in school, you can ____ another fifty years of this kind of work.
choices: look after<sep>look down upon<sep>look up<sep>look forward to
analysis: 【解析】句意：如果你在学校表现不好，你可能会对这种工作再干五十年感到厌倦。A. look after：照顾，与句意不符。B. look down upon：看不起，与句意不符。C. look up：查找，与句意不符。D. look forward to：期待，与句意相符。

stem: And the skills you sharpen to ease a tense relationship will ____ throughout your career.
choices: do in your stand<sep>stand in your light<sep>stand you in good stead<sep>take a stand against you
analysis: 【解析】句意：缓解紧张人际关系的技能磨练将贯穿始终，对你终身受益。A. do in your stand：在你的立场中做。B. stand in your light：挡住你的光芒。C. stand you in good stead：对你有很大帮助，与句意相符。D. take a stand against you：站在你的对立面。

stem: Have you decided yet? Yes, we ll ____ the cheaper option.
choices: take over<sep>go for<sep>set out<sep>make up
analysis: 【解析】句意：决定好了吗？是的，我们选择便宜的那个方案。A. take over：接管。B. go for：选择，与句意相符。C. set out：出发。D. make up：弥补。

stem: Because so few people showed ____ for the meeting, we decided to postpone it to a later date.
choices: out<sep>down<sep>off<sep>up
analysis: 【解析】句意：由于很少人出席，所以我们决定推迟会议。A. show out：送出（客人）。B. show down：摊牌，公布。C. show off：炫耀。 D. show up：出现，与句意相符。

stem: It was only ____ the house was so old ____ she sold it
choices: since; so<sep>because; that<sep>because; so<sep>since; that
analysis: 【解析】句意：只是因为这房子太旧了，她才想着卖掉。根据句意，可得知此处存在因果关系，且so that表示如此以致，故选B. because; that。

stem: According to one belief, if truth is to be known it will make itself apparent, so one ____ wait instead of searching for it.
choices: can t help<sep>had to<sep>can t but<sep>had best
analysis: 【解析】句意：根据一种观点，如果真相要被知道，它会自己浮出水面，所以我们应该耐心等待，而不是一味地苦苦探寻。A. can’t help：忍不住。B. had to：不得不。C. can’t but：不得不。 D. had best：最好，与句意相符。

stem: It looks like this restaurant is closed. What shall we do? I m so hungry! I know a caf that stays open late. I can call and check if they re still open. If you don t mind ordering sandwiches, that is. ____ I don t mind sandwiches. I guess we shouldn t have waited till so late to eat.
choices: Don t worry. I ll pay.<sep>That s all they serve.<sep>I ll find some place that s open.<sep>You won t believe this.
analysis: 【解析】句意： A: 看样子餐馆已经打烊了，我们该怎么办？好饿！ B: 我知道有一家咖啡店仍然开着，我打电话过去看看是否还营业？如果你不介意点三明治的话。他们只供应这个。 A: 我不介意吃三明治。我猜我们不应该等到这么晚才吃。 最后一句A说“我不介意吃三明治”。意味着B会提到那家咖啡店只供应三明治。A. 不用担心 我买单。B. That’s all they serve.他们只供应这个。 C. I’ll find some place that’s open.我会找一个开着的地方。D. You won’t believe this.你不会相信这个。故选B。

stem: I called the Grand Hotel this morning and booked you a room for Wednesday and Thursday nights. Would you mind calling back and asking them to add a night? I d like to stay over Friday and get some sightseeing in. ____Right now I have to finish typing these reports.
choices: Fine. That s not a problem.<sep>Just please don t forget to do it.<sep>I ll do it after lunch, if you think it s OK.<sep>You mean three nights? I ll be back immediately.
analysis: 【解析】句意： A: 我今天早上给大酒店打电话，为你预订了周三和周四的房间。 B: 你介意再打电话过去问问他们能不能再加一晚吗？我想在周五过夜并去观光。 A: 如果你觉得可以的话，我会在午饭后去做。现在我必须完成登记。 最后一句A说“我会在午饭后去做”。意味着A答应了B的请求，但说明了不能马上完成。A. Fine. That’s not a problem.好的，没问题。B. Just please don’t forget to do it.请别忘了去做。与句意不符。C. I’ll do it after lunch, if you think it’s OK.如果你觉得可以的话，我会在午饭后去做。D. You mean three nights? I’ll be back immediately.你是说三晚？我马上回去。故选C。

stem: May I see your ticket, please? Thank you. You re in Row 10, Seat A, right next to the window. Great. Thanks. Can you tell me how long the flight will be? There shouldn t be any delays on a nice cloudless day like today, so I expect we ll be arriving right on schedule at 2:30. ____
choices: Welcome to everyone on board.<sep>We ll probably be about 15 minutes late.<sep>I ll explain the situation to everyone.<sep>We ll begin food service in about half an hour.
analysis: 【解析】句意： A:请出示你的机票好吗？谢谢，您在第10排A座靠窗位置。 B:好的 谢谢。请问这个航班大概多久时间？ A:如无延误的情况下，基本上可以在2点半准时到达。 A. Welcome to everyone on board. 欢迎大家上机。此时已经上机，与上下文不符。B. We’ll probably be about 15 minutes late.：我们可能会晚大约15分钟。前面刚提到会准时到达，与句意不符。C. I’ll explain the situation to everyone.：我会向大家解释情况。与句意不符。 D. We’ll begin food service in about half an hour.：我们将在大约半小时后开始提供食物服务。符合登机的语境。根据句意和前后逻辑，答案选D。

stem: 26. Londoners have been journeying south _____ Brighton for almost 250 years, ever since a doctor claimed that bathing in and drinking the local sea water was therapeutic.
choices: through<sep>around<sep>to<sep>in
analysis: 句意：自从一位医生声称在当地的海水中沐浴和饮用具有治疗作用以来，伦敦人向南前往布莱顿已有近250年的历史。根据句子意思可知，空白处应填介词to，表示去往某个地方

stem: 27. The TV networks believe that the period between 7 p.m. and 10 p.m. is the ____ television viewing time.
choices: prime<sep>primitive<sep>primary<sep>principle
analysis: 【解析】句意：电视广播网认为晚上7点到10点是看电视的黄金时间。“prime time”是固定搭配，表示（电视的）黄金时间，故选A。B. primitive原始的，C. primary 主要的，首要的，D. principle 原则

stem: 28. The pressure _____causes Japanese to be energetic, but it also puts them under a constant emotional strain.
choices: competing<sep>to compete<sep>to be competed<sep>having competed
analysis: 句意：完成任务的压力使日本人精力充沛，但也使他们处于持续的情感压力之下。根据句子结构和意思可知，causes是整个句子的谓语，主语是“ The pressure ____”, 这里是由 “to do”结构做后置定语，意为“...的压力”。

stem: 29. For all good poetry is the spontaneous flow of powerful feelings was put forward by ____.
choices: Robert Burns<sep>William Blake<sep>William Wordsworth<sep>Charles Lamb
analysis: 句意：“好的诗是强烈情感的自然流露”这句话是谁说的？这是一道百科题目，这句话是英国浪漫主义诗人华兹华斯（William Wordsworth）说的，故选C。

stem: 30. Oxford University is an _____ of over 35 colleges, varying in _____ of foundation from medieval times to recent years.
choices: entity; size<sep>organization; manner<sep>integrity; form<sep>association; date
analysis: 句意：牛津大学是一个由超过35个学院组成的协会，这些学院的成立日期从中世纪到近年来有所不同。通过分析“from medieval times to recent years”我们可以推出，第二空应该与时间相关，故选date，D选项。

stem: 31. ______ is a grammatical category used for the analysis of word classes displaying such contrasts as masculine/feminine/neuter, animate/inanimate, etc.
choices: Gender<sep>Case<sep>Number<sep>Mood
analysis: 句意：性别是一个语法范畴，用于分析显示阳性/阴性/中性、有生命/无生命等对比的词类。根据语法知识以及“masculine/feminite”可知，空白处应该填“性别”，故选A。B. case 指“格”，如主格可以说“nominative case”；C. number数字； D. mood “语气”，如“subjunctive mood”虚拟语气。

stem: 32. If you want a shop to keep something for you until later, you may have to _____ .
choices: give a discount<sep>give a refund<sep>open an account<sep>pay a deposit
analysis: 句意：如果你想让商店为你保留一些东西，你可能需要付押金。A. give a discount打折；B. give a refund 退款；C. open an account 开设账户；D. pay a deposit 付押金；根据句意可知，答案为D。

stem: 33. But we have to acknowledge that, for some people, religious identity is such an important part of their lives that it may ____ everything else.
choices: overcome<sep>transcend<sep>excel<sep>predominate
analysis: 句意：但我们必须承认，对一些人来说，宗教身份是他们生活中如此重要的一部分，它可能超越其他一切。A. overcome克服，克服困难可以说“overcome difficulties”；B. transcend超越，跨越（常用于抽象方面的超越），如：music that transcends cultural boundaries跨越不同文化的音乐；C. excel擅长，胜过（他人），后面常接介词at或in；D. predominate支配，主导；根据句意可知选B。

stem: 34. An investigation was carried out on the admission rate of the children in the south area, _____were surprising.
choices: which results<sep>the results of which<sep>as the results<sep>the results of theirs
analysis: 句意：相关部门对南方地区儿童入学率进行了调查，其结果令人惊讶。通过分析句子结构，可以知道本题考察的是非限制性定语从句，首先排除C，因为as不能引导非限制性定语从句；由于从句中已经有谓语动词were，所以排除A；D选项不能连接两个分句，所以选B。

stem: 35. There is already growing evidence, on the basis of ongoing research, that some crop yields are declining _____ climate change.
choices: on account of<sep>with regard to<sep>in spite of<sep>by means of
analysis: 句意：在现有研究的基础上，有越来越多的证据表明，气候变化导致一些作物的产量正在下降。分析句子，空格前后是因果关系，A. on account of 因为； B. with regard to 关于；C. in spite of 尽管; D. by means of 以某种方法；A符合语境，B、C、D带进去句意不通，故选A。

stem: 36. If you perform a service or ____ a commodity for others, you should be ____ for your pains.
choices: compose; gratified<sep>fabricate; fulfilled<sep>produce; rewarded<sep>originate; benefited
analysis: 句意：如果你为别人提供服务或生产商品，你的付出应该得到回报。A. compose 作曲，（使）镇静; gratified 使满足；B. fabricate制造，编造; fulfilled 满足，实现；C. produce 生产; rewarded 奖励，回报； D. originate起源于; benefited 有益于；“compose”和“originate”无法于commodity搭配，排除A、D，根据句意，排除B的fulfilled，故选C。

stem: 37. We re older now and we shouldn t really still be ____ a grudge towards one another.
choices: yielding<sep>directing<sep>bearing<sep>cherishing
analysis: 句意：我们现在长大了，不应该仍对彼此怀恨在心。Bear a grudge (against)是固定搭配，“对...怀恨在心”。A. yield 出产，屈服； B. direct 导演，指向；D. cherish 珍爱。

stem: 38. Helen s parents wanted her to give up writing, but she ____ and went on to become a famous writer.
choices: carried coals to Newcastle<sep>cost an arm and a leg<sep>called a spade a spade<sep>dug in her heels
analysis: 句意：海伦的父母想让她放弃写作，但她坚持不懈，后来成为了一名著名的作家。A. carried coals to Newcastle 多此一举； B. cost an arm and a leg“付出了昂贵的代价、在某事上花费巨大”； C. called a spade a spade “有话直说”； D. dug in her heels “坚持不懈”，根据句意可知，选D。

stem: 39. Erwin: How much did you pay for it? Dennis: 200 bucks. Erwin: 200 bucks for a piece of junk like that? That s a rip-off ! Dennis: What do you mean? Erwin: _____ Dennis: Oh. I guess I really did get ripped off.
choices: It s not worth it.<sep>That s the best I can offer.<sep>It just slipped my mind.<sep>I m kind of broke.
analysis: 句意： 欧文:你花了多少钱买的? 丹尼斯:200美元。 欧文:200美元就买这么一堆垃圾?那是敲竹杠! 丹尼斯:你是什么意思? 欧文:太不值了。 丹尼斯:哦。我想我真的被骗了。 A. It’s not worth it. 太不值了。 B. That’s the best I can offer. 这是我能给的最好的东西。 C. It just slipped my mind. 我忘了。 D. I’m kind of broke. 我手头有点紧。 根据句意和前后逻辑，答案选A。

stem: 40. Niles: When are you gonna take your vacation? Gloria: I was planning to take it at the end of this month. My husband and I haven t had a chance to have a vacation over the past three years. So we re planning to travel to Europe this time. Why! Has something come up? Niles: Well, would it be too inconvenient for you to wait until next month? Gloria: Hm... not really. _____ , but I ve got to talk about it with my husband. Niles: Thank you very much. I really appreciate your being so flexible.
choices: I wish I could get away for a while<sep>I think I ll just need a break<sep>I guess I can put it off until next month<sep>You really scared the heck out of me
analysis: 句意： 奈尔斯:你打算什么时候去度假? 格洛丽亚:我本来打算这个月底去。过去三年，我和我丈夫都没有机会去度假。所以我们计划这次去欧洲旅行。啊!出什么事了吗? 奈尔斯:嗯，你等到下个月会不会不太方便? 格洛丽亚:嗯……不是很想。我想我可以推迟到下个月，但我得和我丈夫商量一下。 奈尔斯:非常感谢。感谢你能灵活调整时间。 A. I wish I could get away for a while 我希望我能离开一段时间 B. I think I’ll just need a break 我想我需要休息一下 C. I guess I can put it off until next month 我想我可以推迟到下个月 D. You really scared the heck out of me 你真的吓死我了 空格后面说 “要和丈夫商量”，说明态度上是同意的，根据句意选C。

stem: 26. Reading _____ the lines, I would say that the Government are more worried than they will admit.
choices: along<sep>among<sep>between<sep>behind
analysis: 【解析】句意：我领悟到了他们的言外之意，我敢说政府比他们所承认的更加焦虑。read between lines为固定搭配，意为领悟隐藏的意思、领会言外之意，故选C。

stem: 27. In the phenomenon of atomic fission, the nucleus is _____ two pieces of appropriately equal mass.
choices: combined with<sep>coinciding with<sep>fallen into<sep>split into
analysis: 【解析】句意：在原子裂变现象中，原子核分裂成恰好相等的两半。split into......意为分裂成…… 。combine with......意为与……结合；coincide with......意为与……恰好同时发生，巧合；fall into......意为掉入。

stem: 28. In education there should be a good _____ among the branches of knowledge that _____effective thinking and wise judgment.
choices: assignment; develop into<sep>balance; contribute to<sep>combination; lead to<sep>distribution; grow into
analysis: 【解析】句意：在教育中，应在各个学科之间保持良好的平衡，以促进有效思考和明智的判断。balance意为均衡，contribute to导致，促进。assignment任务，develop into发展为；combination结合，lead to导致；distribution分配、分布，grow into成长为、成为。

stem: 29. When confronted with such questions, my mind goes _____, and I can hardly remember my own date of birth.
choices: blank<sep>dim<sep>faint<sep>vain
analysis: 【解析】句意：当面临这样的问题时，我的大脑变得一片空白，而且我几乎无法记得我自己的生日了。blank 意为空白的。dim昏暗的；faint暗淡的，眩晕的；vain徒劳无功的。

stem: 30. Its charm and mild climate have made San Francisco, California, _____ city for both business and residences.
choices: a crowded<sep>an appealing<sep>an appropriate<sep>a profitable
analysis: 【解析】句意：加利福尼亚的旧金山的迷人且温和的气候使其成为了一座在商业和居住方面都极具吸引力/商住皆宜的城市。appealing有吸引力的。crowded拥挤的；appropriate合适的；profitable有利润的。

stem: 31. Respect for the law is the foundation of civilized society._____breaks it will be punished.
choices: Whoever<sep>Who<sep>Person who<sep>No matter who
analysis: 【解析】句意：遵守法律是文明社会的基石。无论是谁违反了法律，都将受到惩罚。此处填写的是从句的引导词，此处需要强调“无论是谁”，且引导的是一个名词从句，故选择whoever。no matter who只能引导状语从句，不可以引导名词性从句。

stem: 32._____ students can study in the hot majors , because the number of these hot majors _____ quite limited.
choices: A few; should be<sep>Not many; are<sep>Only a few; is<sep>Quite a few; has been
analysis: 【解析】句意：仅有少数学生能够学习“热门专业”，因为这些“热门专业”的数量相当有限。a few表示很少，only为“仅有”，强调能够学习热门专业的学生的人数之少；the number of意为“……的数量”，其谓语应为单数第三人称。

stem: 33._____ receiving financial support from family, community or the government is allowed, it is never admired.
choices: As<sep>Although<sep>Lest<sep>Once
analysis: 【解析】句意：尽管收到了来自家庭的经济支持，社区或政府也得到许可，但这仍并不被认可。although表尽管。as作为；lest意为唯恐、生怕；once意为曾经。

stem: 34. One day I _____ a newspaper article about the retirement of an English professor at a nearby state college.
choices: came across<sep>devoted to<sep>put forward<sep>set up
analysis: 【解析】句意：有一天我偶然看到一篇新闻文章，关于一位附近州立高中的英语教师的退休之事。come across意为偶然遇到。devote to投入，奉献给……；put forward提出，将……提前；set up设立。

stem: 35. When snow _____ on top of a building during the winter, the _____ sometimes weakens the construction and occasionally causes the roof to collapse.
choices: scatters; height<sep>melts; process<sep>falls; intensity<sep>accumulates; weight
analysis: 【解析】句意：冬季，当雪堆积在建筑物顶部，其重量有时候会削弱建筑物的结构，有时会造成屋顶坍塌。accumulate意为堆积，weight为重量。scatter散播、撒开；melt融化；fall跌落。height高度；process 进程；intensity强度。

stem: 36. Charles wasn t appointed chairman of the foundation, _____ not very popular with all its members.
choices: being considered<sep>considering<sep>having considered<sep>to be considered
analysis: 【解析】句意：查尔斯并没有被任命为基金会的主席，出于对他在成员间受欢迎度并不高的考量。此处考察的是独立主格结构，此处作原因状语，主语与主句相同，用现在分词形式；用其次确定独立主格结构的主语是Charles，Charles是被考虑、被认为不够受欢迎，因此需要用被动形式。

stem: 37. _____people often desire different goals and objects, it is understandable that one person may find joy in repairing an automobile, _____another may find joy in solving a math problem.
choices: Although; so<sep>For; if<sep>Since; while<sep>When; however
analysis: 【解析】句意：由于人们经常渴望不同的目标，有的人能够能够在修汽车中找到乐趣，而有的担任能够在解数学题中找到乐趣，这是能够理解的。since表由于、因为，while表轻微的对比与转折。

stem: 38. Don t you think a thirty-minute lunch break is too short? _____ Yeah? I think thirty minutes is long enough for lunch.
choices: ​Neither do I.<sep>You are absolutely right.<sep>That s what I m trying to say.<sep>Well, I m not so sure about it.
analysis: 【解析】句意： ——你不认为30分钟的休息太短了吗？ ——嗯……我不是很确定。 ——此话怎讲？ ——我认为30分钟用来吃个午餐已是绰绰有余了。 Well, I'm not sure about it，嗯……我不是很确定。Neither do I，我也不是；You are absolutely right，你完全正确；That's what I'm trying to say，那就是我想表达的。

stem: 39. Hey, you look great. Have you been exercising? Yeah, every day for the last three months. Well, it must be so hard to exercise for so long. It is, but I want to look good. And you know _____.
choices: practice makes perfect<sep>no pain, no gain<sep>genius begins with diligence<sep>time flies
analysis: 【解析】 ——嘿，你看起来很棒。你健身了吗？ ——是的，过去三个月里我每天都健身。 ——嗯，锻炼那么久一定很难。 ——确实如此，但我想看起来身材不错的样子。而且你知道的，没有付出就没有回报。 本题考察英文习语。no pain, no gain意为没有付出就没有回报。Practice makes perfect熟能生巧；genius begins with diligence，天才源于勤奋；time flies时光飞逝。

stem: 40. The sports meet, originally due to be held last Friday, was finally_____ because of the bad weather.
choices: broken out<sep>called off<sep>set off<sep>worn out
analysis: 【解析】句意：因为坏天气，原定要于周五举行的运动会在最后关头被取消了。call off取消。break out意为突然发生；set off意为出发，动身；wear out意为使……精疲力尽。

stem: It is important to set yourself clear _____ so you know what you are aiming for.
choices: objects<sep>goals<sep>decisions<sep>opportunities
analysis: 【解析】句意：设定____十分重要，如此一来你就知道你要朝什么目标努力。A. 物体；B. 目标；C. 决定；D. 机会。B正确。

stem: He decided to buy a really expensive painting by a famous Renaissance painter and not a(n) _____.
choices: imitation<sep>adaption<sep>production<sep>composition
analysis: 【解析】句意：他决定要一副著名文艺复兴画家所作的画作，价格昂贵，不买____。A.模仿，赝品；B.适应；C.产品；D.作文。故选A。

stem: The man was put into an isolation ward because the disease was highly _____.
choices: infectious<sep>destructive<sep>severe<sep>massive
analysis: 【解析】句意：男子安排在了隔离间，因为这个疾病非常____。A.传染的；B.毁灭的；C.严重的；D.巨大的。

stem: My first job was to arrange the files into _____ order from the oldest to the most recent.
choices: alphabetical<sep>chronological<sep>numerical<sep>historical
analysis: 【解析】句意：我的第一项工作是整理文件，按照____顺序从最远的到最近的将文件放在一起。A.按字母顺序的；B.按时间发生顺序的；C.数字的；D.历史的。

stem: Realizing that raising citizens cultural confidence plays a vital role, the government has taken a series of measures to build more museums and make them more _____ to the public.
choices: reasonable<sep>responsible<sep>applicable<sep>accessible
analysis: 【解析】句意：政府意识到提高民族文化自信的重要性，采取了一系列措施，建立更多的博物馆，让博物馆更多向公共____。A.合理的；B.负责任的；C.可应用的；D.可进入的

stem: The government should do more to help the _____ to find a job.
choices: denied<sep>excessive<sep>unemployed<sep>insecure
analysis: 【解析】句意：政府应该采取更多措施帮助失业者找到工作。A.拒绝的； B.过度的；C.失业的；D.不安全的。因此应当选C。

stem: My new fridge has a little screen on the outside that ______ the internal and external temperature.
choices: displays<sep>designs<sep>devises<sep>discovers
analysis: 【解析】句意：我的新冰箱外面有一个小屏幕，____内部和外部的温度。A.显示；B.设计；C.发明；D.发现。故选A。

stem: _____, I believe that banning smokers from public places is a very good idea.
choices: Clearly<sep>Fortunately<sep>Justifiably<sep>Personally
analysis: 【解析】句意：____，我认为禁止在公共场所吸烟是一个很好的主意。本题为简单的词汇考察，A.清晰地；B.幸运地；C.公平地；D.个人认为。故选D。

stem: Dina asked the hotel receptionist to give her a wake-up call _____, she overslept and missed her flight.
choices: therefore<sep>consequently<sep>nevertheless<sep>likewise
analysis: 【解析】句意：迪娜让酒店接待员给她打电话叫醒她；____她睡过头了，错过了航班。A.所以；B.结果；C.否则；D.类似的。应当选C。

stem: When I surf the Internet I often _____. Before I know it, quite a few hours have gone by.
choices: take my time<sep>lose track of time<sep>control time<sep>make poor use of time
analysis: 【解析】句意：当我上网时，我经常____。不知不觉中，好几个小时已经过去了。A.慢慢来，不着急；B.忘记时间；C.控制时间；D.不合理利用时间。应当选C。

stem: Let s wait until the music _____ before we announce the big news.
choices: dies down<sep>cuts down<sep>sets down<sep>closes down
analysis: 【解析】句意：我们等音乐____再宣布这个重大消息吧。A.逐渐减弱，消失；B.砍伐；C.放置；D.关闭。故选A。

stem: This is the third year _____ that a female has been chosen to manage the club.
choices: in procession<sep>in success<sep>in process<sep>in succession
analysis: 【解析】句意：这是女性第三年____来管理这个俱乐部。A.队伍中；B.不成功；C.过程中；D.连续。故选D。

stem: It can take _____ time for people to get used to the new system.
choices: long<sep>a long<sep>so long<sep>too long
analysis: 【解析】句意：人们需要_____时间来适应新系统。这道题是对语法的简单考察，take a long time是固定词组，花费很长时间。故选B。

stem: _____ You look a bit like you need a vacation. Actually, I think I just need to sleep for a week. I ve been studying way too hard. You should take a week off and go lie on a beach somewhere!
choices: Where did you go last weekend?<sep>How is your study going?<sep>How was your day trip to the Great Wall?<sep>Why did you stay up late last night?
analysis: 【解析】句意：——_____看起来需要度个假。 ——事实上，我想我只需要睡一个星期。我一直在努力学习。 ——你应该休息一个星期，到什么地方的海滩上躺一躺! A.你上周去哪里了？B.你学习进展如何？C.你的长城之行如何？D.你昨晚为什么熬夜那么晚？所以选择A。

stem: My doctor has suggested that I try music therapy to reduce my pain. Really? _____ At the hospital or at a private clinic.
choices: Do you think music therapy will work?<sep>Who does music therapy for you?<sep>Where can you get music therapy?<sep>How come you believe in music therapy?
analysis: 【解析】句意：—我的医生建议我尝试音乐疗法来减轻疼痛。 ——真的吗？____。 ——医院或者私人诊所 A.你觉得音乐疗法有效吗？B.谁给你用音乐疗法？C.你在哪里可以获得音乐疗法？D.你是怎么相信音乐疗法的？所以选择C。
